title: Sr. Account Executive Enterprise Sales
description:
The Team + The Role

Pendo’s Enterprise Sales team drives growth across the company’s largest and most strategic accounts. The team partners with senior business and technology leaders to position Pendo as a critical platform for product experience, data, analytics, and digital transformation. In DACH, this team plays a key role in expanding Pendo’s presence with major enterprise customers and prospects.

As a Senior Account Executive, you will own new business across Pendo’s largest DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts. You will lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close, with a focus on $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities. This role requires a strategic enterprise seller who can build executive relationships, create disciplined account plans, and position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions with clarity and urgency.

This role is based in our Munich office.

What this looks like day-to-day

- New logo acquisition: Win new enterprise logos across Germany within Pendo’s most strategic segment. You will identify, engage, and convert high-value opportunities across large DACH accounts and DAX 40 prospect accounts.

- Enterprise sales execution: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles from first engagement through close. You will navigate matrixed organizations, align executive buyers, and keep deals moving with clear next steps and strong commercial discipline.

- Strategic deal leadership: Consistently drive $500K–$1M+ SaaS opportunities by building value-based business cases. You will position Pendo’s AI-powered Data & Analytics platform as a critical driver of digital transformation for enterprise customers.

- Executive relationship building: Build trusted relationships with C-level leaders and senior decision-makers. You will engage stakeholders with credibility, understand their priorities, and connect Pendo’s capabilities to strategic business outcomes.

- Account planning: Develop and execute clear, strategic account plans for target enterprise accounts. You will map stakeholders, identify growth opportunities, and create focused plans that support new business acquisition and long-term account potential.

- Cross-functional partnership: Collaborate across Pendo to win and expand strategic accounts. You will partner with internal teams to bring the right expertise into each opportunity and create a strong, coordinated customer experience.

- Pipeline and forecast discipline: Maintain accurate forecasting and disciplined pipeline management. You will keep opportunity data current, communicate deal progress clearly, and manage your business with structure and accountability.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Senior Account Executives don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

- Strong track record of closing $500K–$1M+ enterprise SaaS deals across DACH.

- Experience selling into large, complex, matrixed organizations with multiple senior stakeholders and executive buyers.

- Proven success in a start-up or high-growth environment, with the ability to operate with structure, urgency, and ownership.

- Background selling Data, Analytics, AI, or enterprise technology solutions.

- Passion for AI and technology, with genuine curiosity about how AI is changing the way people work.

- Confident engagement style with C-level leaders, senior decision-makers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Structured, strategic, and highly self-driven approach to account planning, pipeline management, and deal execution.

- Fluent German and professional English.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience selling into DAX 40 prospect accounts or similarly large strategic enterprise accounts.

- Experience positioning AI-powered Data & Analytics solutions as part of broader digital transformation initiatives.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.

Benefits: Robust, employer-backed social coverage paired with additional cash stipends, equity, and meaningful retirement and commute support.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: ----- All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

title: Founding Account Executive – Benelux
description:
Your Impact 

Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit, a proven playbook, and now we're taking it into the rest of Europe.

Benelux is one of our first markets. The Netherlands and Belgium hold a dense base of high-tech and industrial manufacturers, and the category is still wide open there. That's where you come in. You take the region and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates, and win the first customers and reference logos that everything else builds on. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows Benelux from there. A real greenfield, with the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market.

You're not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. This is a highly strategic GTM role where you work hands-on to close the first deals and set the base for everything that comes afterwards. You're based with us in Munich and travel into your market.

Your Tasks 

- Open up Benelux end to end: sharpen the ICP for Dutch and Belgian manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the region's growth

- Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case, closing

- Work hand in hand with the expansion team and develop the outbound playbook for your market: messaging, sequences, segments, channels

- Coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline

- Feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership, and shape how Tacto expands internationally

Your Profile 

- Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes

- An entrepreneurial mindset above all: you want to build and own a market result, explore what works, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn't exist yet

- Hands-on and self-driven: you go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline. You've carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you

- You grasp complex products and sell value over features, translating technical depth into business impact

- Fluent, business-level English. Dutch is a strong plus, French an advantage for the Belgian market. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language

- You're based in Munich or ready to relocate. This is an on-site role - you build Benelux from our Munich office and travel into the market

Who Thrives Here 

You run your market like a founder runs a company. You're a hunter, hands-on to the core: you send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries, and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. You go through the mud and build as you go, turning what works into a system the next person can run. And you think beyond the next deal. You're not just winning customers, you're laying Tacto's foundation in your region: externally through brand, network, and reference logos, and internally through the playbook and the case for the market.

Interview Process 

- Intro call with our Chief of Staff

- Deep dive with our Head of Revenue

- Get-to-know call with the AE you'd be working alongside

- Onsite interview incl. case study and team meetings

Our Background 

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters 

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI. 

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer 

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

- Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

- Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

- Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

- Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

- Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

- Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

What you will do

- Design, implement, and optimize 5G NR PHY algorithms on processor-based and heterogeneous SoC platforms

- Develop software for key PHY functions such as modulation/demodulation, channel estimation, equalization, synchronization, coding/decoding, and HARQ support

- Implement PHY software compliant with 3GPP Rel 15/16/17 specifications

- Hardware, RF, and Platform Integration 

- Integrate 5G PHY software with RF front-end hardware and digital baseband chains

- Develop and maintain hardware control software using interfaces such as I2C and SPI

- Work with complex SoC architectures, including ARM, DSPs, and hardware accelerators

- Develop software interfaces toward embedded accelerators and DSP blocks

- Real-Time and Embedded Systems 

- Design software within strict real-time constraints and low-latency requirements

- Optimize performance, memory usage, and throughput of PHY software components

- Verification, Testing, and Debug 

- Create and execute PHY-level test cases and validation scenarios

- Generate, analyze, and verify PHY test vectors and waveforms

- Verify PHY functionality using 5G test equipment (e.g., R&S, Agilent) and commercial UEs

- Debug complex PHY, timing, RF, and performance issues across software and hardware boundaries

- Technical Leadership and Delivery 

- Provide effort estimation and technical input for PHY software development tasks

- Support customer requests related to 5G PHY features and performance

- Document PHY designs, implementations, and results in Confluence or equivalent systems

- Collaboration and Ways of Working

- Work effectively in a global, distributed team across Europe, India, and the U.S.

- Follow SCRUM / Agile and Continuous Integration development practices

- Operate autonomously while maintaining strong technical communication

What you bring to this role 

- Master of Science or Master of Engineering degree in Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or equivalent

- Significant professional experience as an embedded C and C/C++ software engineer

- Strong background in 5G NR PHY and digital communications theory

- Experience working with SDR platforms and SoC architectures

- Working knowledge of MATLAB and Python for PHY algorithm development and analysis

- Strong understanding of real-time embedded software constraints

- Excellent problem-solving, time management, and communication skills

Bonus Points

- Experience with Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN) and satellite communications

title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description:
Why Kimchi?

Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.

Kimchi Inference 

One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.

Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion. 

About the role

Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.

Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.

The problem: the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.

Stack: Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.

Requirements

- You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.

- Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.

- You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.

- You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.

- Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.

- You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.

- You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.

- A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.

Nice to haves

- You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.

- Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.

- You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.

Responsibilities

- Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine
fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.

- Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or
network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.

- Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the
unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.

- Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business
taking an hour to reach serving.

- Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.

- Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck
on storage or interconnect.

experiments.

title: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router)
description:
Why Kimchi?

Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and the router deciding which model answers each request is ours too.

The Auto Router 

Our promise is one enforcement layer for your AI: budgets, spend attribution, and model routing, applied before a request ever hits a model. The Auto Router makes the call: for every request, which model serves it. Eight open-source models whose input prices span more than 20×, cached input up to 50× cheaper than fresh, frontier providers on customers' own keys, and a coding agent that fires hundreds of requests before its task is done. Frontier-level task success at a fraction of the token cost: that sentence is the product, and it stays true only if the model inside the router keeps getting better. That model is yours.

Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion. 

About the role

Every request gets a decision: which model serves it.

This is an applied-ML seat, not an infrastructure one. Platform engineers own the proxy, the streaming path, and the fleet. You own the model inside them: the training data, the objective, the evaluation, and the iteration loop that ships a better router every cycle.

The problem: routing is a prediction problem wearing a product's clothes. For every request you predict the quality each candidate model would deliver, what it would cost, and how fast it would decode, and you have to be right enough, in aggregate, that the savings are real and the quality never dips below frontier. The data is messy: rollout outcomes from benchmark harnesses, per-request records from the live fleet, override signals, and token streams whose speed depends on the serving concurrency at the moment. Speed itself is a correctness variable: on deadline-bound agentic work, a model that decodes three times slower doesn't do the same work slower, it does less work. That's why naive cost-per-token objectives quietly optimize for the wrong thing. And the bar for evidence is high: a router change ships only after production-parity evaluation with error bars, then gets held to its numbers in live traffic.

Stack: Python; PyTorch; SQL at scale (ClickHouse); OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM APIs; benchmark and rollout harnesses (RouterBench-class); GitLab CI.

Requirements

- You've spent 5+ years in applied ML or ML research, and you've trained, evaluated, and shipped models that make real-time decisions (ranking, recommendation, bandits, pricing, or LLM routing) and you can tell that story with receipts.

- Strong Python and SQL at scale: you can pull, clean, and interrogate millions of request-level records without waiting on anyone.

- You know the difference between a model that got better and an eval that got easier.

- You have real opinions about what LLM benchmarks measure, agentic harnesses included.

- You know enough serving reality (TTFT, decode speed, batching, prefix caching, concurrency) to model the objective honestly.

- You instrument before you optimize, error bars and all.

- A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.

Nice to haves

- You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.

- Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.

- You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.

Responsibilities

- Own the routing model end to end: features, objective, training, calibration, and release cadence. Iterate it like a product, not a research artifact.

- Build the evaluation that gates every change: production-parity benchmarks, router-vs-router comparisons, holdouts by task family, error bars on pass rates.
Nothing ships on vibes.

- Turn fleet data into training signal: per-request outcomes from production, benchmark rollouts, and override feedback, with failure categorization (infra vs
task) so poisoned labels never reach the policy.

- Model the objective the user actually experiences: task success × token cost × wall-clock speed under the real concurrency regime, with cached-input
economics in the picture.

- Run the online loop: shadow, A/B, full rollout, drift monitoring, retrain. When production disagrees with your offline eval, you find out why before the next
ship.

- Push the frontier where it pays: calibrated decisions, abstention under uncertainty, speed-aware routing. We experiment on what a router should be, not just
which model it picks today.

- Partner with platform engineers on instrumentation: the features and labels recorded per request (decode speed first-class among them) and the experiments
the data path must support.

You will work closely with various functions of Deliveroo to share insights from partners and ensure we are developing a “best in class” value proposition. With Deliveroo Express being a new product launched in April, you will play a pivotal role in defining the on-going strategy and driving success of this proposition. 

Using data to understand trends in performance and identify opportunities for operational excellence will be critical to your success in the role. You will need to be able to manage multiple projects at once, interacting with key functions such as Product, Operations and Commercial. You will use your business acumen and negotiation skills to win new business deals and build an on-going pipeline.

Key Responsibilities 

- Directly own the day-day relationship with Deliveroo Express partners across all verticals - Restaurants, Grocery and Retail

- Analyse and present insights on performance against KPIs during weekly/monthly/quarterly meetings and reviews

- Conduct detailed analysis and extract insights to deliver operational excellence and identify ways to course-correct if needed

- Identify opportunities to deepen and grow our partner relationships 

- Develop on-going sales strategy for Deliveroo Express including pipeline development across markets, with support from your Commercial lead

- Conduct new business pitching and commercial negotiation for new partners, with support from your Commercial lead

Qualities We’re Looking For 

- DECISIVE AND INFLUENTIAL: ​you should thrive in a fast-paced environment, and be comfortable with making fast decisions, even in times of ambiguity and based on intuition. You are comfortable making recommendations and communicating them across the business persuasively. More importantly, you must have a strong desire to galvanise action within Deliveroo, thinking about the big picture but also not afraid to get into the weeds of a problem to get things done.

- ANALYTICAL AND COLLABORATIVE: ​there will be some number-crunching involved, but your role will also be about stepping back – you’ll need to see the bigger picture and understand how your insights are aligned with the direction the business is heading in. 

- COMMERCIAL: you will need to excel in building relationships with local commercial teams, and external partners and understand how best to bring our proposition to grocers and retailers. You will need to build a deep understanding of the Deliveroo P&L and operations of the business.

- Confident in analysing data and extracting compelling and actionable insights

- Strong operational mindset to identify opportunities for excellence and course-correct when needed 

- Partner obsessed , with effective relationship building, organisation and communication skills

title: Senior Consultant, Technical Advisory - Electrical T&D Expert
description:
About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Technical Advisory practice are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join the team. 

Our Energy and Resources team works across the energy value chain and supports many of the world’s leading energy companies, infrastructure investors, private-equity funds, lenders, developers, network owners and government organisations. You will have the opportunity to work on transactions and projects across the UK, Europe and internationally. Our Market and Transactions unit is looking for an experienced Senior Consultant or Manager to join our Technical Advisory capability, working at the heart of the energy transition and supporting investors, developers, lenders, utilities and public-sector organisations on grid connection, grid compliance and electrical network decisions. Our Technical Advisory team combines engineering, transaction advisory and technical due diligence experience to help clients understand the connection, compliance, curtailment and network risks that determine the cost, programme and value of energy assets. You will work closely with Baringa’s market, commercial, market access and transaction advice teams, while bringing an independent and engineering-led perspective to investment and development decisions.

What you will be doing 

The core of the role is applying a high voltage power systems background to the grid and electrical workstreams of buy-side, sell-side and lender technical due diligence, and to connection and network advice, across generation, storage, interconnector, network and large demand assets. You will typically:

- Support infrastructure investors, lenders, developers, utilities and public-sector clients on grid connection, compliance and electrical network questions, bringing a power systems perspective to investment and development decisions.

- Review connection applications, offers, agreements and ICP or IDNO arrangements, and the delivery programme behind them, including reinforcement dependencies, outage requirements, network operator obligations and energisation milestones, and what delay would mean for commercial operation.

- Assess grid code and connection compliance requirements such as reactive power and voltage control, frequency response, fault ride-through and power quality, and how compliance will be demonstrated through to energisation.

- Review power system studies prepared by developers, contractors and third parties, including load flow, fault level, voltage step change and harmonics, and whether the assumptions and results are reasonable.

- Assess network constraints and curtailment assumptions, including export limitation and flexible or non-firm connection arrangements, and what they mean for output and revenue.

- Review transmission and distribution infrastructure, including substations, switchgear, transformers, cables, overhead lines, protection and control systems and electrical balance of plant, and comment on design, condition and capacity headroom.

- Benchmark electrical capital and operating costs, connection charges, reinforcement liabilities and replacement assumptions, and whether they are reflected in the business plan.

- Turn complex and often incomplete technical information into clear, practical findings and recommendations for engineering and investment audiences through reports, risk registers and presentations, and take part in client discussions, technical Q&A sessions, management meetings and site

Your skills and experience 

Essential experience 

- You will typically have 5 to 8 years of relevant professional experience, although we welcome candidates outside this range with particularly relevant experience.

- You will have a strong foundation in electrical or power systems engineering, supported by a relevant degree, equivalent qualification or substantial practical experience.

- You will have demonstrable experience undertaking technical due diligence, Lender’s Technical Advisor assignments or comparable investor-facing technical assessments of power and grid infrastructure. This will include assessing capital and operating expenditure assumptions, identifying material technical and investment risks, and taking ownership of substantive deliverables such as technical report sections, risk registers or red flag presentations.

- You will have experience of grid connection processes, including connection strategies, applications, offers and agreements, alongside an understanding of grid code requirements and technical compliance processes for generation, storage or large demand projects.

- You will have hands-on experience independently undertaking power system studies, including relevant network modelling and analysis, using industry-standard software such as DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSS®E, PSCAD or IPSA.

- You will have experience taking responsibility for technical workstreams, coordinating specialist inputs, engaging directly with clients and supporting junior colleagues, appropriate to your level of experience.

- Chartered Engineer status, or demonstrable progress towards chartership, would be desirable but is not essential.

Desirable experience 

- Experience of network constraints and curtailment, including constraint drivers, export limitation, and flexible or non-firm connection arrangements, and their consequences for asset output.

- Experience of the GB connection and compliance regime, including engagement with the national system operator, transmission owners and network operators, and familiarity with the operational notification stage gate process, would be highly relevant.

- Experience of connection and compliance regimes in other European markets, or of interconnector, HVDC or offshore transmission projects, would be valuable.

- Experience of connection charging, reinforcement liabilities, securities, network charges, or the regulatory framework governing connections and network investment would be useful.

- Experience with network owners or operators, including asset condition assessment, capacity headroom, network performance and investment planning, would be relevant.

- Experience using operational or network datasets, automation or AI-enabled tools to support technical assessment and document review would be beneficial, provided outputs remain transparent, auditable and subject to professional judgement. What a career at Baringa will give you 

Putting   People   First. 

Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: 

- Generous Annual Leave Policy:  We recognise everyone needs a well-deserved break. We provide our employees with 5 weeks of annual leave, fully available at the start of each year. In addition to this, we have introduced our 5-Year Recharge benefit which allows all employees an additional 2 weeks of paid leave after 5 years continuous service. 

- Flexible Working:  We know that the ‘ideal’ work-life balance will vary from person to person and change at different stages of our working lives. To accommodate this, we have implemented a hybrid working policy and introduced more flexibility around taking unpaid leave. 

- Corporate Responsibility Days:  Our world is important to us, so all our employees get 3 every year to help social and environmental causes and increase our impact on the communities that mean the most to us. 

- Wellbeing Fund:  We want to encourage all employees to take charge and prioritise their own wellbeing. We’ve introduced our annual People Fund to support this by offering every individual a fund to support and manage their wellbeing through an activity of their choice. 

- Profit Share Scheme:  All employees participate in the Baringa Group Profit Share Scheme so everyone has a stake in the company’s success. 

Diversity and Inclusion 

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people. 

An award-winning workplace 

You can be a part of our ‘Great Place to Work’ – with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all.  Click here  to see some of our recent awards and how we’ve achieved this. 

Using business as a force for good. 

We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve. 

We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have. 

Join us 

All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. We operate an inclusive recruitment process, ensuring reasonable adjustments where needed. Please contact a member of our Recruitment Team to discuss further. 

Baringa Privacy Notices 

For UK & EU 

Your personal data will be retained by Baringa for up to two years, in accordance with our UK Recruitment Privacy Notice / EU Recruitment Privacy Notice , to evaluate

title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Driving Product
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Driving Product Team 

The Driving Product team owns Wayve's core end to end driving model, the algorithm that directly shapes how our vehicles behave on the road. This model already underpins production agreements with Nissan and Mercedes, with further OEM partnerships in the works, so the team's output is tied directly to Wayve's near term commercial milestones. The team is highly iterative: it looks at the top issues we see on the road, root causes them, and drives them out through data, model and evaluation changes, working closely with other teams across the business to resolve issues that span the model and vehicle interface.

🧠 Your day-to-day 

- Lead the team iterating on L2 driving performance, balancing hands-on technical work with team leadership

- Diagnose the highest impact issues seen on the road, root cause them, and resolve them through data and model iteration

- Own changes to data recipes, model architecture, evaluation and release readiness for the driving model

- Partner with other teams to resolve cross-functional issues, including model and vehicle interface problems

- Act as one of the team's key hands-on developers, writing code and running experiments alongside directing the team's priorities

🧩 What you'll be working on: 

- The end to end driving model that powers Wayve's L2 product and sits at the centre of our OEM partnerships with Nissan and Mercedes, with further partners in the pipeline

- Scaling the driving model's performance across different geographies and vehicle platforms while hitting performance and compliance KPIs

- Data led iteration cycles: using on road and off road evaluation to identify the biggest performance gaps and close them

- Cross-functional resolution of model and vehicle interface issues, working with specialists across the business

- Growing and shaping a small, high impact team (initially up to five people) as the driving model programme scales

👤 You should apply if: 

- You're highly technical and hands-on, comfortable writing Python and doing model and data iteration yourself, not just directing others

- You've delivered deployed, production ML models, ideally in robotics or autonomous vehicles, with experience shipping and iterating on ML for embodied AI applications

- Alternatively, you've productionised ML models at another company and have experience delivering incremental improvements to a live system over time

- Your experience is production focused rather than primarily research or early stage exploration

- You want to keep doing deeply technical work, whether or not you've managed people before. We're looking for strong ICs or tech leads just as much as experienced managers, and are happy to ease the right person into managing a small team

🌱 Not ticking every box? That's totally okay! If you're passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every requirement.

More about Wayve: 

🚗 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve's mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working: 

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

📋 The Interview Process: 

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

- Initial call / recruiter screen (20 mins)

- Competency technical interviews (programming and system design; 2 hours)

- Deep-dive interviews (domain and technical leadership; 2 hours)

- Final interview : mission & values alignment (1 hour)

We'll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What's in it for you (Location dependent): 

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partner discounts and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

- Build relationships with brokers and dealers and ensure our underwriting and pay out processes meet their needs

What you’ll bring

- Significant operational leadership experience in regulated financial services

- Deep working knowledge of UK consumer credit conduct requirements

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the world's largest travel brands. We're looking for a senior full stack engineer to anchor this product, owning the realtime and voice layer end to end while building across React/TypeScript front ends, Scala and Python services, and cloud infrastructure. The team is lean and senior, ownership is broad, and the path from your code to a traveler's phone call is short.

What would your day-to-day look like 

- Own the voice channel end to end, including telephony and CPaaS integrations (e.g., Twilio, Amazon Connect), streaming speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, realtime model orchestration, and latency and quality budgets

- Build product features across the stack, including web chat front ends in React/TypeScript, backend services in Scala and Python, and infrastructure on GCP

- Design for multi-tenant scale, with one codebase serving many partners through configuration rather than forks

- Build the safety and compliance plumbing enterprise partners audit, including guardrails, content filtering, and PII redaction integration points

- Keep revenue-critical deployments healthy through observability, alerting, incident response, and SLA performance

- Build the platform capabilities forward-deployed engineers configure for partner telephony integrations and go-lives

- Raise the engineering bar through code review, architecture reviews, and mentoring

An ideal candidate has 

- 6+ years of software engineering experience, with senior-level ownership of production systems and genuine full-stack range

- Hands-on realtime systems experience, such as voice applications, WebRTC/SIP, streaming media, or comparable low-latency products

- Strength in a modern front end (React, TypeScript) and depth on the backend (Scala or another JVM language, and/or Python), along with cloud infrastructure experience on GCP or AWS

- A track record designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven systems

- Familiarity using AI coding tools as a standard part of their workflow, with the judgment to review, correct, and own everything that ships

- An operable-systems mindset, covering SLAs, observability, on-call rotations, and rollback plans

- The ability to break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and ship iteratively, backed by strong communication across product, design, and operations

- Bonus points for conversational AI or LLM orchestration experience, including speech technologies such as Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Whisper, or OpenAI Realtime

- Bonus points for working knowledge of cloud telephony or CPaaS platforms such as Twilio, Amazon Connect, Genesys, or LiveKit

- Bonus points for experience building customer service, CRM, contact center, or workflow automation tools

- Familiarity with travel industry technologies (PSS/GDS, hotel PMS/CRS) is a plus, though not required

Perks and benefits of working with us 

- Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

- Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for the employee for a group insurance plan through Vitality Health

- Automatic contributions when you start with Hopper through Smart Pension

- Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

- Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

- Carrot Cash travel stipend

- Unlimited PTO

- Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

- Open communication with management and company leadership

- Small, dynamic teams, massive impact

About Hopper 

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth: 

- Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS' channels every year. 

- Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions. 

- Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus if they booked just travel.

- Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description:
Why Kimchi?

Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.

Kimchi Inference 

One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.

Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion. 

About the role

Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.

Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.

The problem: the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.

Stack: Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.

Requirements

- You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.

- Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.

- You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.

- You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.

- Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.

- You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.

- You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.

- A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.

Nice to haves

- You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.

- Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.

- You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.

Responsibilities

- Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine
fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.

- Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or
network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.

- Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the
unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.

- Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business
taking an hour to reach serving.

- Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.

- Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck
on storage or interconnect.

- Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible
experiments.

What’s in it for you?

- Competitive salary (depending on the level of experience).

- Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.

- Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology

- Equity options.

- Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.

- Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement. 

- Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.

- Annual hackathon to spark new ideas and strengthen team bonds.

- Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.

- Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.

- Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Hiring process

- Hiring Manager interview

- Technical interview (system design)

- Live coding

title: Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F)
description:
Ingénieur R&D Conception d'équipements d’essais (H/F) 

À propos de notre client 

Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux.

Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE.

Le poste 

Pour accélérer ses projets de développement, notre client recrute un(e) Ingénieur(e) R&D en conception d'équipements d'essais. Vous prendrez en charge la conception, la mise au point et la validation de cellules d'essais haute température et haute pression, un sujet stratégique pour l'entreprise et ses clients.

Rattaché(e) à la direction des opérations, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe qui conçoit aujourd'hui les équipements et dépose les brevets de l'entreprise.

Répartition indicative du temps : environ 70 à 80 % conception et développement, 20 à 30 % laboratoire (montage et validation de vos équipements).

Dans une structure à taille humaine, vous suivrez vos développements de la conception jusqu'aux tests, avant leur transfert à l'équipe de production.

Vos missions 

Conception et développement d'équipements d’essais

- Concevoir de nouvelles cellules et de nouveaux dispositifs d'essais, notamment pour des conditions de haute température et de haute pression.
- Résoudre les problématiques techniques associées : instrumentation et capteurs, étanchéité, tenue en température et en pression.
- Consulter les fournisseurs et sous-traitants, et suivre la fabrication des pièces.
- Améliorer les équipements existants, notamment leur ergonomie et leur facilité d'utilisation en production.
Mise au point et validation

- Monter les équipements développés et réaliser leurs tests de validation au laboratoire.
- Interpréter les résultats expérimentaux et vérifier leur cohérence.
- Transférer les équipements validés à l'équipe de production et l'accompagner dans leur prise en main.
Documentation et propriété intellectuelle

- Rédiger la documentation technique, les rapports et les comptes-rendus, et les présenter, en français comme en anglais.
- Participer à la veille technique et à la rédaction des documents de protection (brevets, enveloppes Soleau).
Vie du laboratoire

- Comprendre les essais réalisés au laboratoire pour concevoir des équipements adaptés à leurs besoins.
- Contribuer à l'activité du labo et à l'amélioration continue, dans le respect de la démarche qualité ISO 9001.
Requirements 

Compétences techniques

- Conception mécanique et maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO.
- Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure.
- Compréhension des grandeurs physiques et physico-chimiques.
- Rédaction technique et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Savoir-être

- Autonomie et capacité à prendre en main un sujet de bout en bout.
- Rigueur, notamment dans les phases d'essais.
- Polyvalence et goût du concret : vous aimez concevoir autant que tester vous-même vos équipements.
- Communication proactive, en particulier pour remonter et résoudre les difficultés rencontrées.
- Envie d'apprendre et de s'investir dans une petite structure.

Formation et expérience

- Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent Bac +5 en génie mécanique, conception, instrumentation ou mesures physiques.
- Expérience d'environ 5 ans en conception d'équipements, en bureau d'études ou en R&D. Les profils plus juniors avec une première expérience significative en conception seront étudiés.
- Une expérience sur des équipements soumis à des contraintes de température ou de pression est un vrai plus.
Benefits 

Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique.

description:

With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. 

At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. 

The Data & Automations Team

The Data & Automations team builds and operates Pigment's internal data platform, and designs, implements, and maintains the intelligent automation solutions that rely on it. Together, they streamline business processes and enhance data-driven decision making: we empower product, business and corporate functions through technology integration, robust data architecture, and process optimization, enabling teams to focus on high-value activities while ensuring accuracy and scalability.

The data platform is the foundation of everything we deliver. It is a centralized, governed ecosystem that collects, stores, transforms, and serves data to internal consumers across Product, Go-To-Market (GTM), and General & Administrative (G&A) functions, providing a single source of truth for analytics, automations, and AI. Making it reliable, secure, cost-efficient, and scalable is at the core of our mission. The team also consolidates and orchestrates AI efforts across Pigment, from governance and enablement to building AI-powered solutions.

Our team tackles diverse challenges, from integrating finance and HR systems and streamlining employee lifecycle processes, to building pipelines that turn product usage and customer interactions into actionable insights for Finance or GTM teams. AI is now at the center of most of what we do with data: many of our pipelines feed LLM-powered solutions, and the quality, structure, and governance of our data architecture directly determine what these solutions can deliver.

The team is led by Pigment's Deputy CISO and works closely with the Security team: security and data governance are part of how we build, not an afterthought.

Role

As a Junior Data and Automations Engineer, you will contribute to the continued development of Pigment's data platform: ingestion pipelines, dbt models, orchestration, data quality, and the underlying cloud infrastructure. You will also build and maintain the data pipelines, automations, and AI projects that support our G&A (Finance, People, IT) and GTM (Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships) teams.

You will work closely with senior engineers, starting with well-scoped tasks and progressively taking ownership of small projects end to end, from requirements gathering to production monitoring. This role involves collaborating with a wide range of internal stakeholders and requires excellent communication skills in English (primarily) and French, verbal and written.

Tech environment

Our core stack relies on Google Cloud Platform, maintained with Terraform, with components including BigQuery, Cloud Run, and Cloud Composer (Airflow), as well as dbt, Fivetran, Hightouch, Elementary for data observability, and Python for integrations and automations. Our pipelines connect business systems such as Salesforce, NetSuite, our HRIS, Gong, or Slack, and feed Pigment applications used by our own business teams. We also build LLM-powered pipelines and use AI tools in our daily engineering work.

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow your skills across these technologies while making a meaningful impact on Pigment's operational efficiency.

Under the supervision of the Data & Automations team's more senior members, you will participate in addressing the following topics.

Data Platform & Infrastructure: 

- Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from APIs, databases, and SaaS tools, using Fivetran, Airflow, and Python

- Build and maintain dbt models that turn raw data into clean, documented, and tested datasets

- Contribute to the evolution of our orchestration, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code setup

- Help improve data quality, observability, and alerting across the platform

- Build pipelines and integrations that sync data between business systems (CRM, ERP, HRIS) through our data warehouse, including reverse ETL with Hightouch

- Develop Python-based automations that remove manual work for teams such as Finance, People, IT, and Customer Success

- Prepare reliable datasets for reporting and for the Pigment applications used by business teams

AI Projects: 

- Contribute to AI-powered solutions, such as LLM pipelines that extract, classify, and enrich unstructured data (call transcripts, messages, tickets)

- Build the data foundations these projects rely on: AI-ready datasets, usage and observability data, evaluation data

- Apply data architecture principles that make our data reliable, well-documented, and safely accessible for AI use cases (context, retrieval, access scoping)

Monitoring & Support: 

- Monitor pipelines and automations, troubleshoot incidents, and fix root causes

- Document data models, pipelines, and processes for both technical and business readers

What you'll do

Automation Development: 

- Develop and maintain Python-based automations and solutions to streamline enterprise processes

- Implement integrations between various systems and applications using APIs and other connection methods

- Assist in maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automation projects

Data Integration & Transformation:

- Participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing sessions

Who you are

Technical skills

The ideal candidate will possess most or all of the following qualifications. Hands-on experience through personal projects (share your GitHub account!), particularly contributions to open source initiatives, will be valued equally to professional and academic experience for this role.

- Up to 3 years of relevant experience in data engineering, including apprenticeships, internships, and/or demonstrable personal projects

Soft skills

Nice to have

title: Senior Creative Designer
description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers. 

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role 

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Designer to join our Brand team in Paris. You’ll help build a brand that is understood, remembered and trusted, making a powerful product feel simple, human and desirable. As part of our creative team, you’ll shape Brevo’s visual identity, content and digital presence across every channel and market. We believe great design starts with great thinking, so we question the brief, look for the sharpest idea and make sure it holds across every touchpoint.

Your impact at Brevo 

- Contribute to the evolution of Brevo's visual identity and brand guidelines, ensuring consistency across every touchpoint, from paid ads to event signage.

- Design marketing and communication assets for product launches and campaigns, adapting concepts across channels, formats and markets (digital, social media, OOH, events, print).

- Produce social-first content, including video, motion and short-form, for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok and X, tailored to each platform's codes.

- Build content plans that combine organic, paid and evergreen content, then measure performance and keep improving.

- Translate complex product features into simple, engaging messages for different audiences and markets.

- Partner with Growth, Product, Sales and Leadership to align creative work with business objectives.

- Experiment with new formats and AI-powered creative tools, and bring what works into the team's workflow.

Who you are 

- Around 6 years of experience in creative, brand or content design, ideally in an agency, startup or SaaS/tech company, with a strong portfolio of brand, content and digital work.

- You think before you design: you take the time to understand the product, challenge briefs constructively and turn complex ideas into clear visual stories.

- You have a solid understanding of B2B communication, paid campaigns, social media best practices and storytelling.

- You’re comfortable with AI creative tools (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Claude…)

- You're fluent in Figma (mandatory, including design systems) Adobe suite.

- You're autonomous and organised, juggle several projects at once and take ownership from idea to execution.

- You communicate in professional English (C1 or above).

- Bonus points if you have B2C experience, speak French.

If you don't meet all the requirements above but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply! 

Why people love working at Brevo 

- A place to grow, together: Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.

- Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).

- Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.

- Flexible for life: A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.

- Wellbeing that works: Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform

- A culture that cares: From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You'll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

Our candidate journey 

- Introductory TA call (30 min)

- Meeting and Portfolio review with Rémi, Senior Brand & Com Director. (40 min)

- Creative case study (4–5 hours of work) and presentation (45 min)

- Final interview with our CMO (30 min)

- Reference check 

Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.
