title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. 

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions 

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role 

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites , ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required. 

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities: 

System operations & technical support 

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

- Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
- Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
- Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
- Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
- Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
- Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions 

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

- Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
- Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
- Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
- Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
- Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
- Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.
The role involves business travel within France and internationally , with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems. 

User training & technical guidance 

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

- Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
- Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
- Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
- Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement 

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

- Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
- Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
- Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
- Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
- Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements 

Education & experience

- Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
- The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities .
- Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
- Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
- Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required 

- Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
- Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
- Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
- Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
- Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
- Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
- Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
- Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken , as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
- Willingness and ability to travel internationally.
Nice to have

- Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics .
- Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
- Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
- Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python .
- Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
- Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.
Benefits 

- Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience 
- Profit-sharing & company savings plan
- 100% health coverage (Alan)
- 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
- Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
- Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer

- A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
- A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
- A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
- Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

title: Leiter Automatisierungstechnik Siemens TIA
description:
About EH Group Engineering 

EHG is developing cutting-edge fuel cell technology for heavy duty mobility and large-scale stationary power applications. Our uniquely redesigned product is a significantly more compact fuel cell with high power density and lower costs of production. Faced with the challenges of climate change and the transition to a decentralised energy system, EHG seeks to provide high performance and cost-effective fuel cell solutions to our clients and partners.

To help bring this vision to life, we are looking for a Senior Control Engineer to coordinate our efforts in designing control strategies for containerized systems integrating our fuel cell technology alongside equipment such as gas reformers, batteries, and climate control units. You will coordinate the control team and play a key role in shaping how these complex, multi-equipment systems operate safely and efficiently in the field. 

Based in the US? You’re welcome to apply. This is an on-site role in Nyon, Switzerland. We ask that you relocate within 3 months of starting, and we’ll support you with a relocation package.

Key Responsibilities: 

- Coordinate the control engineering activities and define the control architecture and technical roadmap for our fuel cell and containerized power systems

- Develop control strategies, models and algorithms for test-benches, fuel cell system and containerized power supply systems using Matlab/Simulink and Siemens PLCs

- Coordinate the transition of prototype control algorithms from Simulink to industrial-quality code in TIA Portal Step 7

- Implement, tune and validate controllers for thermal, air, fuel and power subsystems

- Define and own control requirements, state machines and safety/diagnostic logic

- Drive the continuous improvement (performance, efficiency and robustness) of our products

- Define and oversee model-in-the-loop (MIL) testing and validation procedures

- Manage the complete software life cycle, from requirements through release and maintenance, including dataset management

- Establish coding standards, conduct code reviews and ensure compliance with industrial and certification requirements

- Coordinate and develop the control team, including task planning and prioritization

- Act as the main control interface with embedded, test and electrical engineering, as well as external partners and suppliers

Skills and Experience Required: 

- BSc/MSc in control, electrical, mechatronic or automation engineering is mandatory

- Minimum 7 years of experience in control engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical lead or senior role

- Skill 1 : Strong experience in process control engineering, particularly with containerized power supply systems; knowledge of programming and implementing safety PLCs is a strong plus

- Skill 2 : Strong experience with TIA Portal (Step 7, WinCC, Test Suite), with the ability to structure code to industrial standards and meet certification requirements

- Experience with functional safety (e.g. IEC 61508, ISO 13849), including SIL/PL determination and implementation of safety functions

- Experience across the complete V-model development cycle, including hazard and risk assessment, requirements definition, safety requirements specification (SRS), verification and validation, and dataset management

- Experience with stationary and maritime power applications, with a focus on the US and EU markets and their respective standards and certification requirements

- Proven team player, with the ability to: 
(i) Coordinate and mentor the control team by clearly explaining your code and helping the team adopt robust industrial methods: you will take the responsibility in developing Skill 1 and Skill 2 across the team 
(ii) Collaborate effectively within interdisciplinary teams

- Solid knowledge of control theory, state machines and system identification

- Strong experience with MATLAB/Simulink and model-based design is a plus

- Professional working language is in English.

Start date: Immediately

title: Responsable Qualité Multi-Sites - Piles à Combustible
description:
About EHG 

EH Group (EHG) is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to AI data centers, defense, and industry. Our fuel-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems scale from kW-scale units to GW-scale power plants, and we design, manufacture, and deploy them for customers worldwide.

Founded in Switzerland, EHG is now expanding into the United States, fueled by exponential AI data center power demand and a soon-to-be-announced major investment round. This is a defining, high-growth chapter for the company.

The opportunity 

We're hiring a Quality Manager to own a single quality system across both of our production streams — our established MW-scale facility in Nyon, Switzerland and our new US operation in Houston, Texas.

You'd be based in Nyon, where our production and process knowledge sits today, and own quality for the US operation as it stands up. The requirement is explicit: quality must be identical at both sites. Same specifications, same control plans, same acceptance criteria, same records. A customer taking delivery of a system should not be able to tell which site built the stack inside it, and our certification and warranty position depends on being able to demonstrate that.

Our customers are data center operators, defense programs, and industrial sites where reliability is the product. In your first year you'd harmonize our quality management system across both entities, establish controls in Houston that match those proven in Nyon as manufacturing technology transfers, build supplier quality alongside Supply Chain for a shared global supply base, and support certification of our systems for both European and US markets.

Location & travel: Nyon-based. Regular travel to Houston is expected as the US operation stands up, along with travel to supplier and partner sites in Europe and the US.

What you'll own

title: Robotics Integration Engineer
description:
About Enact 

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role You Will 

- Design, integrate and test the electromechanical systems at the core of our dexterous robots: actuator modules, joints, and end-effectors, sensors, PCBs, and cable harnesses into compact, reliable units for high-DoF robotics

- Bring hardware to life: lead system assembly & bring-up, debug across mechanics, electronics, and firmware, and work with controls & AI engineers to build a fully vertically integrated manipulation system

- Develop & build automated test setups to validate performance, durability, and reliability, and take systems from prototype to series production

What We're Looking For 

- Degree (BSc/MSc/PhD) in mechatronics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or a related field

- 3+ years of work experience developing complex mechatronic systems that bridge mechanical design, electronics, and software

title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (Inference Stack Optimization)
description:
Why Kimchi?

Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and we run the models underneath it ourselves.

Kimchi Inference 

One API line and a customer's existing client just works: DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Nemotron served serverless from our own GPU fleet (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible, pay per token, spend visible per user, team, and key). When control matters, the same models run on the customer's own cluster instead. Behind that one line sits the machinery you'll own: SGLang and vLLM engines, B300 nodes, a shared cluster filesystem that holds every checkpoint exactly once, KV caches riding coding traffic with heavy prefix reuse, and the benchmark harness that gates every change we ship.

Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion. 

About the role

Throughput. Latency. Cold starts. Cost per token.

Move those four numbers in the right direction and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every loader you tune, every scheduler decision you land, every kernel you stare at shows up in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. Your mandate is the inference stack's optimization, whatever it takes, and the technical direction of how we optimize it is yours to argue with data.

The problem: the checkpoints run 0.3-1.5 TB, and the "right" serving configuration depends on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, and quantization tolerance, all variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a configuration once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. We don't: we took Kimi-K3 (1.5 TB) from over an hour cold-to-serving to under twelve minutes with a shared filesystem, O_DIRECT weight loaders, and node-local JIT caches, and we're nowhere near done. Prefill/decode disaggregation and tiered KV caches are next.

Stack: Python; SGLang; vLLM; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; fastsafetensors; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; virtiofs shared filesystems; ClickHouse; OpenTelemetry; Prometheus; Grafana; GitLab CI.

Requirements

- You've built real ML systems for 5+ years, and your portfolio shows depth in inference or training infrastructure, not just model training notebooks.

- Your Python is production-grade: services, not scripts.

- You've run vLLM, SGLang, or TensorRT-LLM for real, and you have a working mental model of why an engine performs the way it does on a given GPU.

- You've measured quantization regressions, not just compression ratios.

- Multi-GPU and multi-node setups hold no fear: tensor and expert parallelism, collective communication, and their practical failure modes.

- You know where the bytes live (page caches, O_DIRECT, network filesystems under terabyte-scale reads) and how fast they move.

- You instrument before you optimize, and you can tell a real win from a benchmark artifact.

- A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.

Nice to haves

- You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.

- Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.

- You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.

Responsibilities

- Push throughput. Continuous batching, chunked prefill, speculative decoding with draft models, CUDA-graph capture, and scheduler tuning across the engine
fleet. Find the ceiling on each GPU SKU, then raise it.

- Cut latency. Attack TTFT and inter-token latency separately; profile to find the actual bottleneck (compute, memory bandwidth, scheduling, storage, or
network) and fix it, not the one you assumed.

- Get more out of the KV cache. Hierarchical and paged attention, prefix caching on heavy-reuse coding traffic, eviction policies, quantized KV. A lot of the
unrealized throughput lives here, and you'll own it.

- Kill cold starts. Weight loaders (O_DIRECT, fastsafetensors-class), JIT and compile caches, shared-filesystem read paths. A 1.5 TB checkpoint has no business
taking an hour to reach serving.

- Quantize without regressing quality. INT8/INT4, FP8/FP4 across weights, activations, and KV, measured on real workloads, not just perplexity benchmarks.

- Scale across nodes. Distributed inference topologies, network-aware placement, prefill/decode disaggregation, checkpointing strategies that don't bottleneck
on storage or interconnect.

- Set the technical direction. Decide what we benchmark, what we adopt, and what we build ourselves. Bring the team along with strong writeups and reproducible
experiments.

title: Senior Applied ML Engineer | Kimchi (Model Router)
description:
Why Kimchi?

Great models are raw ingredients. Kimchi is what happens when you ferment them with good engineering. We started inside CAST AI helping companies run LLMs on their own Kubernetes clusters; today we run our own coding harness on any model you pick, and the router deciding which model answers each request is ours too.

The Auto Router 

Our promise is one enforcement layer for your AI: budgets, spend attribution, and model routing, applied before a request ever hits a model. The Auto Router makes the call: for every request, which model serves it. Eight open-source models whose input prices span more than 20×, cached input up to 50× cheaper than fresh, frontier providers on customers' own keys, and a coding agent that fires hundreds of requests before its task is done. Frontier-level task success at a fraction of the token cost: that sentence is the product, and it stays true only if the model inside the router keeps getting better. That model is yours.

Made by Cast AI — a Miami-headquartered, globally distributed team across 34 countries that hit unicorn status in January 2026 with a $50B+ backed investment pushing its valuation past $1 billion. 

About the role

Every request gets a decision: which model serves it.

This is an applied-ML seat, not an infrastructure one. Platform engineers own the proxy, the streaming path, and the fleet. You own the model inside them: the training data, the objective, the evaluation, and the iteration loop that ships a better router every cycle.

The problem: routing is a prediction problem wearing a product's clothes. For every request you predict the quality each candidate model would deliver, what it would cost, and how fast it would decode, and you have to be right enough, in aggregate, that the savings are real and the quality never dips below frontier. The data is messy: rollout outcomes from benchmark harnesses, per-request records from the live fleet, override signals, and token streams whose speed depends on the serving concurrency at the moment. Speed itself is a correctness variable: on deadline-bound agentic work, a model that decodes three times slower doesn't do the same work slower, it does less work. That's why naive cost-per-token objectives quietly optimize for the wrong thing. And the bar for evidence is high: a router change ships only after production-parity evaluation with error bars, then gets held to its numbers in live traffic.

Stack: Python; PyTorch; SQL at scale (ClickHouse); OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible LLM APIs; benchmark and rollout harnesses (RouterBench-class); GitLab CI.

Requirements

- You've spent 5+ years in applied ML or ML research, and you've trained, evaluated, and shipped models that make real-time decisions (ranking, recommendation, bandits, pricing, or LLM routing) and you can tell that story with receipts.

- Strong Python and SQL at scale: you can pull, clean, and interrogate millions of request-level records without waiting on anyone.

- You know the difference between a model that got better and an eval that got easier.

- You have real opinions about what LLM benchmarks measure, agentic harnesses included.

- You know enough serving reality (TTFT, decode speed, batching, prefix caching, concurrency) to model the objective honestly.

- You instrument before you optimize, error bars and all.

- A wide mandate excites you more than it unsettles you.

Nice to haves

- You've worked on LLM routing specifically: RouterBench-class evals, cost/quality/latency Pareto fronts.

- Calibration, abstention, or conformal methods in production decision systems.

- You've run online A/B loops with drift monitoring on a model that touches real money.

Responsibilities

- Own the routing model end to end: features, objective, training, calibration, and release cadence. Iterate it like a product, not a research artifact.

- Build the evaluation that gates every change: production-parity benchmarks, router-vs-router comparisons, holdouts by task family, error bars on pass rates.
Nothing ships on vibes.

- Turn fleet data into training signal: per-request outcomes from production, benchmark rollouts, and override feedback, with failure categorization (infra vs
task) so poisoned labels never reach the policy.

economics in the picture.

- Run the online loop: shadow, A/B, full rollout, drift monitoring, retrain. When production disagrees with your offline eval, you find out why before the next
ship.

- Push the frontier where it pays: calibrated decisions, abstention under uncertainty, speed-aware routing. We experiment on what a router should be, not just

title: Senior Employer Branding Specialist
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Our team’s mission is to align Vinted’s values, business goals, and Employer Value Proposition with our people’s real work experience. We translate Vinted’s truth into an inspiring story that attracts the right people, helps them grow, and instils them with pride.

You’ll take an active role in Employer Branding at Vinted, with a particular focus on attracting engineering and data science talent. You’ll be based in Amsterdam, where our data science team is growing, but your work will reach candidates around the world.

Vinted has become an ecosystem with vertically integrated shipping and payments. This requires us to adapt our EVP to three very distinct brands and even more diversified hiring needs. Your job is to turn that into creative campaigns and stories that make specific audiences want to work here.

Our next big focus is storytelling. Bringing the skills and challenges our teams face to life! What is a day in the life of a cybersecurity analyst? How does an anti-money laundering expert keep members’ wallets safe? What does it take to build the data science behind a marketplace used by millions? And what stories does each of our locations need?

Partnering with Talent Acquisition, engineering and data science leaders, People, Marketing, PR, Internal Comms, and Brand & Design, you’ll make sure those stories are told and that our presence is strong where we hire.

In this position, you’ll 

- Be the guardian of Vinted’s employer brand, ensuring consistency and visibility across all platforms, like LinkedIn and Instagram

- Strong brand-building skills, with a clear vision of global vs local branding differentiation

- Use your sound understanding of branding and our editorial guidelines to write clear and engaging copy for things such as blogs, advertising campaigns, employer branding assets, email campaigns, event materials, online company profiles, as well as our careers pages.

- Create bespoke or support partnership events such as meetups, webinars, and networking events

- Plan and run recruitment advertising, such as targeted LinkedIn campaigns and sponsorships with third-party publications and organisations, aimed at technical audiences.

- Define where our global employer brand ends and local adaptation begins, so each location can tell its story while staying consistent with Vinted’s.

- Shape our content calendar around hiring needs and our location strategy.

- Track what works, using results to sharpen the next activation, and share learnings with the wider Employer Branding team.

About you 

- Passionate about all things Employer Branding!

- You love storytelling: finding stories and having a keen eye for telling them in ways that stand out. You can show campaigns or activations you conceived and delivered.

- Background in building and nurturing online and offline communities, and delivering innovative events and social media campaigns.

- A clear view of global vs local branding, and experience working across markets.

- Adept at identifying new talent attraction channels, especially for engineering and data science audiences.

- Comfortable using data to set goals and judge what worked.

- Ability to juggle multiple projects with strong stakeholder management, and to work confidently with engineering and data science leaders.

- Excited by change, a fast pace, and learning new ways of doing things.

- Excellent knowledge of social media and digital channels, including LinkedIn, Glassdoor, Indeed, and Meta.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (English is Vinted’s official working language).

title: Senior Product Manager - Search & Ranking
description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car , a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton , Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe , we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.

- Taking ownership and driving impact 

- Being open to change and feedback

- Being passionate about our mission and our customers. 

Your mission 

Every Product Manager at Catawiki owns a meaningful part of the customer experience.

In Search and Ranking, your mission is to help buyers find the special objects they care about. You will shape how search, ranking and personalisation work across the buyer journey, making discovery more relevant and helping more buyers find objects they love.

This is a broad product area. It brings together buyer needs, expert curation, marketplace priorities, search experiences and machine learning. You will identify the most important opportunities, set a clear direction and lead a cross functional team from insight to measurable customer and business impact.

The solution is not prescribed. You may improve search relevance, ranking, recommendations or personalisation, or explore new AI enabled ways to help buyers discover objects. What matters is that you solve a meaningful customer problem, measure the impact and scale what works.

You will own the strategy, outcomes and execution for this area, working closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Marketing and Commercial teams.

What you will do 

- Set and communicate a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for Search and Ranking.

- Own measurable outcomes across search relevance, discovery, engagement and buyer conversion.

- Use behavioural data, customer research and commercial insight to identify and prioritise the biggest opportunities.

- Turn ambiguous customer and business problems into clear hypotheses, prototypes and executable plans.

- Lead initiatives from early discovery through experimentation, launch and scaling.

- Define success metrics and build a rigorous experimentation agenda for search, ranking and personalisation.

- Work with machine learning engineers and data scientists to assess model quality, test new approaches and improve customer outcomes.

- Improve the relevance of search results and recommendations across the buyer journey.

- Integrate personalisation into the customer experience in ways that feel useful, coherent and trustworthy.

- Design, run and evaluate experiments, using positive, negative and inconclusive results to guide decisions.

- Use AI and rapid prototyping to test ideas early, reduce development risk and accelerate learning.

- Create clarity, momentum and accountability across teams, including when priorities or incentives differ.

- Communicate strategy, performance, tradeoffs and recommendations clearly to senior and C level stakeholders.

Who you are 

Three qualities matter most in this role.

Outcome ownership 

You take responsibility for customer and business results, not only for delivering features. You stay with the problem, remove obstacles and change direction when the evidence calls for it.

Systems thinking 

You understand how search, ranking, recommendations, auction dynamics, expert curation and marketplace health influence one another. You make thoughtful decisions across the full buyer journey.

Experimental rigour 

You use data, research, prototypes and controlled experiments to make decisions. You learn from negative results and can distinguish meaningful progress from activity.

You will also bring:

- At least five years of product management experience, preferably in consumer ecommerce, marketplaces or another digital product at scale.

- Experience owning a broad product area or customer journey, rather than only individual features.

- Experience defining product strategy or roadmaps for search, ranking, recommendations, personalisation or other machine learning products.

- Confidence working with product metrics, experiments and commercial performance.

- Experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests, including tests involving machine learning products.

- The ability to turn uncertain opportunities into clear hypotheses, prototypes and plans.

- A practical understanding of machine learning concepts and how models become useful product experiences.

- Experience working closely with machine learning engineers and data scientists to develop and improve customer facing features.

- Comfort using AI tools to prototype quickly and explore customer experiences.

- The ability to balance immediate commercial opportunities with longer term product and platform investments.

- Clear communication skills and the ability to influence senior leaders without relying on formal authority.

- The pace, resilience and judgement to maintain a high standard of execution in an ambiguous environment.

Where you will be 

This role is based in Amsterdam. We offer a relocation package for people currently living outside the Netherlands.

Why You'll Love Working with Us 

- Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.

- Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.

- A culture of connection defines us . We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.

- Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion ” . We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.

Our Offices and Way of Working 

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested? 

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support the review of your application. AI may help us assess how your experience matches the requirements of the role, but hiring decisions are always made by our recruitment team

title: Manager Operations Planning & Performance
description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen. Daarvoor moet elke schakel in onze operatie, van warehouse tot voordeur, dagelijks naadloos op elkaar aansluiten. Als Manager Operations Planning & Performance ben jij de spil tussen wat de klant bestelt en hoe wij dat logistiek waarmaken. Je brengt alle operationele schakels samen in één strakke, integrale planning en bouwt mee aan een betrouwbare operatie die klaar is om slim door te groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Je bent eigenaar van de integrale operationele planning. Je vertaalt verwachte klantvraag naar concrete capaciteit op de weg (hoeveel bezorgers hebben we per dag en per hub nodig?) en bepaalt samen met de Operations Manager de planningsstrategie voor de korte en middellange termijn. Je zorgt voor een strakke planning tussen Delivery, Retentie en Warehouse. Zo werkt iedereen vanuit dezelfde basis en tilt jouw scherpe blik onze processen naar een hoger niveau.

- Je geeft leiding aan een team van routeplanners (werkstudenten en starters). Samen zorgen jullie dagelijks voor de meest efficiënte bezorgroutes. Jouw team staat in direct contact met de bezorghubs, het warehouse en de growth afdeling om de capaciteit af te stemmen

- Je werkt nauw samen met teams door de hele organisatie, van Tech en Analytics tot Recruitment. Om te weten wat er speelt, ben je regelmatig te vinden waar het gebeurt: op onze bezorghubs en in het warehouse.

- Je stuurt op operationele KPI’s (zoals Drops per Hour en Time per Stop ) en beheert belangrijke kostenlijnen. Samen met de Regiomanager en Business Analyst Delivery blijf je ons bezorgnetwerk continu optimaliseren.

- Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de lijn tussen ons warehouse en de hubs. Je onderhoudt de contacten met vrachtwagenvervoerders, stuurt op prestaties ( On Time ) en kosten ( Cost per Drop ) en maximaliseert de vulgraad.

- Je kijkt altijd naar wat beter kan, houdt trends en innovaties in de markt in de gaten en draagt dit actief aan wanneer je hier kansen ziet. Je signaleert kansen in de operatie, maakt de impact inzichtelijk en leidt verbeterprojecten van idee tot implementatie, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van servicetijd, automatisering van planningstaken of de inrichting van ons netwerk.

- Je bent onderdeel van het Delivery team en rapporteert aan de Head of Delivery.

Dit ben jij

- Je hebt HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in operationele planning, logistiek of supply chain, bij voorkeur in een snelgroeiende e-commerce- of retailomgeving.

- Je beweegt je makkelijk door de hele organisatie, van de vloer tot het management. Je zoekt actief de samenwerking op en krijgt verschillende teams moeiteloos op één lijn. Je creëert draagvlak en krijgt mensen mee in een gezamenlijke aanpak, ook als je geen formele zeggenschap over ze hebt

- Je bent sterk met data. Je duikt zelf in de cijfers, bouwt een model of dashboard als dat nodig is, en vertaalt analyses naar concrete keuzes voor de operatie. Ervaring met SQL, BigQuery en Data Studio is een pré.

- Jij kijkt verder dan je eigen scope en overziet de hele keten. Je begrijpt hoe een keuze in de planning doorwerkt in het warehouse, op de weg en bij de klant, en je weet de juiste balans te vinden tussen kosten en kwaliteit.

- Je bent resultaatgericht en weet wat het is om eigenaarschap te nemen. Jij maakt dingen graag makkelijk en concreet. Complexe vraagstukken zet jij gemakkelijk om naar begrijpelijke acties.

- Je houdt het hoofd koel als het even spannend wordt. Pieken, onverwachte uitval of last-minute wijzigingen brengen je niet van je stuk; je prioriteert, plant opnieuw en zorgt dat de operatie doordraait.

- Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Wat wij bieden

- En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

title: Project Leider Bouw
description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. 

Over de functie 

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. 

We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.

De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team.

Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.

Wat je gaat doen 

- De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.

- Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers.

- Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge.

- Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk.

- Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren.

- Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators.

Wat we zoeken 

- Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder.

- Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.

- Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

- Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.

- Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren.

- Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen.

- Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf.

- Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert.

- Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.

Waarom Monumental? 

Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je.

title: Team Lead, Data Engineering
description:
We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper.

Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us.

This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team . You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.

We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What your team owns

The Data Platform team works across three areas:

- Data Platform : reliable, scalable infrastructure that gets the right data to the right place

- Internal Analytics : a self-service platform so every team can be data-informed without a ticket

- Customer-facing Analytics : the dashboards and exports customers use to see the value they get from DataSnipper

Concretely, you would be walking into billions of usage events flowing from our Excel Add-in, web apps and product backends through Azure Event Hubs into Snowflake ; a dbt estate built on medallion principles and managed in dbt Cloud ; Terraform-managed Snowflake and Azure infrastructure; and a set of product teams shipping AI agents faster than we can instrument them .

You will also find real, named open problems rather than a tidy platform: event capture mid-consolidation, multiple methods of user attribution, and a data quality layer that is designed but not yet built. We would rather tell you that up front.

What you will do

Lead the team

- Lead a team of two data engineers through outcomes, not tasks : set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how

- Make the team measurably better: raise the engineering bar, grow each engineer into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise

What you bring

How you work

Preferred qualifications

title: BDR Talent Programme (Amsterdam)
description:
Company Description 

We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 

We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. 

About the Programme 

This is a structured 18–24 month global programme designed to launch high-potential commercial careers. You don’t need prior sales or payments experience; what you need is ambition, curiosity, resilience, and the drive to build relationships and solve complex problems.

You will join a global cohort of Business Development Representatives (BDRs) with structured learning, dedicated coaching from sales leaders, and real commercial responsibility from month one. Throughout the programme, you will master enterprise sales: researching strategic accounts, engaging senior decision-makers, conducting sharp discovery conversations, and building pipeline that drives real business growth.

High performers transition into Sales, Account Management, and other commercial roles across the business. Many of our top commercial leaders, including our Chief Revenue Officer, started their journey at Checkout.com as BDRs or interns. Whether you are a recent graduate, an early-career professional with 1–3 years of experience, or a career switcher, what matters most is your hunger to learn and achieve.

What You’ll Do 

- Research Strategic Accounts: Identify high-value targets by researching key organizations, industries, and executive stakeholders.

- Initiate High-Impact Outreach: Open doors with senior decision-makers using personalized outreach across email, phone, and LinkedIn.

- Build Qualified Pipeline: Drive consistent growth momentum through disciplined prospecting, rigorous follow-up, and account mapping.

- Run Consultative Discovery: Uncover merchants' technical and business challenges to align Checkout.com ’s solutions with their goals.

- Partner on Live Deals: Work alongside Sales Representatives to support opportunities through to deal execution.

- Leverage AI & Modern Tech: Use CRM, intent data, and approved AI tools to streamline research, refine outreach, and work smarter.

Who We’re Looking For 

We welcome applications from recent graduates and professionals with 1–3 years of experience looking to change careers. Regardless of your background, we are looking for the following core skills to set you up for success:

- Driven & Goal-Oriented: You set high personal standards, work hard, and stay motivated when tackling challenging commercial goals.

- Resilient & Adaptable: You bounce back quickly from rejection, view obstacles as practice, and maintain consistent output.

- Relational & Engaging: You genuinely enjoy starting conversations, asking sharp questions, and building trust with diverse stakeholders.

- Track Record of Achievement: You demonstrate drive and ownership through professional, academic, athletic, or entrepreneurial success.

- Commercial & Tech Curiosity: You are eager to learn complex fintech products and use AI and sales tools to work smarter.

- Coachability & Clear Communication: You listen well, articulate ideas clearly, and actively apply feedback to improve performance.

What You’ll Get Out of It 

A 2-year structured programme that ensures you have a successful career in sales. A clear progression pathway built around key pillars:

- Fintech & Enterprise Sales Mastery: Build deep expertise in global payments, digital commerce, and complex deal execution alongside experienced Account Executives.

- AI-Native Commercial Skills: Master modern sales tools, intent data, and AI to automate routine tasks and focus on high-impact prospecting.

- Coaching & Leadership Growth: Receive 1:1 mentorship from sales leaders, earn certifications, and take on senior BDR responsibilities, from mentoring peers to working on live deals through pricing and signing

- Direct Career Acceleration: Graduate with a tight-knit global network and a direct pathway into Account Executive, Account Management, or Commercial Strategy roles.

Want to Stand Out? 

When we review your CV, ensure you show us why you're great for this role. Ensure and share something you’ve built, led or achieved, whether that’s hitting a target, launching a side project, or leading a team effort.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 

- Who should apply? Recent graduates, early-career professionals (1–3 years experience), and career changers with strong commercial drive.

- When does the programme start? We have start dates in March and September 2027.

- What is the application deadline? Apply early for the best chance of being reviewed. We will close once we receive a sufficient number of applications.

- Where are the roles located? We have roles in London, New York, Barcelona, Amsterdam, Riyadh, Dubai, and Shanghai.

- Do I need a second language? Fluent English is required. Specific local language proficiency may be required depending on the hiring region.

Additional Information 

Bring all of you to work 

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com 

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com , follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Essential Experience

Desirable Experience

- Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.

Mindset

title: Senior Technical SEO Specialist
description:
Who We Are

VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

About the role 

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do 

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.

- Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.

- Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.

- Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.

- Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.

- Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.

- Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.

- Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.

- Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.

- Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for 

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of: 

- HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.

- HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.

- JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.

- Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.

- Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.

- txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.

- Structured data and Schema.org.

- Core Web Vitals and web performance.

- International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.

- Website and platform migrations.

- Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

- Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.

- Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.

- Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.

- Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.

- Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.

- Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.

- Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.

Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.

What you'll need: 

- 10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.

- Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.

- Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.

- Strong experience working with l arge and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.

- Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.

- A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.

- Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.

- An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.

- Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.

What we offer: 

We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. 

Our compensation: 

- A gross annual salary range of 80,000€ - 95,000€, based on experience level.

- Access to learning platforms .

- Wellbeing initiatives including mental health support programs and wellness activities. 

- Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. 

- Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops. 

- At WPP ES, we believe in investing in people who build long-term value for our clients and their customers. Your growth is part of our growth. 

About WPP 

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. title: Process Automation Engineer
description:
Functieprofiel 

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.

Wat ga jij doen! 

In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

- Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

- Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

- Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

- Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

- Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

- Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

- Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

- Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

Wat wij vragen! 

- Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

- Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

- Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in procesautomatisering

- Hands‑on ervaring met Siemens Step7 / TIA Portal / WinCC

- Ervaring met ProLeiT Plant.iT 

- Bij voorkeur ervaring met OPC UA en AVEVA PI

- De bereidheid om jezelf én de organisatie continu te blijven ontwikkelen

Wat bieden wij jou! 

Werken bij NX Filtration biedt je de kans om samen met een gedreven en enthousiast team een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan de professionalisering en groei van de organisatie. Je werkt in een open en informele omgeving met zeer korte communicatielijnen, waarin eigen initiatief wordt gestimuleerd.

Het betreft een zelfstandige functie binnen een snelgroeiende, dynamische organisatie in een internationale setting, waar je volop ruimte krijgt om jezelf te ontwikkelen – zowel persoonlijk als in je loopbaanambities.

Daarnaast:

- Alle processen zijn volledig geautomatiseerd met ProLeiT 

- Volledige data‑integratie ten behoeve van diepgaande procesanalyses

- Mogelijkheden voor remote support

title: Senior interim manager in de zorg in loondienst
description:
Ben jij een ervaren leider die energie krijgt van het aanbrengen van structuur in uitdagende situaties? Hou je ervan om orde op zaken te stellen en daarna door te gaan naar de volgende interne opdracht? Wat ga je doen? 
Als interim manager word je ingezet op locaties van Cordaan waar extra leiderschap en verandering nodig zijn. Dit betekent dat je tijdelijke projectmatige opdrachten uitvoert in de organisatie, waar je snel schakelt, structuur aanbrengt en teams in crisis helpt stabiliseren. Je start elke opdracht met het maken van een projectplan en zorgt dat dit succesvol wordt uitgevoerd. Je zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers optimaal kunnen functioneren en kwalitatieve zorg kunnen bieden. 

Jouw belangrijkste taken: 

- Leidinggeven in complexe situaties: Je biedt duidelijkheid, hakt knopen door en creëert een veilige en gestructureerde werkomgeving. 

- Verandermanagement: Je begeleidt afdelingen in transitie en zorgt voor blijvende verbeteringen in zorgkwaliteit en teamdynamiek. 

- Bedrijfsvoering op orde brengen: Je monitort en rapporteert maandelijks over financiën, medewerkerstevredenheid en verloop. 

- Samenwerking versterken: Je betrekt vrijwilligers, mantelzorgers en familieleden bij het welzijn van cliënten. 

- Coachen en inspireren: Je helpt de collega’s op de locatie groeien, zodat zij hun werk met plezier en vertrouwen kunnen doen. 

Wat krijg je van ons? 
Bij Cordaan krijg je de kans om impact te maken binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener en zorgwerkgever van Amsterdam te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform cao VVT: 

- Een jaarcontract ( 32 - 36 uur per week ) met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband; 

- Salaris conform CAO VVT FWG 60: min. € 4.157 en max. € 6.171 bruto (o.b.v. 36 uur per week); 

- Extra’s : Eindejaarsuitkering (8,33%) en vakantiegeld (8%); 

- Reiskosten: een vergoeding á € 0,21 per km en een fietsplan; 

- Pensioenopbouw via Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn; 

- Ontwikkelmogelijkheden : Volop mogelijkheden om je persoonlijk en professioneel te ontwikkelen; 

- Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van € 500,- netto.

Wie ben jij? 
Jij bent een manager met een sterke persoonlijkheid en ruime ervaring in crisis- en verandermanagement in de zorg. Je kan projectmatig werken en weet hoe je teams motiveert en veranderingen succesvol implementeert. 

Verder heb je: 

- Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als leidinggevende; 

- Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in zorgmanagement, bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting én een aanvullende cursus of opleiding gevolgd op het gebied van verander- en/of crisismanagement;

- Aantoonbare beheersing van minimaal 3 van de volgende competenties (blijkend uit recente talentenscan of 360⁰ feedback): resultaatgerichtheid, visie, verandermanagement en beïnvloedingskracht. 

Waar ga je werken? 
Als interim manager kun je ingezet worden binnen een van de verschillende zorgdomeinen van Cordaan in Amsterdam in de ouderenzorg, Jeugd, GGZ en gehandicaptenzorg. Je wordt flexibel ingezet op locaties waar tijdelijke versterking nodig is, zodat jij impact kunt maken waar het écht telt.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
As Optics11 continues to grow, we are looking for a Senior Mechanical Engineer – Hardware Design to take ownership of the mechanical hardware development of high-performance fiber-optic measurement systems used in demanding energy and marine environments.

At Optics11, we develop cutting-edge fiber-optic sensing solutions that make critical infrastructure and underwater security systems smarter, safer, and more reliable. 

In this role, you will design ruggedized chassis, enclosures, and mechanical assemblies that protect and integrate electronic, photonic, fiber-optic, and electromechanical subsystems. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams and external partners to develop robust, manufacturable, and serviceable hardware solutions that support integration, qualification, manufacturing, and long-term operation.

You will apply structured engineering methods, sound technical judgement, and rigorous verification practices to ensure products perform reliably under vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and other environmental conditions.

What you'll do: 

- Lead the mechanical design and development of chassis, enclosures, mounting structures, and assemblies for fiber-optic measurement systems, from concept through qualification and release.

- Collaborate with electronics, photonics, optical, and systems engineering teams to define PCB placement, optical component integration, fiber routing, interconnections, thermal interfaces, and packaging constraints.

- Design robust hardware solutions that meet vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, environmental, serviceability, and lifecycle requirements for energy and marine applications.

- Develop modular, maintainable, and upgradeable hardware architectures that support manufacturability, serviceability, and long-term product support.

- Create and maintain engineering documentation, including drawings, specifications, design calculations, assembly instructions, and manufacturing documentation.

- Manage technical collaboration with suppliers, manufacturers, OEMs, and external development partners to ensure performance, quality, manufacturability, and qualification requirements are met.

- Support prototype development, subsystem integration, environmental and mechanical testing, product qualification, and release activities.

- Analyze test results, performance margins, failure modes, and operational limits to improve product robustness, reliability, and design maturity.

- Apply engineering analyses, trade-off studies, DfMA principles, simulation tools, and FEA to optimize mechanical, thermal, structural, dynamic, manufacturability, lifecycle, and cost performance.

- Investigate qualification failures, manufacturing issues, integration challenges, and field performance topics using structured problem-solving and root cause analysis.

- Provide technical input during design reviews, engineering discussions, development decisions, and cross-functional integration activities.

- Plan and execute work in line with priorities, milestones, quality expectations, and timelines, while proactively communicating risks, dependencies, and recommendations.

- Share expertise, lessons learned, and best practices to strengthen team capability, collaboration, product quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

Why Join Us? 

- Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

- Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

- Fresh team lunches provided3 times/ week.

Qualifications: 

- MSc in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline with a focus on mechanical design of opto-electronic, electronic, photonic, or other high-tech hardware products.

- 5+ years of experience in multidisciplinary product development environments.

- Strong experience designing chassis, enclosures, hardware packaging solutions, and mechanical assemblies for high-performance products.

- Proven track record in developing ruggedized opto-electronic hardware products from concept through qualification and release.

- Strong understanding of vibration, shock, thermal, EMC, ingress protection, and environmental requirements for demanding operational environments.

- Experience with 3D CAD tools such as SolidWorks, Creo, NX, or similar.

- Experience creating engineering drawings, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.

- Strong analytical mindset with experience in structured problem solving and engineering verification.

- Strong communication skills in English and collaborative working style.

- Eligible for EU/NATO security clearance.

Nice to have: 

- Experience with fiber-optic integration, optical component packaging, or photonic hardware development.

- Experience with CE/FCC, MIL, NATO, and/or STANAG qualification standards.

- Experience with ruggedized chassis standards used in defense, marine, aerospace, or industrial applications (e.g. VPX, CompactPCI, uTCA).

- Experience managing external suppliers, manufacturers, and development partners.

- Experience supporting environmental qualification, certification, or product compliance programs.
