title: Senior Engagement Manager
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

Engagement Management is a new and fast-growing practice at ClickUp, and it's quickly becoming central to how we serve our enterprise customers. Our EMs bring program leadership, service delivery and change management together in one role. As a ClickUp Senior Engagement Manager you will lead the formation and orchestration of post-sale strategy and execution for the company’s largest and most strategic clients. We're looking for someone hungry, who excels in building, and who takes genuine pride in the quality of their work.

Here, Engagement Managers are the single point of accountability for outcomes. You own everything between the contract being signed and the client seeing measurable results: what was sold gets delivered, on time and on margin, and we can prove it worked.

You'll lead enterprise SaaS implementations across the full engagement lifecycle, from shaping scope in pre-sales, mobilizing the team and delivery, go-live, stabilization and a clean handover to the account team. You'll run work-stream programs with Paid TAMs, AI specialists, Product and Engineering, and the client's own project team, and you'll be the trusted advisor to the client's executive sponsor.

Simply put: you are the single point of accountability for delivery, the client's partner in getting value from ClickUp, and a thought leader for how we deliver.

Your role

- Stakeholder Management 

- Serve as the primary client contact for delivery

- Build strong relationships with stakeholders while ensuring delivery remains aligned to client objectives and contractual commitments.

- Build trusted relationships with client executive sponsors and program leads at VP and C-level, acting as their primary point of contact for delivery.

- Navigate complex enterprise stakeholder environments and competing priorities across client functions (IT, PMO, business sponsors, procurement) and broker alignment when they conflict.

- Project Delivery Oversight 

- Deliver engagements against agreed scope, schedule, hours budget and quality, using rigorous change control to protect timelines and delivery margin.

- Translate customer business requirements into internal deliverables and milestones

- Own engagement governance, including kickoffs, weekly working sessions, sponsor check-ins and SteerCos, and provide clear, concise status reporting to clients and internal stakeholders.

- Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable and high-performing delivery culture while providing coaching, direction and support.

- Proactively manage risks, issues and dependencies through the RAID log, and act as the primary escalation point.

- Manage engagement financials, including hours burn, forecasting, utilisation and margin, flagging overrun risk early and agreeing recovery plans.

- Drive AI adoption 

- Guide clients from manual workflows to AI-assisted and agent-driven operations, and own post-go-live adoption outcomes.

- Drive Value and Business Outcomes 

- Identify expansion opportunities through delivery and co-sell with Account Executives, bringing the delivery credibility that secures follow-on work.

- Establish a value baseline before configuration begins, track benefits through go-live, and produce the value assessment that underpins renewal and expansion.

- Governance 

- Design and run governance mechanisms

- Track delivery efficacy, timelines, value realization and customer experience

- Create continuous-improvement mechanisms

- Change Management & Communication 

- Own communications around delivery status, risks and outcomes

- Manage escalation and communication across customer/internal teams

- Assess change readiness and resistance across impacted teams; build sponsor and champion networks to carry the rollout.

- Design the communications and enablement plan with the client, and sequence go-live to match the organization's capacity for change.

- Role Development 

- Contribute to building the Engagement Management practice by iterating on templates, playbooks and AI workflows that make every engagement faster and more consistent.

Your skills and experience

- 5+ years of software and/or services delivery experience, with at least 2 years as the accountable project, program or engagement lead.

- Proven track record taking enterprise SaaS deployments from kickoff through go-live and into adoption, ideally in work management, PSA, CRM, ITSM or collaboration platforms.

- Strong grasp of SaaS implementation fundamentals: workspace and data architecture, permissions and SSO, integrations, data migration, change management and enablement. No coding required, but you can challenge an unrealistic technical scope.

- Comfortable with Agile, Waterfall and hybrid delivery, and knowing which one the client actually needs.

- Commercial acumen: you've managed engagement budgets, SoWs, change requests and margin, and you know when to push for expansion vs when to stabilize.

- Executive presence: you can run a SteerCo, deliver bad news early with a recovery plan, and hold a line on scope with a CIO in the room.

- Experience leading cross-functional and distributed teams you don't directly manage, across client, partner and internal resources.

- Strategic judgment to separate genuine product gaps from client process or training gaps.

- Hands-on with AI: you already use AI to work faster, and you can credibly advise clients on where agents and automation fit.

- Excellent written and verbal communication. Status reports people actually read.

Nice to have: Experience in work management or SaaS software, professional services firms, agencies or regulated industries. PMP Certification.

What you'll love about working here

- Impact: Lead high-visibility enterprise engagements with global brands, and see the result in their day-to-day work.

- Build something: Engagement Management is a new function. You'll help define the methodology, tooling and AI workflows that become the standard.

- AI at the centre: Work on the frontier of AI-driven work management, with ClickUp Brain and Super Agents in your own delivery toolkit.

- Career growth: A clear path from Engagement Manager to Senior or Principal Engagement Manager.

- Community: Learn alongside Paid TAMs, AI specialists and delivery leaders across EMEA and NA.

title: Senior Architect (all genders)

In unseren agilen Teams setzt du neue Maßstäbe und feierst gemeinsam echte Erfolge. Seit 1992 stehen unsere kreativen Lösungen und maßgeschneiderten Strategien für digitale Exzellenz. Mit über 140 engagierten Mitarbeiter*innen gestalten wir User Experiences, die nicht nur zuverlässig funktionieren, sondern auch nachhaltig begeistern – von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.

Dein Impact bei uns

Als Senior Architect (all genders) entwirfst du Software- und Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe digitale Vorhaben. Du machst Entscheidungen verständlich, prüfst wichtige Annahmen praktisch und bleibst bis zur Umsetzung eng mit den Engineering-Teams verbunden.

- Architecture Impact: Du entwirfst umsetzbare Architekturen für Webplattformen, digitale Services, APIs und Integrationen mit passenden CMS- und Cloud-Bausteinen.

- Business Impact: Du bewertest Lösungswege nach Kundennutzen, Machbarkeit, Sicherheit, Betrieb und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

- Delivery Impact: Du prüfst kritische Annahmen durch Prototypen oder Code-Reviews und begleitest Architekturentscheidungen bis in die Umsetzung.

- Ownership & Communication: Du dokumentierst wichtige Entscheidungen, erklärst Zielkonflikte und machst Risiken und Abhängigkeiten transparent.

- Growth & Capability: Du entwickelst Architekturwissen und Standards im Team weiter und gibst Engineers durch Reviews und Mentoring Orientierung.

Darum du

- Du hast digitale Plattformen oder Services über mehrere Projektphasen hinweg als Engineer und Architect verantwortet.

- Du kannst in einem modernen Backend- oder Frontend-Stack selbst entwickeln. Java/Spring Boot, Kotlin, Node.js sowie TypeScript mit Vue/Nuxt, React oder Angular passen zu uns; der konkrete Stack ist nicht entscheidend.

- Du beherrschst API- und Integrationsdesign, Datenmodellierung sowie die Grundlagen skalierbarer und wartbarer Systeme.

- Du kennst Cloud-Umgebungen wie AWS oder Azure und hast praktische Erfahrung mit CI/CD und Containern.

- Du kannst Architekturentscheidungen verständlich erklären, Zielkonflikte moderieren und wichtige Annahmen mit dem Team praktisch prüfen.

- Du gibst Engineers Orientierung und unterstützt technische Konzeption und Aufwandsschätzungen.

- Du kennst KI-gestützte Entwicklung mit Coding Agents aus der Praxis und kannst sinnvolle Workflows sowie Regeln für Qualität und Sicherheit mitgestalten.

- Du kommunizierst fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch.

- Du wohnst in München oder im Einzugsgebiet und kannst bei Bedarf kurzfristig ins Büro kommen. Eine feste Büroquote gibt es nicht.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer | Java / React (f/m/d)
description:
Become a Part of ACCURIDS

Join us and help shape the future of pharmaceutical data!

At ACCURIDS, we’re building the data backbone behind life-science innovation — a system that identifies, links, and standardizes critical enterprise data in compliance with global standards such as ISO IDMP. We help global life-science companies launch products faster, more safely, and with better patient outcomes.

At ACCURIDS, you’ll join a collaborative, growth-driven environment where your work makes a real impact from day one.

As a key member of our Product Development team, you will operate with a high degree of autonomy while collaborating closely with backend and frontend engineers, QA, DevOps, and product owners. In this role, you will directly align with cross-functional engineering stakeholders and indirectly impact our customers through the features and fixes you deliver, while having direct access to our CTO as a trusted mentor and technical sparring partner

How you’ll make an impact:

- Own features end-to-end: Take full ownership of user-facing features across the stack, from refining business logic in modern Java/Spring Boot to building responsive React/TypeScript interfaces via GraphQL and REST APIs.

- Amplify velocity with AI: Lead by example in our AI-native engineering culture. You will use tools like Cursor, Claude, or Gemini to accelerate scaffolding, refactoring, and test writing, while acting as the ultimate authority on architectural integrity, security, and quality. As agents take on more of the routine coding, your leverage moves up a level - you direct them, shape the architecture, and own the quality of what ships.

- Shape next-gen architecture: Drive our evolution toward a multi-module Spring Modulith architecture, optimize complex PostgreSQL and Elasticsearch queries, and dive into domain-specific RDF semantic data structures.

- Elevate quality & team standards: Raise the bar on engineering hygiene by maintaining rigorous test coverage (JUnit, Testcontainers, Playwright), conducting sharp merge request reviews (including AI-generated code), and mentoring junior engineers.

What helps you succeed:

- Proven SaaS Experience: 5+ years of shipping and owning full-stack features in production software. A degree in Computer Science, Fachinformatiker training, or strong hands-on experience as a career-changer are all welcome.

- AI-Native Mindset: AI tools (Cursor, Claude and Gemini) are an integral part of your daily workflow. You view AI as an output amplifier, combine high curiosity with deep technical judgment, and reject skepticism toward AI-assisted coding.

- Location & Work Permit: You are based in Germany within a reasonable commuting distance to our Cologne office (NRW) and hold a valid German work permit.

- Full-Stack Core Stack: Deep expertise in modern Java (17+), the Spring Boot ecosystem (Spring Security, Spring Data JPA), React 18, TypeScript, Redux, and GraphQL (Apollo Client).

- Data & Testing Rigor: Strong hands-on experience with SQL/PostgreSQL, Flyway migrations, full-stack testing (Unit, Integration, E2E), and GitLab CI/CD pipelines.

- Languages: Business fluent English is required; German skills are a strong plus.

- Bonus Impact: Prior experience with semantic web tools (RDF, SPARQL, Apache Jena), Material UI (MUI 5), Elasticsearch, or pharma/life-sciences domains (FHIR, IDMP) is a major plus.

Why you’ll love working here:

- Impactful Career Growth: Evolve into a Technical Lead / Lead Engineer role or deepen your specialization in semantic data platforms, AI features, or platform architecture as we scale.

- Epic Office & Hybrid Work: Work from our brand-new office in the KölnTurm, featuring breathtaking views over the city (even higher than the view from the Cologne Cathedral!). Enjoy flexible hybrid options. (Note: On-site presence in Cologne/NRW is required; fully remote work is not offered).

- Community & Industry Events: Connect and grow your network through exclusive industry events hosted regularly right in our scenic office space.

- Competitive Compensation: Fixed salary package of €75,000 – €100,000 per year for a full-time, permanent position.

- Work-Life Balance & Perks: 30 days of paid vacation, a personal learning budget, hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux, Windows), and your choice between a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a €50/month City Plus Card.

- Empowered Culture: High trust, flat hierarchies, and an environment where your decisions directly shape the product.

Not ticking every box?

Not ticking every box? We encourage you to apply anyway! We know great talent doesn’t always follow a checklist and we care more about your potential, curiosity, and motivation to learn.

At ACCURIDS, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented backgrounds in tech, science, and data to apply.

Wir sind Finanzcheck – der Online-Kreditvergleich und Go-To-Place für Kredite in Deutschland. Wir gestalten den digitalen Kreditmarkt der Zukunft und wurden 2022 als Kununu Top Arbeitgeber ausgezeichnet. Werde jetzt Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte! 

Zur Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams mit knapp 100 Finanzprofis suchen wir dich ab sofort in Vollzeit als:

Quereinsteiger Kreditvertrieb Hamburg (w/m/d) 

So sieht dein Team aus: 

Gemeinsam mit deinen zukünftigen Kolleg*innen berätst du unsere Kund*innen rund um das Thema Konsumentenkredite und erfüllst tagtäglich ihre größten Wünsche. Bei uns erwartet dich eine offene Kultur mit flachen Hierarchien, starken Teams und genügend Raum, um dich selbst mit einbringen zu können. Wir von FINANZCHECK.de sorgen dafür, dass all unsere Mitarbeiter*innen den für sich richtigen Platz finden, denn bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt.

Deine Rolle bei uns 

- Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Kund*innen und berätst diese telefonisch und schriftlich beim Kreditvergleich

- Du begleitest deine Kund*innen vom Erstkontakt bis hin zum Vertragsabschluss und unterstützt sie dabei in allen Phasen

- Mit einer gründlichen Bedarfsanalyse findest du heraus, was unsere Kund*innen wirklich benötigen und hilfst ihnen, das optimale Kreditangebot zu finden

- Du unterstützt unsere Kunden dabei, ihre Wünsche zu erfüllen, und das ganz ohne Kaltakquise, da alle unsere Kunden aktiv ihre Daten bei uns hinterlassen haben

- Dank unserer modernen Kommunikationstools und den digitalen Abschlussmöglichkeiten unserer Partner steht einem effizienten Arbeitsalltag nichts im Wege

Das bringst du mit

- Du konntest bereits erste Erfahrung im Kund*innenkontakt sammeln (z.B. Vertrieb, Sales, Telesales oder Verkauf)

- Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent und überzeugst durch deine offene und professionelle Art am Telefon

- Du zeichnest dich durch eine hohe Zuverlässigkeit und eine engagierte Arbeitsweise aus 

- Du hast Lust dich weiterzuentwickeln , bringst viel Motivation mit und möchtest gemeinsam mit uns durchstarten

- Deutsch beherrschst du fließend in Wort und Schrift

- Du verfügst idealerweise über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung

Dein Einstieg im Vertrieb bei Finanzcheck 

Du bist neu im Vertrieb, aber motiviert, mit uns gemeinsam durchzustarten und beruflich zu wachsen?

- Wir fördern dein Potenzial und begleiten dich bei der Entwicklung vom Quereinsteiger zum Vertriebsprofi 

- Mit unserer gründlichen Einarbeitung eignest du dir alle erforderlichen Fähigkeiten im Bereich Kreditberatung und Vertrieb an

Das bieten wir dir

- Deine Motivation wird bei uns belohnt: Profitiere von unserem Gehaltsmodell mit ungedeckelter Provision!

- Interne Karriereprogramme, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und Coaching Angebote unterstützen dich bei deiner beruflichen Entwicklung

- Ein modern ausgestattetes Büro inklusive Dachterrasse, Lounge und regelmäßige Events, um unsere Erfolge gemeinsam zu feiern

- Work-Life-Balance: Bei uns kannst du bis zu drei Tage im Home Office arbeiten

- Mit Uber Eats bekommst du dein Mittagessen direkt ins Büro geliefert und sparst gleichzeitig durch die Bezuschussung von Finanzcheck.

- Für deine Erholung gibt es 30 Tage Urlaub , Eltern profitieren von 10-Kind Krank Tagen zusätzlich zum gesetzlichen Anspruch

- Für deine körperliche und mentale Gesundheit gibt es Kooperationen mit Sportanbietern sowie Sportangebote in unserem Office .

- Wir bezuschussen dein Ticket für den ÖPNV in Hamburg damit du umweltbewusst unterwegs bist

Wir setzen uns für ein diverses und inklusives Umfeld ein. Gemeinsam als ein Team aus über 50 Nationen mit unseren verschiedenen Fähigkeiten, Ideen und Erfahrungen arbeiten wir aktiv daran, Vielfalt im Unternehmen zu repräsentieren.

Bei Finanzcheck.de stehen wir für Vielfalt und schaffen ein Umfeld, das eine Vielzahl von Perspektiven, Fähigkeiten und Backgrounds repräsentiert. Wir setzen uns für gleiche Beschäftigungs- und Entwicklungschancen ein, unabhängig vom Geschlecht oder der Geschlechtsidentität, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, Hautfarbe, Beeinträchtigung, Kultur oder Herkunftsland.

Kannst du dich mit unserer Kultur identifizieren? Dann werde Teil von uns! #bestesTeam 

Vor deinem ersten Arbeitstag bei uns, wird dir unser People Operations Team natürlich alle wichtigen Informationen bezüglich deiner Einarbeitung zukommen lassen.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin: 

FFG FINANZCHECK Finanzportale GmbH | Admiralitätstraße 60 | D-20459 Hamburg

Fatin Hamedani, Team Lead - Sales Talent Acquisition | Bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf oder per „one-click“ in nur 2 Minuten über den “Jetzt bewerben“ Button.

title: (Senior) Accountant/ Buchhalter*in (all genders) in Berlin
description:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du arbeitest in unserem Finance-Team und verantwortest die korrekte und zuverlässige Buchung der Geschäftsvorfälle unserer Gesellschaften. Gemeinsam mit dem bestehenden Accounting-Team stellst du sicher, dass notwendige Zahlungen in allen Unternehmensbereichen korrekt abgewickelt und verbucht werden. Der Einsatz moderner Software-Lösungen beschleunigt und digitalisiert unsere Prozesse. Du nimmst eine zentrale Rolle im Unternehmen ein und stehst im regelmäßigen Austausch mit den verschiedenen Unternehmensbereichen. 

Diese Position richtet sich an eine Person, die eigenverantwortlich arbeitet, Prozesse aktiv mitgestaltet und gemeinsam mit Homaris langfristig wachsen möchte.

What You'll Do

Geschäftsvorfälle prüfen und buchen . Du stellst sicher, dass sämtliche Geschäftsvorfälle in DATEV korrekt erfasst werden. 

Debitoren- und Kreditorenbuchhaltung verantworten. Du erfasst die Vorgänge ordnungsgemäß und betreust außerdem die Anlagen- und Bankbuchhaltung. 

Zahlungseingänge und Zahlläufe steuern. Du kontrollierst die Zahlungseingänge und erstellst die erforderlichen Zahlläufe. 

Steuermeldungen übermitteln. Du übermittelst die Umsatzsteuervoranmeldungen und Übernachtungssteuererklärungen. 

Konten abstimmen. Du führst Abstimmarbeiten im Sachkonten-, Debitoren- und Kreditorenbereich sowie für Intercompany-Konten durch. 

Abschlüsse vorbereiten. Du übernimmst vorbereitende Tätigkeiten und arbeitest bei der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB mit. 

Kreditkartenabrechnungen bearbeiten. Du bearbeitest und buchst die Kreditkartenabrechnungen über Pleo. 

Prozesse digital weiterentwickeln. Du optimierst proaktiv Prozesse und erhöhst dabei den Digitalisierungsgrad.

What Makes You a Fit

Relevante Ausbildung und Erfahrung . Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung und mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung. 

Kenntnisse im deutschen Rechnungswesen . Du verfügst über Kenntnisse des HGB und des Umsatzsteuergesetzes. 

DATEV-Erfahrung . Du bringst Erfahrung mit der Buchhaltungssoftware DATEV mit.
Weiterbildung als Pluspunkt. Idealerweise hast du eine Weiterbildung zum/zur geprüften Bilanzbuchhalter:in (IHK) abgeschlossen. 

Digitale Sicherheit . Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere Excel, und offen für eine digitale Arbeitsumgebung. 

Eigenständigkeit und Teamgeist. Du arbeitest selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich, bist zugleich teamfähig und schaust gerne über den eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus. 

Verbesserungsorientierung. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und hast Interesse daran, deinen Bereich aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln. 

Sprachkenntnisse . Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse auf mindestens B1-Niveau. 

KI-Affinität. Du nutzt digitale Tools mit Leichtigkeit, erkennst ihr Potenzial und bist begeistert davon, wie KI den Arbeitsalltag effizienter gestalten kann. 

Präsenz. Du arbeitest in Berlin oder bist bereit, nach Berlin zu kommen. Du arbeitest gerne persönlich mit anderen zusammen – denn genau so entsteht gute Arbeit.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen. 

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet. 

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst. 

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei. 

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren. 

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf. 

Wir nehmen uns Zeit, alle Bewerbungen sorgfältig zu prüfen, daher kann es 1-2 Wochen dauern, bis wir uns bei dir zurückmelden. Wir bitten dich um ein wenig Geduld und danken dir dafür! 

Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Naomi unter oder +49 1579 2465851 

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Kulturen und Hintergründe.

title: Software Entwickler:in mit Schwerpunkt GenAI
description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen. 

Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich “Generative AI” aus und suchen dafür dich, um gute Software für Kunden zu bauen, die relevante Probleme löst.

Was dich erwartet

- Du entwickelst Individualsoftware für verschiedene Kunden und unterschiedlichste Use-Cases auf Basis von LLMs (z. B. GPT, Claude, Mistral) unter Nutzung von Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LangGraph, Open Hermes, Transformers für Generative AI- und RAG-Pipelines.

- Du nutzt und verarbeitet Daten über Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken, APIs, Cloud-Speicher und Legacy-/Unternehmenssysteme, damit AI-Anwendungen mit relevanten Informationen arbeiten, um für den Kunden echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.

- Du bringst die Fähigkeit mit, dein bestehendes Know-How auf neue Herausforderungen anzuwenden.

- Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der fachlichen und technischen Umsetzung von GenAI-Anwendungen und deren Integration.

- Du teilst dein Wissen gerne, z. B. auf Konferenzen, Meetups oder in Fachartikeln.

- Du nutzt Open Source zur Problemlösung und lässt Verbesserungen und Erweiterungen zurückfließen.

- Du hast einen Blick auf den GenAI-Markt und die Weiterentwicklung von Technologien und Trends.

Das solltest du mitbringen

- Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder IT-Beratung.

- Erfahrung mit RAG- oder RAG-Pipelines unter Verwendung von Embeddings, Vector-Datenbanken und LLMs.

- Grundkenntnisse in probabilistischem Testen mit Testsets und Qualitätssicherung mit Metriken.

- Du hast Spaß an der Interaktion mit Kunden (wie etwa bei der Beratung oder im Pre-Sales).

- Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch auf C1+ Niveau sowie konversationssicheres Englisch.

- 1-2 Mal im Monat innerhalb Deutschlands zu reisen, um Kunden und Kolleg:innen persönlich zu treffen, stellt kein Hindernis für dich dar.

Das haben wir zu bieten

- Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 65.000 € bis 75.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden.

- Kein 08/15: Bei unseren AI-Projekten sind Forschungsgeist und Experimentierfreude gefragt, da wir innovative Konzepte verproben, um Lösungen mit hohem Kundennutzen zu schaffen.

- Lass dich inspirieren: Arbeite mit einem der führenden Köpfe auf dem Gebiete der generative Artificial Intelligence - unserem CTO

- Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst.

- Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiterentwickelst.

- Wir arbeiten selbtsorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir schaffen den Rahmen, den du brauchst, um gut arbeiten zu können.

- Werde berühmt: Du hast eine technische Redaktion, die dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren unterstützt, sodass du als Expert:in nach außen sichtbar wirst.

- Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet, dass du nach Feierabend erreichbar bist, Nachrichten beantwortest trotz Krankmeldung oder im Urlaub noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten erledigst .

- Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück ist kein Problem.

- Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen.

- Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad.

- Achtung: Bitte bewirb dich nur, wenn du für ein Pflicht- oder studienbegleitendes Vollzeitpraktikum verfügbar bist und mindestens 5 Monate Zeit hast. Für diese Stelle ist keine Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder ein freiwilliges Praktikum vorgesehen.

Aber: wir möchten nicht vorgeben, diverser und inklusiver zu sein, als wir es aktuell sind. Wir haben Lücken, die wir mit einem wachsenden Team schließen möchten. Falls es für dich bestimmte Herausforderungen gibt, finden wir gemeinsam heraus, was du brauchst, ohne es zu deiner Aufgabe zu machen.

- Gesponsertes Deutschlandticket oder monatlicher Wunschgutschein

title: Senior AI Solutions Entwickler:in
description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH ist ein mittelständischer Dienstleister für Individualsoftware mit Schwerpunkt “Generative AI”. Seit 1998 in Gründerhand, entwickeln wir Software und beraten Kunden aus allen Branchen. Wir setzen auf Cloud Native, modernisieren Software und unterstützen unsere Kunden mit maßgeschneiderten AI-Lösungen. 

Bei Mayflower arbeiten wir in agilen Teams und legen großen Wert darauf, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam Erfolge zu feiern. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für das Produkt, pflegen eine professionelle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden und legen Wert auf eine offene Feedback- und Weiterbildungskultur. Dazu bieten wir spannende Use Cases, großen Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, echten Einfluss beim Kunden zu nehmen. 

Wir bauen unseren Businessbereich „Generative AI" aus und suchen dich, um gemeinsam agentische AI-Lösungen zu entwickeln, die für unsere Kunden echte Probleme lösen. 

Neugierig geworden? Dann lies einfach weiter!

Was dich erwartet

- Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks wie LangGraph oder OpenAI Agent SDK. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack und Vector Databases.

- Du berätst Kunden als vertrauenswürdiger Partner auf Augenhöhe und führst sie strategisch bei der Umsetzung innovativer AI-Vorhaben.

- In Workshops erarbeitest du gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden die AI-Architektur für die jeweiligen Use Cases, ermittelst die Business-Anforderungen und stellst eine Roadmap auf, die einen schnellen Start mit kurzfristigen Ergebnissen ermöglicht.

- Mit Begeisterung nutzt du moderne agentische Entwicklungsmethoden, entwickelst mit deinem Team Best Practices und förderst kontinuierlich den Wissenstransfer zu moderne AI-Architekturen, Model Optimization und Enterprise-AI-Integration.

- Du verfolgst relevante Trends und bringst Inhalte für Whitepaper, Landing Pages, Workshop-Konzepte und AI-Produkte ein, um Kunden für uns zu begeistern.

Das solltest du mitbringen

- Mindestens 10 Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, idealerweise bei einem Individual-Software-Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.

- Projekterfahrung mit LLMs und Agentic-RAG-Implementierungen sowie mit AI-Agent-Frameworks – ob im Python-Umfeld (LangGraph, Deepagents), im TypeScript-Bereich (Eve, Flue, Mastra) oder im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Erfahrung mit Vector Databases und MLOps ist von Vorteil.

- Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.

- Fähigkeit zur Integration von AI-Systemen in bestehende Architekturen.

- Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse auf dem Level C1.

- Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands: 1-2 Mal im Monat für Workshops und Konferenzen.

Das haben wir zu bieten

- Kompetitive Vergütung: Je nachdem welche Erfahrungen und Kompetenzen du mitbringst, vergüten wir die Stelle mit einem Bruttojahresgehalt von 80.000 € bis 90.000 € bei 40 Wochenstunden.

- Sinnhafte Projekte: Entwickle Software, die relevante Kundenprobleme löst und Usern das Leben leichter macht.

- Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.

- Kein 08/15: Bei uns hast du Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use-Cases und Technologien.

- Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.

- Mache einen Unterschied: Du hast bei uns viel Verantwortung und einen großen Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir sind ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, in dem dein Beitrag unseren wirtschaftlichen Erfolg beeinflusst.

- Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche stellen sicher, dass du dich stets weiter entwickelst.

- Wir arbeiten selbstorganisiert: Mit einem hohen Grad an Selbstorganisation und soziokratischen Strukturen hast du alle notwendigen Freiheitsgrade, um die gesetzten Ziele zu erreichen. Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.

- Werde berühmt: Du hast eine technische Redaktion, die dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren unterstützt, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst. Teile deine Erfolge und bringe dich und andere weiter.

- Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Bei uns findest du echte Sparring-Partner, die mehr sind als Rubber Ducks - Kolleg*innen, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln.

- Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet, dass du nach Feierabend erreichbar bist, Nachrichten beantwortest trotz Krankmeldung oder im Urlaub noch ein paar Kleinigkeiten erledigst. Viele Überstunden und überlange Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns nicht üblich.

- Gut für die Psyche: unsere das und ein offener Umgang mit psychischer Gesundheit unterstützen dich dabei gesund zu bleiben.

- Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück sind kein Problem.

- Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen.

title: Risk Manager/in (m/f/d)
description:
Location

Frankfurt am Main

About Us

About AllUnity 

AllUnity is a regulated e-money institute building Europe’s digital payments infrastructure for instant cross-border payments, digital asset markets, and seamless liquidity flows. Established by DWS, Flow Traders, and Galaxy, AllUnity delivers fully backed, MiCAR-compliant stablecoins (EURAU, CHFAU and SEKAU) that provide regulatory certainty and robust reserve backing for secure, frictionless capital movement across markets.

About the Role

We are looking for a Risk Manager/in (m/f/d) with experience in structured risk management within a regulated financial services environment and a strong interest or exposure to blockchain-based products. The role focuses on risk framework development, new product and change assessments, and technology-related risk analysis in a digital asset context.

You will act as a key contributor to the Institute’s second-line risk function, supporting the evaluation of new blockchain integrations, product developments and outsourcing arrangements under MiCA and DORA. The role combines traditional operational risk management with digital asset specific risk considerations.

You will manage defined risk workstreams, particularly in the assessment of new blockchain integrations and product developments.

Key Responsibilities

1. Core Risk Management & Governance

- Conduct inherent and residual risk assessments in line with the Institute’s risk methodology

- Maintain and enhance the risk inventory, including control mapping and documentation standards

- Assess control design and effectiveness across operational and technology-related processes

- Monitor KRIs and risk appetite thresholds, including follow-up and escalation where required

- Support tracking and monitoring of recovery indicators and related governance processes

- Contribute to material change assessments and structured risk papers for management

2. New Product & Process Risk (NPP)

- Perform end-to-end risk assessments for new blockchain integrations (e.g., L1/L2 chains, bridge solutions)

- Assess impact on existing operational processes, governance structures and control frameworks

- Evaluate smart contract-related risk exposure at a conceptual level (e.g., mint/burn controls, upgradeability, governance mechanisms)

- Identify operational, ICT, outsourcing and concentration risks arising from new initiatives

- Support the preparation of clear, decision-ready risk assessments for internal approval committees

3. Technology, ICT & Outsourcing Risk (MiCA / DORA)

- Support alignment of ICT and outsourcing risk management with MiCA and DORA requirements

- Evaluate third-party providers (e.g., custody, bridge, oracle and technology providers) from a risk and criticality perspective

- Assess resilience, dependency, concentration and exit strategy considerations

- Contribute to operational resilience testing and scenario development

- Ensure technology and outsourcing risks are consistently reflected in the overall risk profile

4. Digital Asset Risk Structuring

- Translate technical setups into structured, risk-relevant documentation

- Identify key risk drivers such as governance risk, third-party dependency and single points of failure

- Challenge control design constructively and propose practical mitigation measures

- Support stress scenario development (e.g., bridge exploit, de-pegging, chain halt)

Key Requirements

Experience

- 4 - 6 years of professional experience in Risk Management, Operational Risk, Internal Audit or Risk Advisory

- Experience in a regulated financial services environment (e.g., bank, EMI, fintech or comparable institution)

- Practical exposure to risk assessments, control evaluations and governance processes

- Experience supporting new product approvals or material change assessments is a strong advantage

Technical & Regulatory Knowledge

- Solid understanding of risk assessment methodologies (inherent/residual risk, control effectiveness, risk appetite frameworks)

- Familiarity with blockchain fundamentals (e.g., token issuance, smart contracts, L1/L2 chains, bridge concepts)

- Understanding of operational and technology risk in digital asset environments

- Knowledge of MiCA and/or DORA requirements is strongly preferred

- Awareness of outsourcing and third-party risk principles in regulated institutions

Skills & Working Style

- Strong analytical and structured thinking

- Excellent documentation and drafting skills in German & English

- Proficiency in German is required

- Ability to translate technical and regulatory topics into clear risk documentation

- Independent and solution-oriented working style

- Confidence to challenge constructively while collaborating across functions

- High attention to detail and ownership mindset

Why You Should Apply

In this role, you will not only monitor risk, you will actively contribute to the development and refinement of the risk framework of a BaFin regulated euro stablecoin institution operating under MiCA and DORA.
You will gain hands-on experience at the intersection of traditional financial risk management and blockchain-based infrastructure, working closely with senior leadership in a highly regulated environment.
This role offers meaningful ownership, regulatory depth and exposure to one of Europe’s most innovative digital financial initiatives. 

Benefits

- Competitive Compensation

- 45 EURAU Monthly Employee Allowance

- 30 Days Paid Vacation

- Learning & Development Budget

- Transparent Culture, Open Communication and a driven, collaborative team committed to innovation, professionalism, and excellence.

- Regular Team Retreats & Offsites

- Welcome Packages & Company Swag

Ready to Apply?

If you are excited to build a world-class digital workplace and help shape the infrastructure powering the future of finance, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Creative Project Manager - Brand
description:
About Pleo 

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role 

The Creative Production studio team sits squarely within our Brand function working alongside our Brand Foundations team. You will report directly to the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and join a tight-knit, highly experienced group of project management leads and producers.

In this role, you will lead our internal Creative Production studio team, the execution engine delivering all branded assets across Pleo, including campaign and performance assets, global adaptation and localization, event branding, content marketing, web, socials and lifecycle design. You will balance hands-on delivery with direct people management for a team of three in-house designers and copywriter, ensuring our creative output remains fast, scalable, and sharp across all touchpoints.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to 

Our Brand department is 13 people across two teams: Brand Foundations and Creative Production. You'll lead the four-person Creative Production studio, a senior copywriter, two senior designers and a motion designer, spread across our European offices. Day to day, you'll work alongside a peer project lead on Brand Foundations, a brand strategist, our producers, and internal partners in Events, Lifecycle, Performance Marketing, HR/People Ops and Legal, plus our media agency. Most of the studio's clients are internal teams across Pleo.

What you’ll be doing 

As a Senior Creative Project Manager, you will:

Creative Production & Operations 

- Studio Ownership: Lead end-to-end execution across all creative production studio work streams, ensuring projects hit quality benchmarks, deadlines, and brand standards. This is also not just intake of brand requests but also spotting opportunities proactively for brand involvement and governance across the business.

- Project Management: Own intake of BAU requests, filtering and assigning work while acting as the bridge between requestors and the studio team. Define scope upfront and ensure the team has what it needs to execute. Contribute to project plans for integrated campaigns and large events and manage Creative studio kick-offs, status reporting, and timeline and milestone tracking.

- Core Output Focus: Oversee production for high-performing marketing assets, market localization and adaptations, event branding, and content marketing.

- Process & Integration: Partner closely with peer project leads, producers, and the Brand Foundations team to streamline intake briefs, cross-team handoffs, and resource sharing.

- Global Asset Delivery: Manage asset adaptation frameworks to keep our brand consistent across different regions and channels.

- Capacity Planning: Own and manage resourcing across internal teams and freelance support, balancing capacity against demand and prioritizing against business needs when demands compete.

- External agency partnerships: Serve as the lead creative point of contact for asset production with our media agency. Manage sprint-style monthly asset delivery in response to agency and internal performance team briefs, keeping output aligned with the media plan. Review final creative placements across Meta and LinkedIn to ensure assets display correctly on paid channels.

People Management & Leadership 

- Direct Management: Line manage, mentor, and foster career growth for a cross-functional team of three in-house designers and one copywriter overseeing their daily priorities and bandwidth.

Stakeholder Alignment & Strategy 

- Cross-Functional Partner: Serve as the strategic operational bridge connecting the studio with Marketing, Events, HR/People Ops, and Legal.

- Leadership Alignment: Work closely with the Director of Brand Strategy & Experience and Associate Director of Brand Management to align studio output with broader brand goals and business priorities.

We launched our new brand in September, so this is a moment to build. The studio has the basics in place, but intake, briefing, project tracking and resourcing are still early. You'll set the ways of working that the studio runs on, and we'd love you to bring AI into how we plan, brief and produce.

What you bring 

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

- In-House Brand Experience: Minimum 5-7 years of work experience. Solid background working in-house in a fast-paced brand function (tech, scale-up, or high-growth environment).

- People Leadership: Direct experience line-managing creative talent (designers/artworkers) based remotely in different offices in Europe with an empathetic, growth-oriented approach.

- Production Scope: Broad familiarity managing workflows across digital performance, multi-market localization, physical/virtual events, AI creative production, and employer branding.

- Culture Driver: Thrives in a peer environment working alongside other motivated and constructive senior PMs, producers, creatives, and strategists.

- Operational Skills: Mastery of modern project management tooling and AI-powered workflows (e.g. Asana, Notion, Jira, Slack).

- Project Management Experience: Strong hands-on project management experience in a fast-paced, delivery-focused environment, running multiple projects concurrently. Comfortable not just initiating projects, but staying a consistent presence throughout: managing delivery, and reassessing priorities and capacity as needs shift.

Why is this role a good fit for you 

This role is a good fit for you if:

- You love day-to-day production and get a kick out of turning an event brief into finished collateral within a week.

- You want to build how a studio works, from intake to resourcing, as much as you want to ship the work.

- You enjoy leading creatives, giving them clear briefs and keeping the work grounded in what the business needs.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

- You mainly want to work on big brand campaigns. We run around two a year, and they're produced with an external agency. The studio adapts those assets, but most of the work is events, performance creative and BAU requests.

- You prefer a predictable, planned workload. Last-minute requests are part of life on Brand.

- You haven't line-managed people yet. Direct people management of the studio team is a core part of this role.

How you’ll develop in this role 

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

- Deliver the studio's day-to-day work to our speed and quality standards, in line with the new brand guidelines.

- Set best practice for how the studio takes in, briefs, tracks and resources work.

- Improve how we estimate and plan capacity, using AI where it makes sense.

The location 

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work . We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

Show me the benefits! 

- Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

- Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

- Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

- We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

- For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

- Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

- We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

- Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process 

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

- Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

- Hiring manager interview: A conversation with the Director about the projects you've delivered, the teams you've led and the kind of production work you enjoy most.

- Case study: You'll walk us through how you'd approach a creative production task. You'll present to the Director and a peer project lead, and possibly a member of the studio team.

- Final stage: Team-fit chat with one or two people from the studio

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired this role, we received an incredibly high volume of applications but only so many could be taken forward. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

- CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

- Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

- Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application 

- English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

- A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

- Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

- Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email -----

title: Senior Manager, Marketing Operations - Europe
description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the Role 

The Manager, Regional Marketing Operations is responsible for turning global and regional marketing priorities into coordinated, localized, production-ready, and successfully delivered marketing activity across the Region.

This role owns the regional execution layer of the marketing operating model, connecting Regional Marketing with Crunchyroll’s global operational capabilities. The candidate will ensure campaigns are operationally planned, assets are produced and localized to regional requirements, dependencies are managed, and final materials are delivered accurately and on time across relevant regional channels and partners.

A critical responsibility of the role is the end-to-end management of marketing localization for the Region. This includes localization of all marketing assets used regionally, whether those assets originate from a global campaign or are created specifically for a regional initiative. The Manager coordinates translation, transcreation, adaptation, versioning, approvals, quality checks, and delivery of localized marketing materials, working closely with Global Localization while remaining accountable for regional marketing localization readiness.

The role operates as the regional counterpart to Global Operations, Content and Marketing and Distribution Operations, Content and Marketing, with particularly close interfaces to Integrated Planning, Campaign Operations, Marketing Production, and Marketing Delivery. The objective is to leverage common global processes, technology, production capabilities, and standards while ensuring regional priorities, language requirements, cultural considerations, channels, and market-specific needs are fully represented

Key Responsibilities 

- Regional Marketing Operations & Execution: Own the operational coordination of the Region’s marketing activity, translating global and regional marketing strategies into executable plans, milestones, asset requirements, localization needs, dependencies, and delivery schedules. Maintain an integrated view of regional marketing readiness and ensure activities move effectively from planning through execution.

- Regional Integrated Planning: Partner closely with Integrated Planning to incorporate regional priorities, launches, campaigns, tentpoles, local initiatives, and market requirements into the broader global marketing planning process. Translate global plans into actionable regional timelines while providing early visibility into local requirements, resource constraints, localization lead times, and execution risks.

- End-to-End Marketing Localization Management: Manage the localization workflow for all global and regional marketing assets required by the Region, including copy, key art, trailers, video, social assets, paid-media creative, CRM materials, partner assets, promotional content, and other campaign deliverables. Coordinate translation, transcreation, cultural adaptation, versioning, review, approvals, QA, and final delivery, ensuring localized assets are accurate, brand-appropriate, culturally relevant, and available against campaign deadlines. Partner with Global Localization on standards, technology, vendors, workflows, terminology, and quality frameworks while retaining operational accountability for regional marketing localization.

- Marketing Production Coordination: Partner with Marketing Production to communicate regional production and localization requirements early, define necessary versions and formats, and ensure global source assets are structured to enable efficient regional adaptation. Coordinate requests for region-specific materials where global assets do not meet local needs while avoiding unnecessary duplication of global production capabilities. For regionally originated campaigns, manage the operational interface between regional creative requirements and the appropriate production resources.

- Marketing Delivery Coordination: Work closely with Marketing Delivery within Distribution Operations, Content and Marketing to ensure final global and localized marketing assets are packaged, distributed, and made available to the correct regional destinations on time. Coordinate region-specific channel requirements, specifications, deadlines, and partner needs and provide clear escalation when assets are missing, incorrect, delayed, or unable to meet delivery requirements.

title: Staff Backend Software Engineer - GO & Python
description:
About us

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

The Role

PhysicsX is building a platform that enables Data Scientists and Simulation Engineers to build, train, and deploy Deep Physics Models. The platform handles massive volumes of complex simulation data and enables high fidelity multi physics simulation through AI inference.

We are looking for a Senior (potentially Staff level, depending on the candidate) Software Engineer to join the AI Workbench platform team. This is a software engineering role, not an ML research role. You do not need to be a practising ML engineer, but you do need to be fluent in the language of ML and data platforms, ideally through prior hands on experience with ML platforms or data science work.

The team sits in a highly infrastructure heavy domain without being an infrastructure team itself. A large part of the role is building strong working relationships with the infrastructure team and owning the work that falls in the space between the two, where ownership is not always clearly defined. You will also play a key role in mentoring and developing engineers across the team, some of whom are early career and some mid career.

Note for candidates: PhysicsX is currently going through a team reorganisation. The scope of this role may evolve as team structures settle, and we have kept this description intentionally broad rather than narrowly tailored to today's team shape.

What You Will Do

- Design and build distributed systems, services, and APIs for high dimensional simulation data across the machine learning lifecycle, from data processing and model training to inference services.

- Own work end to end in a domain where responsibilities often sit between the AIWB platform team and the wider infrastructure team, and proactively build the relationships needed to manage that ambiguity well.

- Build tools that enable data scientists and engineers to create automated, robust pipelines for data ingestion and processing, powering active learning loops.

- Architect and integrate storage solutions, data warehouses, and data lakes to handle the demands of complex simulations, multimodal data, and deep learning workloads.

- Deploy and support services across more than one production environment, including cloud and on premises or air gapped customer environments.

- Define system architecture for new capabilities, making trade offs across performance, reliability, cost, and developer experience.

- Author and review Technical Decision Records and contribute to Technology Radar reviews.

- Mentor and support the growth of engineers across the team, including those earlier in their careers, and act as a technical role model.

- Remain genuinely hands on. Writing code stays part of the job at every level, this is not a purely managerial track.

- Communicate clearly and confidently with a wide range of stakeholders and personalities across engineering, delivery, and customer facing teams.

What You Bring to the Table

- A passion for the craft. You are driven by engineering excellence and enjoy building things properly, not just shipping quickly.

- Strong Kubernetes experience. This is a must have, including comfort with CRDs, Operators, and infrastructure configuration tools such as Helm or ArgoCD.

- Strong command of Go, plus working knowledge of Python. Comfort with Rust is also valued. Experience across Kubernetes, Go, Python, and Rust is ideal.

- Experience deploying and supporting services in more than one production environment, not just a single deployment target.

- An ML platform background or prior data science experience, even if you have since moved into pure software engineering. You understand how ML practitioners and researchers think and talk about problems.

- Intellectual curiosity and a proactive approach. You do not need to be told what to do next.

- Strong communication and organisational skills, with experience operating at a senior or staff level, or equivalent people leadership experience, in a comparable engineering organisation.

- Comfort with ambiguity and an adaptable, startup minded approach. PhysicsX moves quickly and priorities shift, and we are looking for people who thrive in that environment rather than finding it difficult.

- Prior experience mentoring or developing other engineers.

Ideally

- Experience at an ML focused startup or platform company, or a strong infrastructure background from a larger organisation such as a bank, provided you can demonstrate adaptability to a smaller, faster moving environment

- Side projects, open source contributions, or things you have built for their own sake. Not a requirement, but a nice signal of genuine engineering passion.

- Understanding of what it takes to build and support software across cloud, on premises, and air gapped environments.

- Experience with big data systems and analytics at scale in production.

What We Offer

- Equity options, share in our success and growth.

- 10% employer pension contribution, invest in your future.

- Free office lunches, great food to fuel your workdays.

- Flexible working, balance your work and life in a way that works for you.

- Hybrid setup, enjoy our new Shoreditch office while keeping remote flexibility.

- Enhanced parental leave, support for life's biggest milestones.

- Private healthcare, comprehensive coverage.

- Personal development, access learning and training to help you grow.

Over the past 6 years, our People team has designed, built, and implemented the people processes that have scaled Street Group from 30 - 230 people. But we know that systems that work at 200 people can break when growth accelerates - and we want to get ahead of that.

This is an opportunity for someone who has been through that scaling journey before to have an oversized impact on a small but ambitious People team to become best in class.

Why this role exists now

In 2026, over half of the business told us they don't know what excellence looks like in their role, or how excellence is rewarded. This is the crux of this role; to build the systems, processes and reward that sets people up for success and ensure we reward and retain our best people.

Over the next 12-18 months, this will mean you'll be working with our Head of People and People Partner on initiatives that clarify excellence and reward - our internal levels framework, compensation & reward, embedding our excellence standard throughout the business, coaching senior managers and leaders, and building manager capability at scale.

title: Product Manager — Kits and Integrated Workflows
description:
At ONI, we are driven by a profound mission: to propel scientific discovery and combat diseases by granting everyone the ability to visualize, comprehend, and share the intricate microscopic details of life. Our revolutionary Nanoimager and Aplo Platform stand at the forefront of advancing cellular studies on a molecular level, making substantial contributions to the evolution of scientific knowledge. 

We’re looking for a product manager to own our kits and workflows, including EV Profiler and LNP Profiler, now that the concept is proven. You’ll make sure sample preparation, fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software work together as one system, and your responsibility is the complete customer experience, from sample to scientifically meaningful result. The job is making that system rock solid: hardening what’s already on the market, making sure it works the same way at every site, and getting more customers on it without support load growing at the same rate. 

The Role 

As part of the Product team, you’ll own the product management of our kits and end-to-end workflows, including the Discovery Kit, EV Profiler and LNP Profiler and their future revisions. You will ensure these work together with automated sample preparation and fluid handling, imaging, analysis and reporting software to deliver reliable, reproducible and intuitive solutions for our customers. 

The initial products have launched, and the work now is making them dependable, repeatable, and scalable for our customers. You’ll create clarity and momentum for the R&D teams by understanding which problems matter, turning customer and market evidence into priorities, and removing barriers to delivering a coherent solution. You’ll grow adoption to routine use across many sites, including bioprocessing and QC settings where results must be reproducible and defensible, and you’ll work with Marketing on positioning and the product story as the portfolio evolves. You will play a critical role in bringing these quality improvements to the market and ensuring that current and future kits maintain their quality over time, and you’ll help define the roadmap for next iterations of existing and future kits and workflows. As a product manager, you’ll be the connective tissue between software, hardware, bioware, support, and the field, acting as the voice of the customer to help internal teams better understand our customers’ needs and problems. 

The role is ideal for a technically curious, commercially aware individual who loves getting hands-on with products, takes ownership of outcomes and thrives on complex, cross-functional challenges. You will work broadly across our platform and alongside US colleagues; the position is based in Oxford and involves occasional travel to customers and our US team (typically 10-20%). 

What you’ll do 

- 
Understand scientists and their complete workflows first-hand. Work with customers and field teams, study usage and support data, and synthesize their sometimes conflicting inputs into the problems worth solving. 

- 
Drive evidence-led product direction and priorities across our solutions with R&D and commercial leaders, balancing customer outcomes, differentiation, adoption, reliability, margin and technical feasibility. 

- 
Own the roadmap for our kits (including the Discovery Kit and the EV and LNP Profiler kits) and workflows, balancing quality, reliability, usability and new features. 

- 
Build and refine market and product requirements (MRD/PRD) across workflows, from sample preparation (Aplo Flow) through acquisition (Aplo Scope) to analysis (CODI), according to our Product Development Process. 

- 
Own validation for each kit and workflow: define acceptance criteria, performance specifications and validation plans, including reference samples and reproducibility across instruments, operators and sites. Work with R&D, who own development and verification. 

- 
Drive coherence across our end-to-end solutions, ensuring kits, reagents, lab automation, instruments and software evolve together rather than as disconnected products. Champion reproducibility, usability and reliable results across the complete workflow. 

- 
Connect R&D, operations, quality, service, field applications, sales, marketing and customers. Establish feedback loops, clear ownership and effective cross-team decisions. 

- 
Own pricing and packaging for our kits and workflows, balancing customer value, competitiveness and margin targets. 

- 
Work with Marketing throughout a product's life to shape positioning, the value proposition and the product story as the portfolio evolves, not only at launch. 

- 
Lead launch and release planning with R&D, Marketing and the field: set readiness criteria, make go/no-go decisions, and coordinate documentation, release notes and training for each launch or revision. 

- 
Create and run webinars and internal training for the field application and sales teams on new products and revisions, and keep an accurate record of what each kit, instrument and software version can deliver. 

- 
Track post-launch performance, including adoption, kit reorders, time to first result, reproducibility, support burden, customer feedback and commercial results, and use it to set priorities. 

- 
Analyze support tickets, logs and customer feedback to identify recurring failure modes, and prioritize root-cause fixes into the roadmap. 

- 
Work with Quality and Operations on manufacturing transfer, life cycle support and end of life, so our kits and workflows maintain quality over time. 

What you’ll bring 

- 
A life-science background, ideally EVs, LNPs, nanoparticle characterization, imaging or biophysics. Being able to speak the language of our customers is critical. An MSc/PhD or equivalent hands-on experience is a real plus. 

- 
Fluency across software, instruments, laboratory workflows and multidisciplinary R&D; comfortable investigating issues hands-on and understanding how the system fits together. 

- 
Experience working with empowered, cross-functional development teams: knowing when to provide context, decide on a trade-off and leave the solution to specialists. 

- 
Product management (or product owner) experience in life-science tools or instrumentation, ideally taking something from first release to a scaled, supported product. 

- 
Experience planning and running launches with Marketing, R&D and the field, from development through adoption. 

- 
Commercial and pricing judgement: You can weigh customer value, competitiveness and margin when setting price and packaging. 

- 
A quality mindset: You’re comfortable writing acceptance criteria and test plans, and you think about risk, reproducibility and traceability. Exposure to a quality system (ISO 9001 or 13485) is a plus. 

- 
Comfort with data: logs, tickets, precision and method-comparison numbers (CVs, site to site). Evidence sets priorities, not the loudest voice. 

- 
The ability to lead across software, hardware, bioware, support and field without owning any of them, and to prioritize when everything feels urgent. 

- 
Clear writing and organization skills. Requirements, release notes and docs that other people can act on. 

Nice to have 

- 
Super-resolution or single-molecule imaging experience (dSTORM, PALM, DNA-PAINT), or general microscopy experience (TIRF, widefield, confocal, spinning-disk). 

- 
Hands-on EV or LNP work in research, biopharma, gene therapy or drug delivery. 

- 
Laboratory automation, automated liquid handling, sample preparation, consumable kits, workflow integration, scientific software or data analysis. 

- 
Integrating instruments, software, consumables and automated lab workflows; exposure to verification, validation, quality systems or lifecycle support. 

- 
Commercialization, pricing, segmentation, product positioning or product marketing in technically sophisticated markets.

Data Enablement Officer

Help shape how Efficio uses data responsibly, securely and effectively.

We are looking for a Data Enablement Officer to establish and lead Efficio’s data governance framework, helping us protect client data while enabling its responsible use across our services, analytics, products and AI capabilities.

This is a highly visible role at the intersection of data, technology, AI, risk and client delivery. You will work across the business to turn complex contractual, regulatory, privacy and security requirements into practical guidance that enables teams to innovate with confidence.

Initially, the role will have a strong advisory and enablement focus: helping teams understand client requirements, assess new uses of data and make proportionate, risk-based decisions. As our governance model matures, the role is expected to take greater ownership of the framework and delegated authority for lower-risk decisions.

What you'll be doing

Establish our data governance framework

You will assess our current data-handling practices and develop a practical, scalable governance framework covering the lifecycle of client data – from collection and classification through to access, use, sharing, storage, retention and secure deletion.

- 
Client data handling and classification

- 
Data reuse and fair usage

- 
Use of client data within Efficio products

- 
Use of data with AI tools, including third-party and self-hosted solutions

- 
Data access and security

- 
Retention, archiving and secure disposal

- 
Anonymisation and aggregation

- 
Third-party data sharing

- 
Policy exceptions and escalation

You will also help establish and maintain our information asset inventories, data flows and AI asset registers.

Enable responsible use of data and AI

A key part of the role will be helping teams determine what we can do with data, under what conditions, and with what safeguards.

You will establish a consistent approach for assessing new and changing data use cases, considering factors such as:

- 
Why the data was originally obtained

- 
Client and contractual restrictions

- 
Data sensitivity and classification

- 
The proposed use and intended recipients

- 
Security and access controls

- 
Retention requirements

- 
Legal, client and reputational considerations

Govern products, platforms and technology

Working closely with Technology, Information Security, Legal and Privacy teams, you will assess areas including:

- 
Data residency and international transfers

- 
Encryption, access controls and logging

- 
Supplier and subcontractor access

- 
Data retention, backups and deletion

- 
Exit and data-export arrangements

- 
Use of customer data for AI model training, product improvement or other secondary purposes

You will help ensure that unapproved platforms are not used for client data without appropriate assessment and documented approval.

Support new solutions and innovation

You will work alongside teams designing and deploying new data, software, analytics and AI solutions, providing governance input from an early stage.

Ahead of launch, you will help confirm that the appropriate governance, legal, privacy and security reviews have taken place and that material risks have been appropriately addressed.

Where issues remain, you will recommend practical remediation, escalation or, where necessary, a delay to rollout. Acceptance of significant residual risk will remain with the appropriate executive or governance committee.

Build governance that works in practice

This role isn't simply about writing policies. We want to create a governance model that teams can understand and use.

You will help develop:

- 
A clear data governance operating model and decision-rights framework

- 
Practical data, AI, security, reuse and retention policies

- 
Data and AI use-case assessment processes

- 
Risk-classification and escalation models

- 
Policy exception processes and decision registers

- 
Product and AI platform assessment standards

- 
Solution launch-readiness checklists

- 
Training, guidance and supporting materials

- 
Governance reporting for senior leadership and relevant committees

You will coordinate, advise and constructively challenge stakeholders across the organisation while recognising that responsibility for managing data risk is shared across business owners, data owners, Legal and Privacy, Information Security, Technology and senior governance forums.

Client engagement

This will also be an important client-facing role.

You will participate in client discussions where required, confidently explaining Efficio's approach to data governance, security and responsible data use.

You should be comfortable responding to questions about how client data is accessed, used, stored, shared, retained and protected, translating technical or governance concepts into clear, credible explanations for different audiences.

What we're looking for

Data governance or data management

Data privacy

Information security

Technology or operational risk
