Aave Labs began with a simple question: how do we make financial services like borrowing, saving, and earning more accessible globally?

We built the Aave Protocol, now the world’s largest and most trusted onchain lending market, connecting decentralized finance with individuals, traditional finance, and fintech.

Today, we build trusted, high-quality products that expand access to lending, credit, and savings globally

Our culture 

We build trusted products that help people access and discover economic opportunities.

We hold a high bar for quality and craftsmanship. No detail is too small. Trust depends on it.

We’re a global team building products people can actually use, turning complex technology into something simple and reliable.

We stay aligned, move quickly, and think long term, while keeping teams lean and focused on impact.

About the Role 

We're hiring a Principal Backend Engineer to lead the engineering team behind Push, Aave Labs' regulated, non-custodial on-ramp and off-ramp.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning the systems that connect banking and open-banking partners, identity and compliance controls, payment processing, blockchain settlement, customer wallets, and the applications through which customers access Push.

You'll set the technical direction for a high-stakes financial product where correctness, security, auditability, and operational resilience directly affect customer funds and regulatory obligations. Alongside designing and building critical systems, you'll provide day-to-day leadership to the engineering team, create clarity from product and regulatory requirements, and ensure the team can deliver safely at pace.

How you can make an impact: 

- Own the technical direction and architecture for Push across backend services, external integrations, data flows, and onchain settlement

- Translate product, regulatory, and operational requirements into a clear engineering roadmap, well-scoped projects, and sound technical decisions

- Design and build resilient services for on-ramp and off-ramp transaction lifecycles, including payment initiation, status tracking, settlement, exception handling, and customer notifications

- Lead integrations with open-banking, payments, identity, compliance, and blockchain infrastructure providers

- Define secure boundaries between fiat systems, non-custodial wallets, and onchain execution, ensuring sensitive data, permissions, and signing-related flows are handled appropriately

- Set and uphold standards for secure development, architecture review, testing, observability, incident response, deployment, and sustainable on-call ownership

- Partner closely with Product, Compliance, Legal, Security, Operations, Finance, and application engineers

- Remain hands-on in the codebase, particularly for complex architecture, high-risk changes, and critical production issues

Let's connect if you have: 

- 8+ years of backend engineering experience, including senior technical leadership of production systems and teams

- Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems that move or account for real money, with a strong understanding of failure modes and operational risk

- Experience with regulated financial products and understanding how to balance compliance and regulatory requirements with product features and goals 

- Strong backend programming skills. Production experience with Rust is highly desirable; deep experience with Go, Java, C++ can substitute

- Strong knowledge of API design, PostgreSQL or another relational database, messaging systems, and service-to-service integration patterns

- Experience in regulated fintech, payments, banking, digital assets, or another environment requiring auditability, controls, and high availability

- Excellent system-design judgement, including migration strategy, build-versus-buy decisions, security boundaries, and the long-term operational cost of architecture choices

- A track record of leading engineers through ambiguous, high-impact work while remaining close to implementation and production operations

Haven’t quite met all the criteria? Let’s not miss out on the chance to speak. Whilst you might not meet every single requirement, you might bring other, more exciting skills to the companies!

Equal opportunities statement: 

Aave Labs celebrates diversity and views each and every team member as a separate individual with their own unique identity. No matter your race, religion, gender, ethnicity, age, disability, sexual orientation or even the wallet you use, we welcome you at Aave Labs. As an equal opportunities employer, we take accountability and believe in everyone's potential to build, create and inspire changes. With a mission to build a diverse workforce, we are proud to foster a working environment in which everyone can feel safe and valued for who they are.

description:
The Senior Paraplanner is the technical engine room of our advice service. You take the output of the advice engine, the fact find data, and the rest of the case context, and you make sure that when an Advisor speaks to the customer — or when a plan is released — everything is in order, suitability is clearly evidenced, and the documentation tells a coherent story. 

You are the senior practitioner in the Paraplanning team, working closely with the Head of Proposition who owns the advice policy and proposition. You set the day-to-day quality bar for suitability writing, lead on the most complex cases, coaching less experienced Paraplanners, and acting as the technical bridge between the Paraplanning team, the Advisors and the engine team. 

What you'll be doing 

Case work and suitability 

- 
Lead on complex cases — particularly those involving pension consolidation, drawdown and multiple pots — preparing the case before the advice is presented to the customer. 

- 
Take the engine-generated plan and ensure the suitability report supporting it is accurate, complete and reads well for the customer — clear on objectives, recommendations, risks, costs and the rationale. 

- 
Run pre-meeting case reviews with Advisors, flagging anything in the fact find or plan that needs attention before the customer call. 

- 
Support Advisors during the QA review of engine-generated plans, particularly on cases flagged for a higher level of review. 

Standards, templates and tooling

Develop and maintain the suitability report templates and suitability wording required by the advice engine for each customer circumstance. Team leadership

Set the bar for what good paraplanning looks like in a digital-first model — this is new territory and you'll help define it.

Working across the service

Contribute to advice policy and House Rules discussions — bringing the paraplanner's eye on what is clear, fair and not misleading for the customer. 

- 
Support Risk & Compliance on monitoring activities, root cause analysis and remediation, recognising that paraplanning acts as a first-line risk control in our model. 

- 
Be the go-to technical voice for Money Guides and Financial Advisers on complex queries, helping them stay clearly on the right side of the guidance/advice boundary. 

What we're looking for 

Essential 

- 
Substantial paraplanning experience in a regulated advice firm, ideally including pension consolidation and drawdown cases. 

- 
Diploma in Regulated Financial Planning (Level 4), with appetite to keep building qualifications.

Strong technical knowledge of UK pensions, ISAs, investment products, and the tax treatment of each.

description:

And now Moneybox is building the means to help more people in more ways - through personal financial advice. We believe that great advice should be available to everyone, at every stage of life, and that technology can help us deliver it with the care, clarity and accountability people deserve.

We're building a new kind of advice service from the ground up, and the people who join us now will help shape how millions of people plan for their future.

The Senior Financial Advisor is one of the most experienced practitioners in the advice team. You are the technical anchor for complex cases — particularly pension consolidation and drawdown — and you carry significant accountability for the quality and suitability of advice we deliver to customers. 

You will work alongside the Advice Engine rather than replacing it: the engine generates the plan, and you ensure it is right for the customer. You will also play a leading role in shaping the House Rules that govern advice outputs. You will coach less experienced Advisers and Money Guides, and be the senior point of escalation for the team to deliver good advice outcomes. You may have line manager responsibility for a team of Financial Advisers. 

What you'll be doing 

Customer-facing advice 

- 
Running video consultations, collecting information & establishing customer goals, walking customers through their plan, answering questions and helping them feel confident about their next steps. 

- 
Handle the most complex escalations from the support team — vulnerable customers, customers with multiple pension pots, customers where suitability needs to be carefully assessed, and customers who need to be off-boarded with care. 

- 
Make final calls on whether a customer should be off-ramped from the service, documenting the rationale clearly and ensuring the customer leaves the interaction with a good outcome and a clear next step. 

- 
Respond to customers flagged as insistent, doing the right thing for the customer while protecting them and the firm. 

Quality assurance and oversight 

- 
Review engine-generated plans against our suitability standards within the agreed SLAs, signing off plans for release. 

- 
Review flagged customer cases before their plan is released, deciding whether to further fact find, off-ramp or release the plan. 

- 
Carry out QA checks on advice given and calls delivered by other Advisors and on customer interactions handled by the support team, feeding findings into the T&C scheme. 

- 
Own a portfolio of QA themes (e.g. drawdown suitability, vulnerable customer handling) and report findings into governance forums. 

Shaping the service 

- 
Provide expert input into the House Rules — the restrictions and parameters that govern what the advice engine can and cannot recommend. 

-

- AI workflow tooling and the tiered graduation ladder from personal tool, to shared tool, to business system.

Own model hosting and scaling. Hosting and scaling for AI and model workloads, including the customer-facing models behind our Aurora financial guidance service, with execution in collaboration with Tech Ops. Model safety and performance for customer-facing AI is shared with our Decisioning and Data Science teams: they own what happens inside the model, you own everything surrounding it.

Enable the do-ers. Give departments a working answer for using AI today - clear guardrails on what is allowed now and fast risk assessment rather than blanket restriction - and make sure demand arrives through the front door.

Who You Are

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About Moneybox 

At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement. 

Job Brief 

Moneybox serves more than 2M customers and runs a live service handling over 20M API requests a day. We have agreed a company-wide AI Platforms strategy and are building a new AI Deployment team to deliver on it. This is the first of several Senior AI Deployment Engineer hires, reporting to the Head of AI Platforms & Deployment.

You will be a forward-deployed senior engineer who unlocks AI-driven solutions to business problems: an expert in deploying AI and using it safely, not an ML modeller. The work is mainly Python across the modern AI engineering stack - harness engineering, skills and tool building, agent workflows and orchestration, agent hosting and sandboxing, guardrails, evals, RAG and context engineering, and tokenomics (cost, latency, model selection). Production-grade LLM system experience is the core requirement.

You will work on three types of project:

- Departmental engagements. Embed with departments to AI-enable tasks and processes in a more sophisticated way than "just ask Claude" - for example, Python pipelines where one step is an LLM API call - delivering real incremental value with each engagement and transforming working patterns into load-bearing, AI-enabled business processes.

- Customer-facing AI deployment. Deploy and integrate AI components built by our ML and Decisioning teams into production: the engineering implementation layer between a working model and a live customer feature.

- AI platform capabilities. Work with the AI Platforms team to turn engagement patterns into safe, increasingly self-serve company-wide tooling.

Departments across Moneybox are already building AI tools themselves - we want to provide them with a safe path to load-bearing use at scale. This role catches that demand and matures it properly.

What You'll Do 

- Own engagement delivery end to end. Scope with the department, design the solution, build it, deploy it, and agree the handover and ownership model - from prototype through to stable production. Engagements arrive as vague pain; you define the problem, not just the solution.

- Engineer AI solutions properly. Pipelines, LLM API integration, evals, guardrails, monitoring, and cost and accuracy optimisation for the systems you build. Know when a step must be deterministic and when an LLM is the right tool.

- Graduate tools into business systems. Take shared, team-load-bearing tools that people have built for themselves and rebuild them as owned business systems under a full SDLC where the value justifies it.

- Deploy ML-built components into production. Serving, integration with the Moneybox platform, and everything surrounding the model, in partnership with Decisioning and Data Science teams (who own what happens inside the model) and our engineering squads.

- Build reusable capability. Convert engagement learnings into shared tooling, templates, playbooks and self-serve workflows on the AI Platforms stack. Building out platform components including guardrails, sandboxing, workflows, and gateways.

- Raise the bar. Work alongside embedded specialists during the team's ramp-up, absorbing and internalising their output so the capability stays with Moneybox.

In your first three months we expect your first departmental engagements to be selected on feasibility and delivered with measurable business value - time saved, cost avoided, risk removed - and at least one ML-built capability deployed to production with proper evals, monitoring and cost controls.

This role is explicitly not ML model training or data science, and it is not a chatbot-prompting generalist: this is production software engineering with AI at its core.

Who You Are 

- A production engineer with AI at the core. You have built and shipped LLM-powered systems that ran in production and can talk concretely about evals, failure modes, cost curves, and what you would do differently.

- Comfortable in ambiguity. You can walk into a department with a vague problem and leave with a scoped, deliverable system, and you are managed by exception rather than by direction.

- A strong partner to non-technical owners. Embedding, scoping and communicating with people who own a business process but not the technology is the job, not a distraction from it.

- A platform thinker. You have turned one-off solutions into reusable tools or platforms before and you look for the pattern in every engagement.

- Operationally minded. You care about monitoring, cost and reliability of what you ship, and about making a prototype into a system someone can rely on.

- Safety-conscious by habit. PII handling, data-boundary discipline, prompt-injection awareness, human-in-the-loop design and graceful failure are how you build, not a checklist you apply afterwards.

Skills & Experience 

Essential

- 5+ years of software engineering with meaningful production ownership.

- Has built and shipped LLM-powered systems that ran in production.

- Production-grade Python as your primary language.

- LLM-powered systems in production: real-world experience working with models via APIs - harnesses, orchestration, structured output, tool use and agents, RAG where appropriate.

- Evals and quality: designing evaluation sets, measuring accuracy, recall and precision for LLM steps, regression-testing prompts and workflows.

- Safety and guardrails in practice: PII handling, data-boundary discipline, prompt-injection awareness, human-in-the-loop design.

- Cost and performance optimisation: model selection, caching, batching, token economics, latency budgets.

- Deployment and operations: CI/CD, containerisation, monitoring and alerting for AI workloads.

- Data processing fundamentals: pipelines, transformation, validation, anomaly handling.

- Customer- or stakeholder-facing delivery experience: consultancy, forward-deployed engineering, solutions engineering, or embedded or platform roles serving non-engineering users.

Desirable

- Experience with Azure and/or .NET. We host on Azure and our core stack is .NET, so willingness to integrate with both is required; existing expertise is a bonus rather than a requirement.

- Experience with agent hosting and sandboxing platforms, LLM or MCP gateways, or agentic workflow orchestration tooling.

- Experience in financial services or another regulated environment.

- Experience deploying models built by a data science team into customer-facing production systems.

title: Legal Counsel - AdTech Transactions
description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Corporate teams support the company’s performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo’s Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo’s success.

Role

We're looking for a Legal Counsel, AdTech Transactions to join our Legal team. In this role, you'll own the contracts and legal questions across Voodoo's advertising activity: selling ad inventory in our apps, buying user acquisition at scale, and the ad network we are now launching to connect third-party publishers and advertisers.

This position sits at the intersection of ad tech, commercial contracting, and data and privacy law, in a market where platform policies, ATT, GDPR, and consent frameworks change several times a year. Your work will directly shape how Voodoo monetizes its inventory, buys and measures user acquisition, grows its advertising network, and handles player data,while keeping us within legal and platform requirements and player expectations.

Your main responsibilities :

- Own ad tech transactions end-to-end for Voodoo's games and apps portfolio: draft, negotiate and close agreements with mediation platforms, ad networks, exchanges and SSPs on the sell side, and with ad networks, DSPs, direct advertisers and rewarded platforms on the buy side,including the incentive and rebate agreements (bonuses, UA credits, payment terms), that drive the commercial terms..

- Negotiate agreements with mobile measurement partners, attribution and analytics vendors, data providers and other partners

- Advise on SDK integrations and data flows together with the Privacy team, so contracts match what the tech actually does

- Build our advertising network's contract framework and advertising policies for third-party publishers, advertisers and programmatic partners; negotiate its infrastructure agreements and structure its commercial offers on the legal side

- Manage partner disputes with networks, mediation platforms and other ad tech partners, including reporting discrepancies, invalid traffic (IVT) and compensation claims, from first analysis through negotiated resolution.

- Track and apply platform policy changes and translate them into contract positions and business guidance

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Monetization, UA, Ad Network, Publishing and other product teams, serving as a trusted legal partner who helps the business move with speed and confidence

- Build scalable legal infrastructure-templates, playbooks, fallback positions, contract tooling - that allows the business to operate efficiently as volume grows

Profile

- 5-7 years of relevant legal experience, with meaningful time spent on ad tech and mobile/programmatic advertising, ideally in-house

- Substantive familiarity with ad tech: you understand how mediation, in-app bidding, SDK-based data collection, attribution and device identifiers work at a technical level - not just a conceptual one - and you know who does what along the supply chain

- Transactional experience: you've negotiated agreements with companies across the advertising ecosystem, ideally on both the publisher and advertiser side

- Privacy law fluency: you handle the privacy side of a deal as comfortably as the commercial side

- Industry standards: you know IAB terms and the TCF inside out

- Risk tolerance and business judgment: you're comfortable making calls in the absence of perfect information, offering clear and concise risk framing that avoids unnecessary stalling of the business. You operate like a business partner, not outside counsel

- Strong communication skills: you translate complex legal requirements into plain language for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, and you're comfortable presenting your views succinctly and with confidence

- Autonomy and initiative: you take ownership of your portfolio, identify problems before they escalate, and propose solutions rather than waiting to be directed

- Master 2 in business law, IT/digital law or IP law from a French university or equivalent; avocat or in-house juriste profiles are equally welcome; an LL.M. or study abroad experience is a plus

- Full professional English required

Benefits

- Competitive salary based on experience

- Swile Lunch voucher

- Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

- Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

- Wellness activities in our Paris office

- Remote Fridays

description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. 

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA. If you’re someone who is excited and driven by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

Sales Cycle Ownership 

- Coplan and execute discovery calls to understand customer requirements, their technical environment, and current business challenges.

- Design and deliver compelling demonstrations that solve customer problems, quantify the value of solving those problems, and tell a clear, credible story of how Synthesia solves them better than anything else.

- Understand and overcome technical objections and integration concerns; identify blockers early and develop solution paths with customers.

- Support stakeholder workshops that connect Synthesia to the buyer's broader technology strategy on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

- Partner with Account Executives to define account and deal strategy, advise on competitive positioning, and provide your assessment of opportunity stage and forecast your book of business to leadership.

Demo Excellence 

- Design and execute repeatable Demo methodologies that prove Synthesia’s business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, designing Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

- Identify, build relationships with, and actively empower executive champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

- Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objections, and industry playbooks brought to life directly in Synthesia’s platform.

- Support POC and pilot readouts as a business narrative, not a feature tour, learning to bring storytelling and executive presence to the room as you grow into more senior conversations.

- Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments.

Product & Industry Expertise 

- Maintain deep expertise on Synthesia's platform capabilities across all product lines, roadmap, and positioning to highlight value driving use cases.

- Specific vertical knowledge, establishing credibility as a subject matter expert within an industry to easily build credibility and trust with executive buyers.

- Share customer and prospect product and competitive feedback to the pre-sales leadership and Product team; flag customer pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in live deals.

- Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from current, static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration 

- Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

- Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

- Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

- Enablement: Review and enhance enablement content from what is effective in preparing our team members for client engagements, delivering and evaluating certification as needed to accelerate understanding in the commercial team.

What we are looking for 

- We think the ideal candidate for this role will bring 5+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience at SaaS companies.

- Strong consultative discovery, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with both executive decision-makers (CHRO, CLO, Head of L&D, CTO) and technical audiences (IT, security, developers).

- Technical depth in at least one area: Creation flows, APIs, integrations (LMS, HCM, CRM, identity), security, compliance; willingness to learn quickly across domains.

- Fluency with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message. Comfort translating technical requirements into business value and ROI conversations.

- Consultative approach to problem-solving; comfort gathering requirements, asking clarifying questions, and adapting solutions to customer needs.

- Excellent business and technical presentation skills, in person and remote, and the ability to explain complex AI and integration concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Self-motivated and organized; ability to manage multiple POCs, demos, and customer conversations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

- Collaborative mindset; thrives working with AEs, Product, Customer Success, and other teams to drive customer and company success.

- Product orientation; genuine curiosity about how customers use technology

- Willing to travel; willingness to visit key customers for discovery, executive conversations, and on-site demos.

Location 

We’re ideally looking for someone based in Paris who can spend time in our office at 40 Rue du Colisée, 75008 Paris, or someone based in the UK who can spend time in our London office at 20 Triton Street, Regent’s Place, London NW1 3BF. 👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here .

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

We can work together on completing your skill set.

Benefits

🎳 Monthly socials - as if quarterly company events weren't enough, we also give each office a budget for a monthly social activity (think anything from low-key dinner & drinks through to adventure golf, paddleboarding, bowling, electric darts, trampoline parks and more!)

👚 Laka swag - we'll give you some lovely Laka kit to get you started, including a jumper & t-shirts so you can feel (& look) like part of the family

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
About Nabla 

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role 

We are scaling our healthcare AI platform, with more products, integrations and AI agents, and more protected health information (PHI) flowing through them. To keep pace, we're growing our security engineering team and looking for an exceptional Senior Security Engineer .

Our cloud infrastructure handles highly sensitive healthcare data, so security is core to everything we do. Our engineers already ask the right questions every day: can we use a one-time token here? How long should it live? How do we scope this OAuth Client?

You'll work directly with our Lead Security Engineer to bring real AppSec expertise into the product squads, and to strengthen security well beyond them.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role. About half your time goes to AppSec , but it is deliberately a broad security engineering role, not a pure code-review or pentest job. You'll regularly cross into platform and cloud, CI/CD and detection, and you'll own problems from start to finish. Code scanning, SCA and AI-driven code review are already running, but there is no AppSec process to undo. The threat-modeling practice, the security review loop, the triage rhythm and the secure-by-default libraries don't exist yet. You'll build them and run them.

If you're pragmatic, love working shoulder to shoulder with developers, and want your work to protect patients' most sensitive data, this role is for you.

Responsibilities 

- Partner with the product squads as their go-to security engineer: design reviews, per-feature threat modeling, and fast, opinionated answers on authN/authZ, tokens and session design.

- Secure our authentication and authorization surfaces (OAuth clients, one-time codes, multi-org tenancy, the Core API user API, embedded/postMessage SDKs) and hunt for BOLA, IDOR and broken access control before attackers do.

- Run the code-security findings loop: triage and prioritize results from our SAST, SCA, secrets and IaC scanners and AI-driven code review, route them to the right owners with SLAs, and drive the dependency-vulnerability backlog down, fixing issues yourself when that's faster.

- Secure our AI/LLM features and internal agents, covering prompt injection, tool and permission scoping for autonomous agents, PHI leakage, de-identification assurance and model/API egress.

- Run the external testing program: scope and run pentests (web, mobile, backoffice), validate fixes, operate our vulnerability disclosure program, and stand up a bug bounty.

- Build secure-by-default guardrails (secure coding guidelines, hardened libraries and patterns, pre-commit and PR checks) so the secure path is the easy path.

Qualifications 

- 5 to 8+ years in security engineering, including at least 2 to 3 years in application or product security, or experience as a software engineer with a strong security focus.

- Deep understanding of modern web and API security: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC, session and token design, multi-tenancy, and the OWASP Top 10 and API Top 10. You can find access-control flaws by reading code.

- Strong coder, comfortable reading and fixing production code (mostly Kotlin and Python, plus web, mobile and desktop clients) and automating in Python.

- Experience running threat modeling and security design reviews, and operating SAST, SCA and secrets scanning in CI with a real triage loop, not just a dashboard.

- Genuine breadth: comfortable moving between an API design review, a supply-chain hardening PR and an incident in the same week, and honest about what you don't know yet.

- Excellent communicator who earns developers' trust and works well with engineering, compliance and IT.

- Full professional fluency in French and English (oral and written).

Nice to have: LLM / AI agent security, mobile app security, pentest or bug bounty experience, GCP / GKE, or experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.

Life at Nabla 

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed. 

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off . We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla 

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel 

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble 

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift 

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity 

We recognize the ongoing challenge of diversity in tech. Our responsibility starts with fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels empowered to be their authentic selves and do their best work.

Diversity & Inclusion 

Diversity and inclusivity are fundamental values at Nabla. We embrace individuals from various backgrounds, including race, gender, educational history, sexual orientation, and beyond.

As an equal opportunity employer, we actively seek out and welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, believing that a wide range of perspectives enriches our team and enhances our ability to innovate and thrive.

Avoid recruitment scams: Stay safe and informed

There is an active employment and financial scam which uses Nabla to collect personal information. If you’re contacted by a Nabla recruiter, please ensure they are utilizing a nabla.com email address. We will never ask for the exchange of any money or credit card details during the recruitment process. Nabla utilizes a hiring platform for all applications; please be aware of any suspicious email activity. You can find more information following this link .

Nabla does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruiters or employment agencies in response to the Nabla Careers page or a Nabla social media post. Any unsolicited CVs, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Nabla.

Votre mission est majoritairement axée sur la conception mécanique en CAO, avec une fabrication des pièces essentiellement en impression 3D. Ponctuellement, vous intervenez sur l'intégration et le dimensionnement de l'électronique embarquée afin de valider les prototypes de bout en bout, de la modélisation aux premiers essais. Vous contribuez ensuite à la mise en production des produits validés (DFM, optimisations, gammes de montage, schémas de câblage).

Missions principales 

Conception CAO (cœur de mission : 55%) 

- Concevoir et modéliser sous Fusion 360 des pièces et sous-ensembles mécaniques : structures, carters, supports, fixations, interfaces de charges utiles, …

- Intégrer dès la conception les contraintes de la fabrication additive FDM : orientation, épaisseurs, jeux et tolérances d'assemblage, inserts, limitation des supports

- Faire évoluer rapidement les designs à partir des retours d'impression et d'essais (cycles d'itération courts)

- Réaliser les assemblages, et assurer la gestion des versions des fichiers CAO

Prototypage rapide (5%) 

Enchaîner des cycles courts conception → impression 3D → test → correction pour valider rapidement les choix techniques

- Analyser les résultats d'essais et les retours terrain afin d'orienter les itérations suivantes

- Préparer les impressions sous OrcaSlicer et assembler les prototypes dans un objectif d’amélioration continue

Industrialisation et mise en production (30%) 

- Faire évoluer les prototypes validés vers une version industrialisable en appliquant les principes DFM / DFA (conception pour la fabrication et l'assemblage)

- Optimiser les pièces et sous-ensembles : masse, coût, nombre de pièces, temps de fabrication, choix des procédés et matériaux de série

- Participer à la rédaction les gammes de montage et les instructions d'assemblage

- Réaliser les schémas de câblage et la documentation électrique associée

- Constituer le dossier de définition du produit : plans, nomenclatures, tolérances

Intégration et dimensionnement électronique (5%) 

- Participer au choix et au dimensionnement des composants embarqués (motorisation, ESC, batteries, contrôleur de vol, capteurs, câblage) selon les contraintes du prototype : masse, encombrement, consommation, thermique

- Prévoir dans la CAO l'implantation des cartes et composants, le passage des câbles, le refroidissement et l'accessibilité pour la maintenance

- Assembler, câbler et réaliser les premiers tests d'intégration pour valider le fonctionnement des prototypes

- Configurer et paramétrer les systèmes via Mission Planner (calibrations, paramètres, check avant vols)

Essais et documentation (5%) 

- Participer aux essais de validation : tests au banc, tests au sol et, le cas échéant, essais en vol encadrés

- Documenter les conceptions, les choix techniques et les résultats d'essais

- Présenter régulièrement l'avancement de ses travaux à l'équipe technique

Profil recherché 

Formation 

- Étudiant(e) de niveau Bac+3 à Bac+5 (école d'ingénieurs, licence professionnelle, master) en conception mécanique, génie mécanique, mécatronique ou équivalent

- Stage (idéalement de fin d'études) 

Compétences techniques 

- Très bonne maîtrise d'un logiciel de CAO 3D, idéalement Autodesk Fusion

- Connaissance des règles de conception pour l'impression 3D FDM ; la pratique d'OrcaSlicer (ou d'un autre slicer) est appréciée

- Notions de résistance des matériaux, de tolérancement et de choix des matériaux (PLA, PETG, ASA, nylon, composites chargés)

- Bases en électronique embarquée : lecture de schémas, alimentation et puissance, dimensionnement de composants, soudure et câblage

Atouts 

- Connaissance du monde des drones (multirotors, voilure fixe, ArduPilot / PX4) est un gros plus

- Notions d'aérodynamique (portance, traînée, profils, hélices) est un plus

- Profil mécatronique, capable de faire le lien entre mécanique, électronique et logiciel

- Projets personnels ou associatifs en drone, robotique ou impression 3D

- Un intérêt pour les environnements aéronautique, spatial ou défense est apprécié

Qualités personnelles 

- Curiosité et goût pour le prototypage et le travail « hands-on »

- Rigueur et sens du détail, indispensables dans un contexte défense où la fiabilité des pièces est critique

- Autonomie, force de proposition et capacité à travailler en équipe

title: Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights
description:
We are growing! We are currently looking to hire a Director, Luxury Market Intelligence & Insights . 

About CXG: 

Founded in 2006, CXG is a global customer experience company uniquely positioned at the intersection of data-driven retail performance, customer experience transformation, and operational execution across 200+ luxury brands worldwide.

The mission of our 270 collaborators is to help brands transform customer and employee experiences through tailored insights, strategy, and implementation.

We are passionate about delivering impact.

Our clients include the world's most admired luxury houses, and our solutions combine research, technology, and human expertise to elevate every customer interaction.

We are looking for a thought leadership expert with the editorial vision to spot what matters next, the conviction to shape CXG's point of view, and the writing talent to make it influential across luxury retail, beauty and cosmetics, watches and jewellery, automotive, and hospitality.

Context and role 

Reporting to the Chief of Staff, you will lead CXG's Thought Leadership and Market Intelligence functions. You will define the topics on which CXG should have a distinctive and credible point of view, turn CXG's proprietary data, expertise and market knowledge into original external content, and position the company ahead of emerging developments in customer experience, luxury and its priority verticals.

This is a hands-on role: you will research, analyse, write and produce content yourself, while mobilising expertise and data from across the business. You will be accountable for ensuring that every publication presents a recognisable CXG angle rather than simply reporting market developments or repeating established industry views. You will manage one Market Intelligence team member.

Thought Leadership Development 

- Define the thought leadership strategy and roadmap, including priority themes, target audiences, formats and a realistic publication calendar.
- Drive and coordinate content creation across Practices, Solutions and Regions.
- Work closely with Practices, Regions and Solutions to: 
- Push: scan for trends and hot topics and ensure CXG has a voice and perspective, commenting regularly on these subjects.
- Pull: identify and collect new ideas and proposed topics from the relevant stakeholders, prioritise and incorporate them into the thought leadership roadmap.
- Use market intelligence, CXG's proprietary data, internal expertise and client-facing insights to identify emerging topics early, develop a clear CXG point of view and decide where CXG can make a credible contribution to the conversation.
- Research, interview internal experts, write and edit articles, perspectives and other thought leadership content directly. Challenge generic claims and ensure each piece advances a clear argument and is supported by credible evidence.
- Ensure that analysis is methodologically sound, appropriately contextualised and presented without compromising client confidentiality.
- Develop topics that connect expertise across Practices and Regions, while reflecting relevant differences between markets.
Thought Leadership Communication 

- Ensure relevant thought leadership pieces (e.g., perspectives, publications) are disseminated on a periodic basis.
- Work with Marketing on the publication, distribution and promotion of content, while retaining ownership of the editorial strategy, substance, quality and consistency of CXG's point of view. In addition, collaborate with Marketing to maximise impact by communicating through the channels relevant to each market.
- Track the reach, engagement and qualitative response generated by CXG's thought leadership, as well as relevant business enquiries influenced by published content. Use the findings to refine the roadmap.
- Shape and host or contribute to CXG's podcast "The Luxury Edit", working with internal experts and guests to develop topics, prepare interviews and turn conversations into useful content.
- Develop the content and key messages for CXG-hosted events and external conferences, panels and talks; act as a CXG speaker where appropriate; and work with internal experts to prepare other CXG speakers and turn the company's point of view into compelling presentations and discussion topics.
- Look for and test new thought leadership formats (e.g., interactive reports, data visualisations, short-form video, newsletters, social-first content) to broaden reach, engage new audiences and keep CXG's content distinctive.
- Identify and build collaborations with conferences, specialised industry magazines and universities (e.g., content partnerships, guest articles, co-branded publications, joint research, guest lectures, speaking slots) to extend CXG's visibility and credibility with target audiences.
Market Intelligence 

- Keep abreast of market and competitive developments and ensure relevant findings are communicated across CXG.
- Translate these findings into clear implications for CXG's strategic priorities, client conversations, commercial opportunities and external thought leadership.
- Contribute market intelligence, evidence and relevant CXG perspectives to priority proposals and client deliverables, working with Practices, Solutions and Regions to strengthen the quality and relevance of the final output.
- Manage and develop the Market Intelligence team member, setting clear priorities and reviewing the quality and usefulness of their work.
Competitive Analysis 

- Develop and continuously update a list of CXG competitors.
- Research competitor performance, including revenues and market share where reliable information is available.
- Identify and assess the impact of new competitors' offerings.
- Review competitors' thought leadership, influence and presence.
- Identify gaps in the conversations competitors are leading and opportunities for CXG to establish a distinct position.
Industry Analysis 

- Research and review clients' developments (e.g., new strategy, launch of new product or service, restructuring, M&A, key managerial appointments).
- Track public financial announcements (e.g., quarterly and annual earnings).
- Monitor developments in luxury, retail, customer experience and adjacent sectors; distinguish lasting shifts from short-lived topics and explain their implications for CXG and its clients.
- Publish the weekly "This Week in Luxury" news brief and issue timely flash updates when significant developments require immediate attention, such as financial announcements, major transactions or leadership changes.
Internal Dissemination and Application 

- Synthesise research and findings into concise, actionable outputs tailored to the needs of relevant internal stakeholders. Feed findings into the Thought Leadership roadmap.
- Proactively bring relevant market signals to Practices, Regions and leadership early enough to inform decisions, client conversations and potential cross-practice opportunities.
- Disseminate new thought leadership across CXG and equip Practices, Regions and client-facing teams with the key messages and supporting materials needed to use it in client conversations and commercial activities.
Requirements 

What will you bring along? 

- Proven experience developing thought leadership, editorial content or insight-led communications in a consulting, research, customer experience, retail or luxury environment.
- Excellent English writing and editing skills, with a portfolio demonstrating original, well-argued, evidence-led articles or publications written personally. If possible, include examples that turn proprietary research, data or specialist expertise into a distinctive point of view. Additional languages (e.g., French, Mandarin) are a plus.
- Strong oral communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to represent CXG as a speaker at conferences, panels and client events.
- Proven ability to build relationships and influence senior stakeholders across functions and regions without direct authority.
- An established network or demonstrated ability to build partnerships with media, conference organisers, academic institutions or industry bodies.
- Comfort working with quantitative data and research methods, and the ability to translate data into clear, credible narratives and visualisations.
- Ability to define and track content performance indicators and use them to refine editorial priorities.
- Strong research and analytical skills: able to assess sources critically, connect market signals and form a clear point of view rather than simply summarise trends.
- Familiarity with AI-assisted research and content tools, used with appropriate rigour.
- Sound knowledge of luxury, retail and customer experience, and curiosity about how these sectors are evolving across markets.
- Ability to interview senior experts, challenge ideas constructively and turn specialist knowledge into accessible, credible content.
- Comfort working independently in a remote setting, managing an editorial roadmap and delivering finished work without a large production team.
- Experience managing or coaching at least one team member.
- Confidence preparing and hosting interviews or podcasts is a plus.

Nous réinventons la réputation pour en faire un véritable atout concurrentiel. Burson est le gardien de votre réputation, le partenaire qui vous guide dans un environnement complexe.

Réalisation de veilles (institutionnelles, revue de presse, réseaux sociaux, sensibles)

Cartographies de parties prenantes

Suivi législatif (compte-rendu d’auditions, examen de textes, suivi du dépôt d’amendements)

Recherche d’informations et notes de contexte et d’analyse

Rédaction de notes de briefing et de préparation aux rendez-vous institutionnels ou presse

Aide à la préparation des réunions clients

Télétravail possible et éligibilité à la prime de télétravail (10€/mois)

Forfait mobilité durable (45,40€/mois)

- 
Prise en charge des repas au restaurant d’entreprise (reste à charge de 3,70€)

- 
1 jour de RTT par mois

- 
Accès aux offres du comité d’entreprise (cinéma, culture, sport…)

- 
Prime de cooptation

Profil recherché :

M1, M2, année de césure, en communication, affaires publiques, sciences politiques, relations internationales, écoles de commerce… Convention de stage obligatoire

Impliqué.e, curieux.se, autonome, sens du travail en équipe

- 
Capacités de rédaction analytique et synthétique

- 
Intérêt pour l’actualité politico-économique

- 
Intérêt pour les institutions françaises, le processus législatif (navette parlementaire, prérogatives et fonctionnement du Parlement) et l’actualité gouvernementale.

Intérêt pour découvrir des secteurs et des missions éclectiques

- 
Anglais lu, écrit et parlé (plusieurs missions peuvent être en anglais)

Le débriefing de cet exercice se fera directement pendant l’entretien.

title: Customer Care Specialist
description:
Making preventive health the default for every human in Europe 

The mission 

At Lucis , we believe healthcare should be preventive, not reactive. We’re building the OS for human longevity to help people add more healthy years to their lives. You can read more about who we are and how we work here .

The role 

Health is complex, personal, and deeply important to our members. As the voice of Lucis clients, you support them throughout their health journey and own member happiness end to end.

With rapid member growth, we are hiring our first dedicated Customer Care Team Lead . You will own the member experience end-to-end, stabilize our operational metrics, and build and manage a world-class support team.

What you will own 

- Member support: Resolve member and lab partner inquiries via chat, email and phone, with warmth, precision and a sense of urgency.

- Phone-first when it matters: Pick up the phone whenever a situation calls for a human voice: a delayed result, a stressful moment, a confused member.

- Know your boundaries: Work hand in hand with our medical team and know exactly when to escalate a health question rather than answer it yourself.

- Voice of the member: Spot recurring issues and turn them into clear, structured feedback for the product and ops teams.

- Contribute to projects: Take part in initiatives that improve the member experience, like rebuilding our Help Center, designing proactive care for lab delays, or automating repetitive workflows with AI.

About you 

You’re passionate about the future of human health and want your work to help people stay healthy for longer. You move quickly from idea to execution, take full ownership of what you build, and work best with talented people who care as much as you do.

You thrive in fast‑moving environments, learn by doing, and value feedback as a way to continuously improve. You use AI the way others use a calculator: naturally, to go faster and think bigger.

You’ll fit in well if 

- Experience: 1+ years in B2C customer care, support, hospitality, or any role where you dealt directly with customers. Strong recent graduates with relevant experience are welcome too.

- Bilingual: Fluent in both English and French, written and spoken.

- People-first energy: You bring genuine warmth and empathy to every interaction, and you turn routine support into memorable experiences.

- Rigorous precision: Exceptional attention to detail, with zero tolerance for misquotes, wrong information or operational errors. In health, accuracy is care.

- Builder mindset: When something breaks twice, your instinct is to fix the root cause, not just the ticket.

Nice to have 

- Support tooling: You've used Intercom or similar support tools.

- AI automation: You've already used AI tools to automate part of your work.

- Startup mindset: You thrive in early-stage environments with high autonomy, rapid execution and clear communication.

The process 

- Intro call, culture & role fit (20 min)

- Case study interview (30-60 min)

- Deep dive and team chat, on-site (2 hours)

- Reference calls

How we work 

We work together from our Paris hub. We’re passionate about what we’re building and believe the fastest way to create something exceptional is side by side. We’re open to relocation support for the right individuals, and we welcome missionaries who travel to work with us in Paris on a regular basis.

- Rigor without ego: Audits, science, and code all deserve the same high bar.

- Radical ownership: Feedback loops are short; everyone contributes to building the best version of Lucis.

- Velocity over perfection: We ship daily and prefer a good decision today over a perfect one next week.

title: Head of Security
description:
About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. title: Finance Manager, Financial Control & Accounting
description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. 

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. 

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. 

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 

💰 Our Finance team 

The Finance team ensures Joko's financial health and long-term success. We manage everything from financial planning and accounting to financing and cash management.

We make sure every euro is put to its best use, working closely with all teams, we provide the insights and structure needed to scale efficiently.

As we scale, we're splitting Finance into three specialized poles: FP&A , Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) , and Procurement . This role anchors Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) — the pole that keeps Joko's financial information accurate, timely, and audit-ready. You'll report directly to Quentin, our COO .

✨ Why this role is special 

Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) is a brand-new specialized pole at Joko — previously bundled into a single generalist Finance Manager role. You'll be the first person to own this scope end to end, with direct visibility to the COO and VP Finance with real influence over how the function is built as the company scales past 200 people across multiple geographies.

- You set the standards, not just follow them: as the pole's first hire, the processes, controls, and calendar you establish now become the backbone the rest of Finance builds on.

- A true partner in automation: you'll work hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated — this isn't a role where you're expected to grind through manual work alone.

- International scope from day one: France, the US, and future markets — you'll help build the multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as Joko expands.

🎯 What you will do 

As Finance Manager, Finance Operations (Financial Control & Accounting) , your main mission is to own the reliability, timeliness, and completeness of Joko's financial information. Rather than doing the bookkeeping — we have an external accounting partner for that — you set the standards, drive the calendar, and hold your internal and external stakeholders accountable.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Drive the closing calendar: own the monthly and annual closing calendar, holding our external accounting partner and auditors to a high standard;

- Own our legal reporting package: make sure the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement are always accurate and delivered on time;

- Oversee AP/AR end to end: keep invoicing, payment runs, and collections under control;

- Lead our international accounting build-out: as we open new entities and markets, including our IFRS consolidation framework;

- Own cash management: reconciliation, yield optimization, and day-to-day treasury;

- Be the main point of contact for our banking and accounting partners , and a key interface for auditors as we scale toward IPO readiness;

- Continuously strengthen and document our financial processes and controls , working hand-in-hand with a dedicated BizOps partner to automate what can be automated, making everything more robust and less error-prone as the company scales.

👀 Who we're looking for 

- Experience: 4–8 years, with a strong foundation in accounting or audit (Big 4 or equivalent), ideally combined with in-house experience in a scale-up.

- Education: A master's degree from a top business school. A double degree in accounting (DCG/DSCG) is a plus.

- Financial rigor: Deep understanding of French GAAP and treasury fundamentals — you bring the same discipline to a closing cycle as you do to a cash position.

- International mindset: Excited to build a multi-entity, multi-country accounting backbone as we expand; IFRS exposure is a plus.

- Stakeholder management: You build trust with partners inside and outside Joko, and you're comfortable holding them accountable.

- Problem solving: You dig into the root cause and fix things.

- AI centricity: You use AI in your daily work today, and you're excited to help automate reporting and reconciliation as part of Joko's AI-first finance ambition.

- Languages: Fluent French and English.

💎 Our perks 

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only) 

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

- Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

- Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

- 💸 Top-market compensation

- 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

- 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

- 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

- 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

- 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

- …and much more, check the full list here !

🤝 Our hiring process 

- Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

- Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

- Step 2 – Role-specific assessments 

- For non-engineering roles : A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

- For engineering roles : A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

- Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

- References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €61.5K – €84K

The Senior Machine Learning Engineer, ML Platform is responsible for building, running, and evolving the ML monorepo used by the X-ray, CT, and MRI machine learning group at DeepHealth. The monorepo covers the full path from experimentation to product: dataset and sample definitions, training and evaluation code, experiment tracking, model export, and the inference servers that run in production. Everyone on the team contributes to the monorepo; this role is the single point of accountability for it. This hands-on role owns the architecture, tooling, and engineering standards of that codebase for a distributed team of about twenty machine learning engineers and scientists, working with model developers and software engineers to make the team’s work fast, better, and easier to audit. It also leads the team's agentic coding strategy, shaping how AI coding agents are used across the codebase. The role reports to the Leader of the ML for X-ray/CT/MRI group.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

- Own the architecture and roadmap of the ML Monorepo: 

- Module boundaries, shared abstractions for datasets and samples, training and evaluation loops, configuration, and experiment tracking.

- Build and run the engineering tooling around the codebase: 

- Continuous integration, testing, dependency management, containers, artifact and model registries, and GPU job scheduling on cloud (GCP) and HPC infrastructure.

- Own the path from trained checkpoint to deployable model: 

- Model packaging, inference servers with enforced API contracts, reproducibility, and performance and memory budgets on target hardware.

- Define and enforce engineering standards (code review, testing, documentation) in a way that accelerates research rather than slowing it down.

- Ensure traceability of data, code, and model versions across experiments and releases.

- Investigate and resolve performance, reliability, and usability issues in the stack raised by the team and reduce their recurrence through shared tooling.

- Drive the team's agentic coding strategy: define how AI coding agents are used in the monorepo, set up the tooling, guardrails, and conventions that make them effective, and help colleagues adopt them.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time. 

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

- Strong Python skills and software engineering fundamentals: API design, testing, refactoring, and attention to developer experience (required).

- Solid PyTorch knowledge and practical experience with model training and profiling (required).

- Experience running ML workloads on a cloud platform, ideally GCP (Vertex AI, Artifact Registry, IAM, storage), and with containerization (required).

- Ability to work closely with researchers, translate recurring pain points into shared tooling, and push back constructively when needed (required).

title: Staff Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. 

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1917 

The Role: 

We are looking for a Staff QA Engineer to join our team building post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for HSM and network-appliance products. You will own product-level quality assurance: the system test plans, automation and compliance test execution that stand between an engineering release and a product customers can trust. In a security product, QA is not an afterthought; it is part of the evidence.

Responsibilities :

You will define and execute system-level test plans for FPGA-based cryptographic products: functional, performance, stress, stability and negative testing across the full stack, from hardware through firmware and drivers to cryptographic APIs. You will build and maintain the automated QA infrastructure (regression suites, hardware-in-the-loop test benches, CI integration, results dashboards), execute standards-based compliance test campaigns (NIST ACVP/CAVP test vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence runs, CNSA 2.0 checklists and standard FPGA compliance tests) together with our verification and security engineers, run interoperability testing against protocol stacks and customer-representative configurations, own defect tracking and triage, and define the release-qualification criteria for every product release.

- Own system-level QA of cryptographic hardware products: test plans, automation, execution and release qualification

- Execute standards and compliance test campaigns (ACVP/CAVP vectors, FIPS 140-3 evidence, CNSA 2.0 and FPGA compliance tests) as part of the certification effort

Requirements: 

We are looking for a candidate with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience) and at least five years in quality assurance or system test of embedded, hardware or networking products. You have built test automation in Python or similar, integrated it into CI, and worked hands-on with lab equipment and hardware-in-the-loop setups.

Exposure to security or compliance testing (FIPS, Common Criteria, or telecom/industrial certification regimes) is a strong plus, as is experience testing cryptographic or networking functionality. You are rigorous, methodical and precise in documentation, because in this product your test reports become certification evidence. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

- Experienced system-test/QA engineer for embedded or hardware products with strong automation skills

- Compliance or security test experience and meticulous documentation habits are strong advantages

Preferred Qualifications: 

You take professional pride in being the last line of defence before a release, you like breaking things methodically so customers never do, and you enjoy the extra weight QA carries when the product is a security device.

Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment. 

At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

In dieser Rolle arbeitest du zu 100 % im Homeoffice. Du konzentrierst dich voll und ganz auf die direkte, virtuelle Betreuung sowie den engen interdisziplinären Austausch mit unserem medizinischen Fachpersonal (Ärztinnen und Ärzte, Psychotherapeut/-innen sowie Medizinische Praxisassistent/-innen).

- Interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit: Aktive Teilnahme an regelmässigen Fallbesprechungen und Rapporten mit Ärztinnen, Ärzten, Psychotherapeut/-innen und MPAs zur Sicherung einer ganzheitlichen Patientenversorgung.

Das bringst du mit 

- Qualifikation: Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Ernährungswissenschaften / Ernährungsberatung (FH oder Bachelor BFH / FFHS) oder eine entsprechende Schweizer SRK-Anerkennung eines ausländischen Diploms.

- Bewilligung: Eine gültige Berufsausübungsbewilligung (BAB) für deinen Wohnkanton ab dem ersten Arbeitstag.

Operating at the intersection of data science, software engineering, and cloud infrastructure, you will build the foundations and ensure that our ML systems are scalable, reproducible, and production ready.

In this role, you will design, implement, and continuously improve a cloud-agnostic data and ML platform that supports multiple products and teams. You will be responsible for platform reliability, scalability, and cost-efficiency, while providing data scientists and ML engineers with the tools and infrastructure to efficiently develop, train, validate, and deploy machine learning models. You will serve as a technical bridge between the data science and IT/infrastructure teams, translating requirements into robust and maintainable systems.

This role includes ownership of an existing vendor-delivered platform and its evolution into a fully automated, reproducible, and multi-product ML platform.

- Design, implement, and maintain the data and ML platform infrastructure, including systems for data ingestion, storage, processing, and training.

- Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform) and automated deployments.

- Experience with ML platforms and tools (MLflow, Feast, DVC, DataHub or equivalent).

- Experience with AWS Sagemaker or Google Vertex AI platforms.

- Experience with databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, InfluxDB or equivalent).

- Experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitLab CI).

- Programming skills in Python.

- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana).

- Understanding of DevOps and MLOps practices.

- Ability to work across teams and translate requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions.

Nice to Have: 

- Knowledge of data governance, IAM, and security frameworks.

- Familiarity with multi-tenant or multi-product platform architectures.

- Experience working with EU data compliance constraints in energy, maritime or defense.
