title: Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter
description:
Bouw mee aan recruitment voor een hoogwaardige tech consultancy

Senior tech professionals vinden vraagt meer dan vacatures publiceren en sollicitaties beoordelen. De beste kandidaten zijn vaak niet actief op zoek. Je moet weten waar je ze vindt, hoe je ze benadert en hoe je ze enthousiast maakt voor een inhoudelijk gesprek. 

Bij Conflux zoeken we daarom een Senior Corporate Tech Recruiter die recruitment en sourcing beheerst. Iemand die zelfstandig de arbeidsmarkt benadert, hiring managers adviseert en verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor het volledige recruitmentproces. 

Conflux is een Nederlandse tech consultancy met gespecialiseerde expertise binnen onder andere Data & AI, Software Development, Cloud en Platform Engineering. Onze consultants werken aan complexe technische vraagstukken en behoren inhoudelijk tot de ervaren professionals binnen hun vakgebied. 

Dat betekent dat onze recruitment vraagstukken niet eenvoudig zijn. We zoeken onder andere Senior Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, Java Developers, Kubernetes Engineers, Platform Engineers en Front-end Developers. 

Daarvoor zoeken we een recruiter die zijn of haar vak verstaat.

Wat je gaat doen 

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de werving van ervaren technische consultants binnen onder andere: 

- Data Engineering & AI 

- Machine Learning 

- Java Development 

- Kubernetes & Cloud Native 

- Cloud & Platform Engineering 

- Front-end Development 

Je beheert het recruitmentproces van arbeidsmarktanalyse en sourcing tot selectie en aanbieding. 

Concreet betekent dit dat je: 

- actief technische professionals sourcet en benadert, onder andere via LinkedIn Recruiter en andere sourcingkanalen; 

- zelfstandig searches en sourcingstrategieën ontwikkelt voor moeilijk vindbare doelgroepen; 

- kandidaten screent op ervaring, technische context, motivatie en consultancy-fit; 

- hiring managers adviseert over doelgroep, haalbaarheid, arbeidsmarkt, selectiecriteria en recruitmentaanpak; 

- kandidaten gedurende het volledige proces begeleidt en zorgt voor een professionele en persoonlijke candidate experience; 

- interview- en selectieprocessen bewaakt en waar nodig bijstuurt; 

- talentpools opbouwt en relaties onderhoudt met relevante professionals; 

- data en recruitmentinzichten gebruikt om keuzes en prioriteiten te onderbouwen; 

- externe recruitmentpartners inzet wanneer dit aantoonbaar waarde toevoegt; 

- kansen signaleert om recruitment slimmer, sneller en effectiever te organiseren.

Ongeveer 85% van je tijd ben je bezig met recruitment en sourcing. De overige tijd gebruik je om recruitment verder te professionaliseren, bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van tooling, data, processen, arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, AI of nieuwe sourcingmethoden. 

Je bent daarmee niet alleen verantwoordelijk voor vacatures, maar mede-eigenaar van hoe recruitment binnen Conflux wordt uitgevoerd en ontwikkeld. 

We zoeken nadrukkelijk een ervaren tech recruiter die zelfstandig kan opereren in een markt waarin kandidaten schaars zijn en actief gevonden en overtuigd moeten worden.

Dit breng je mee

- Minimaal 6 jaar professionele recruitmentervaring. 

- Minimaal 4 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met IT- of tech recruitment. 

- Ervaring met het zelfstandig werven van ervaren of senior technische professionals. 

- Aantoonbare ervaring met active sourcing en direct search. 

- Je weet hoe je een technische doelgroep analyseert en vertaalt naar een effectieve search- en benaderingsstrategie. 

- Je kunt inhoudelijk voldoende meepraten over technische rollen en begrijpt het verschil tussen bijvoorbeeld software engineering, data engineering, machine learning, cloud en platform engineering. 

- Je bent ervaren met LinkedIn Recruiter en weet dat goede sourcing verder gaat dan alleen LinkedIn. 

- Je bent een stevige gesprekspartner voor hiring managers en durft recruitmentvraagstukken kritisch te benaderen. 

- Je kunt zelfstandig prioriteiten bepalen en meerdere complexe vacatures tegelijkertijd managen. 

- Je combineert snelheid met kwaliteit en houdt grip op voortgang en candidate experience. 

- Je spreekt en schrijft professioneel Nederlands en Engels. 

Ervaring met recruitment binnen tech consultancy, IT-dienstverlening, detachering of een vergelijkbare kennisintensieve omgeving is van toegevoegde waarde.

Wie jij bent

Je hebt weinig dagelijkse aansturing nodig. Je ziet waar recruitment stagneert, onderzoekt waarom en komt met oplossingen. 

Je wacht niet alleen op sollicitanten, maar gaat zelf de markt in. 

Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe sourcingmethoden, tooling en technologie en experimenteert graag met manieren om moeilijk bereikbare kandidaten toch te vinden. 

Tegelijkertijd begrijp je dat recruitment uiteindelijk draait om mensen. Je bouwt relaties op, communiceert duidelijk en zorgt ervoor dat kandidaten ook bij een afwijzing een professionele ervaring hebben. 

Waarom Conflux?

Je komt terecht in een organisatie waarin recruitment dicht op de business zit. De lijnen met hiring managers en directie zijn kort en er is ruimte om vanuit jouw expertise invloed uit te oefenen op hoe we recruitment organiseren.

Je krijgt: 

- veel zelfstandigheid en vertrouwen; 

- directe invloed op recruitmentstrategie en sourcing; 

- ruimte om nieuwe sourcingmethoden en tooling te introduceren; 

- inhoudelijk sterke collega's binnen verschillende technische disciplines; 

- korte lijnen met hiring managers en directie; 

- ruimte om recruitmentprocessen daadwerkelijk te verbeteren.

Wat we bieden 

- Een salaris van €4.600 tot €5.900 bruto per maand op fulltime basis, afhankelijk van ervaring. 

- Vakantiegeld ter hoogte van 8% 

- Een bonusregeling op basis van persoonlijke en bedrijfsdoelstellingen. 

- Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, inzetbaar voor bijvoorbeeld een elektrische auto, declaraties of bruto uitbetaling. 

- Een maandelijkse pensioenbijdrage. 

- Een dienstverband van minimaal 32 uur per week, met voorkeur voor 36 of 40 uur. 

- Laptop en telefoon. 

- Regelmatig gezamenlijke activiteiten en evenementen. 

- Een hybride werkomgeving met kantoor in Utrecht.

We werken flexibel, maar recruitment is bij Conflux nadrukkelijk een vak waarbij relaties belangrijk zijn. Daarom verwachten we dat je regelmatig op kantoor in Utrecht aanwezig bent om nauw samen te werken met hiring managers, consultants en collega's.

Proces

We maken graag kennis met je. Daarbij kijken we niet alleen of jij bij Conflux past, maar ook of Conflux aansluit bij de manier waarop jij recruitment wilt bedrijven. 

- Je solliciteert met je cv. 

- In het eerste gesprek maak je kennis met de recruiters met wie je gaat samenwerken. We bespreken daarbij nadrukkelijk je ervaring met tech recruitment, sourcing en stakeholdermanagement. 

- In het tweede gesprek ontmoet je de directie en gaan we verder in op wederzijdse verwachtingen en jouw visie op recruitment. 

Zijn we daarna allebei enthousiast? Dan volgt een aanbieding en kun je samen met ons verder bouwen aan recruitment binnen Conflux.

Wat maakt deze rol interessant?

Ons Data & AI-team in Nederland groeit. Daardoor stap je niet in een omgeving waarin alles al jarenlang vastligt. Je krijgt juist de ruimte om mee te denken over hoe we werken, welke expertise we verder ontwikkelen en welke oplossingen we als team naar klanten brengen.

Je kunt je binnen projecten inhoudelijk verdiepen, maar hoeft je niet te beperken tot alleen het bouwen van modellen. Als je het leuk vindt om klanten te adviseren, collega’s te begeleiden of mee te bouwen aan nieuwe proposities, dan is daar ruimte voor.

Ook werk je samen met ervaren Data Engineers, AI-specialisten, consultants en architecten. En doordat adesso onderdeel is van een internationale organisatie met meer dan 11.000 collega’s in Europa, kun je ook expertise buiten Nederland benutten.

Je krijgt dus niet alleen een volgende Data Science-opdracht, maar de mogelijkheid om invloed te hebben op hoe we Data & AI binnen adesso verder ontwikkelen.

Data Science die echt wordt gebruikt

De projecten waaraan we werken verschillen behoorlijk.

Een voorbeeld is een Data Science-team binnen de fitnessbranche dat wordt geleid door een collega van adesso. Daar wordt met Computer Vision en Machine Learning gewerkt aan het automatisch herkennen van afwijkende en mogelijk gevaarlijke situaties in onbemande 24/7-locaties.

Denk aan een geweldsincident, iemand die onwel wordt of iemand die ongeoorloofd toegang probeert te krijgen. Door dit soort situaties sneller te herkennen, kan er eerder worden gereageerd.

Het laat goed zien waar we binnen Data & AI naartoe willen: niet alleen experimenteren met technologie, maar oplossingen ontwikkelen die in de praktijk worden ingezet en daar daadwerkelijk iets toevoegen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Senior Data Scientist werk je aan verschillende klantvraagstukken. Soms begint dat met het onderzoeken of Machine Learning überhaupt de juiste oplossing is. In een ander project stap je in wanneer een model verder ontwikkeld of naar productie gebracht moet worden. Ook toepassingen rondom generatieve AI spelen steeds vaker een rol.

Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met klanten en met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines.

In de praktijk houd je je onder andere bezig met:

- begeleiden van Data Science- en AI-trajecten van vraagstuk tot implementatie;

- vertalen van businessvragen naar concrete toepassingen van Machine Learning en AI;

- ontwikkelen, testen en verbeteren van Machine Learning-modellen;

- begeleiden van junior en medior Data Scientists;

- delen van kennis binnen het team;

- meedenken over nieuwe oplossingen, standaarden en proposities binnen Data & AI.

Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid in je werk. We verwachten niet dat je alles zelf doet, maar wel dat je verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor je projecten en makkelijk de samenwerking zoekt wanneer dat nodig is.

Wat neem je mee?

Voor ons hoeft een Senior Data Scientist niet ieder platform, framework of product al gebruikt te hebben. We zoeken vooral iemand met een stevige basis die begrijpt hoe je van een Data Science-vraagstuk tot een werkende oplossing komt.

We denken aan iemand met minimaal vijf jaar relevante ervaring als Data Scientist of in een vergelijkbare rol.

Daarnaast helpt het als je:

- een sterke basis hebt in Machine Learning, statistiek en modelontwikkeling;

- ruime ervaring hebt met Python;

- bekend bent met MLOps en software development-principes zoals Git, CI/CD, containers en dependency management;

- praktische ervaring hebt met generatieve AI en Large Language Models;

- makkelijk schakelt tussen techniek en de vraag van een klant;

- complexe onderwerpen helder kunt uitleggen;

Heb je daarnaast ervaring met bijvoorbeeld PyTorch, TensorFlow, Databricks, Snowflake of dbt, dan komt dat goed van pas. We vinden het belangrijker dat je begrijpt wanneer en waarom je bepaalde technologie inzet dan dat je ieder platform al beheerst.

Werken bij adesso

Bij adesso Nederland werk je in een omgeving met korte lijnen. Je krijgt ruimte om je werk op je eigen manier in te richten, ideeën aan te dragen en verantwoordelijkheid te pakken.

Daarbij vinden we het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. In de richting die bij jou past. Dat kan technisch zijn, maar bijvoorbeeld ook richting architectuur, consultancy, inhoudelijk leiderschap of het verder ontwikkelen van onze Data & AI-propositie.

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet ieder punt in deze vacature af te kunnen vinken.

title: Quereinstieg Hörakustik
description:
Hörakustik Branche – Hörvertrauen – Vollzeit oder Teilzeit – Festanstellung - Hörglück

audibene ist das schnellst wachsende Unternehmen der Hörakustik Branche. Unsere Mission ist es unseren Kund:innen bahnbrechende Hörgerätetechnologie zu liefern und damit entscheidend ihre Lebenssituation zu verbessern. Unsere Reise begann im Jahr 2012 als unsere Gründer sich Gedanken um die Digitalisierung der bis dato sehr traditionellen Branche machten. Heute sind wir global mehr als 1.200 Mitarbeitende, mit 8 Standorten weltweit.
Wir arbeiten in Deutschland mit knapp 1.300 traditionellen Hörakustikbetrieben zusammen und suchen für diese vor Ort nach Unterstützung.

Job mit Zukunft und Perspektive 

Unsere Partnerbetriebe geben engagierten Quereinsteiger:innen oder Personen, die einen beruflichen Einstieg im Umfeld der Hörakustikbranche suchen, eine einmalige berufliche Chance. 

Du arbeitest in Festanstellung ( Teilzeit oder Vollzeit ) bei einem unserer Partnerbetrieben in Deiner Nähe.

Du möchtest mit Deiner Arbeit die Lebensqualität von Menschen verbessern und etwas Gutes bewirken? Dich weiterentwickeln, am Puls der Zeit bleiben und schnell ein anderes Aufgabenfeld für Dich entdecken? 

Deine Tätigkeiten:

- Du begleitest Kund:innen auf dem Weg zu besserem Hören und mehr Lebensqualität von A - Z.

- Du bist die Kommunikationszentrale im Unternehmen nach innen und außen. Du besprichst dich z.B. mit den Krankenkassen, den Laboren, den HNO- Praxen oder den Hörgeräte-Hersteller:innen.

- Du koordinierst Termine und bereitest diese vor und nach.

- Das gesamte Bestellwesen und die Lagerverwaltung gehört ebenfalls dazu.

- Du klärst Kunden zu den Themen Hörverlust und Hörgeräte, Zubehör und Gehörschutz auf.

- Du unterstützt die Hörakustiker:innen in der täglichen Arbeit mit den Kund:innen. Ihr seid ein Team.

- Wenn Du später auch handwerklich tätig sein möchtest, dann kannst Du die Hörmessungen und die Abdrücke von Ohrpassstücken vorbereiten.

- Du kannst auch die Servicetermine übernehmen: hier werden die Hörgeräte regelmäßig kontrolliert, repariert und gereinigt.

Dein Profil

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im kaufmännischen, medizinisch-, pflegerischen oder serviceorientierten Bereich (z.B. Alten- und Krankenpflege, Fachkräfte in der Medizin, MFA, Praxismanagement, Augenoptik, Apotheke, Zahnpraxen, Verkauf, Beratung, Einzelhandel, Großhandel, Kaufleute)

- Organisationsfähigkeit für eine gute Struktur

- Empathie und Begeisterung für eine neue Aufgabe mit Zukunft

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Was wir bieten

- Direkter Quereinstieg

- Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten von Tagesseminaren, Präsenz- oder Online- Schulungen bis hin zu einer 12-monatigen vollwertigen Qualifikation durch die Handwerkskammer

- Festanstellung bei unseren Partner:innen im Fachgeschäft

- Geregelte Arbeitszeiten i.d.R. MO- FR von 9.00 bis 18.00 Uhr

- Die Möglichkeit, in einen neuen Lebensabschnitt voller spannender Aufgaben und tollen Kund:innen zu starten!

title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
description:
About CHAPTERS Group 

CHAPTERS Group is a listed German serial acquirer of vertical market software companies. We have grown 10x in the past five years and now own 55+ companies. Each one runs its own business, close to its customers. We help them get stronger without taking over. AI is one of the biggest opportunities we see for them, and it only works if the people in these companies actually use it.

Tasks

The Role 
German (C1+) and English required

You make sure 10+ software companies get real value out of AI.

You work embedded in one of our portfolio platforms. You own the AI Hub for its companies. The AI Hub is our Open WebUI-based AI platform: each company has its own instance in its own tenant, and the data stays in the EU. You keep it running, roll it out, fix what breaks, and help each company's people use it well.

You are part of the AI Core Team in the CTO office. You work closely with us: you bring back what you see in the field, test new capabilities, and help shape the platform for all 55+ companies.

You are hands-on. You deploy, configure, fix and integrate. Each company also has AI Champions who drive adoption locally. You are their technical backbone: when something needs engineering, you do it, and you make sure the next similar request is faster.

What You Will Do

- Run the AI Hub for 10+ companies: deployments, updates, configuration, SSO with Entra ID, monitoring, backups and incident handling

- Onboard companies and teams: set up skills, knowledge bases and tools and get each company productive on the Hub

- Be the technical point of contact: when something breaks or a Champion is stuck, you diagnose and fix it. You document recurring issues so they get solved once.

- Connect the Hub where a use case needs it: Microsoft 365 / Graph, CRM, ticketing and ERP systems, through tools, MCP servers and REST APIs

- Turn repeated questions into reusable assets: documentation, templates and short hands-on sessions

- Work with the AI Core Team: share patterns across companies, test new features, and feed back into the platform roadmap

- Support our M&A team occasionally (around 10 to 20% of your time) on technical questions, for example assessing the tech and AI stack of acquisition targets

What We Are Looking For

Required 

- German (C1 or higher) and fluent English. You work with managing directors and non-technical teams in German every day. We cannot make exceptions here.

- Production operations experience. You have deployed and operated containerised applications in production (Docker, CI/CD, Linux, a major cloud, Azure preferred), and you were responsible when they broke. This usually means 2+ years in a DevOps, platform, SRE or backend role.

- Python you are comfortable reading, debugging and extending

- Hands-on with LLMs. You use them seriously in your own work and have built something with them, at work or on the side. You know where they fail.

- You explain technical things so non-technical people understand them and can act on them. You are comfortable being the go-to technical person for teams that are not technical.

Strong signals 

- Enterprise identity: Entra ID, OAuth, SSO

- Self-hosted LLM platforms such as Open WebUI or LibreChat

- MCP, tool calling, agent frameworks

- Infrastructure as Code (Bicep, Terraform)

- A support, solutions or customer-facing technical role in your background

- Experience working across several companies, tenants or a group structure

This role is not for you if 

- you want to spend most of your time building new AI products from scratch

- you are looking for ML research or model training

- you want to work only with engineers and avoid direct contact with business teams

Benefits

What You Get

- Real ownership: 10+ companies, one platform, and you are the person who makes AI work there

- A small team in the CTO office with a direct line to leadership. Decisions get made fast.

- Impact beyond your platform: what works for your companies becomes the standard for 55+

- Permanent full-time position , remote-first, with occasional on-site time

- Development: talent reviews, events and conferences. We hire people who want to grow with us.

How to Apply 

Send your CV and answer this one question in German , max. 200 words. No cover letter needed.

- Tell us about a system you ran in production that broke. What happened, what did you do, and what changed afterwards?

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Staff Solutions Engineer ( MSSP )
description:
Our Purpose 

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us 

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For? 

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Staff Solutions Engineer, you will be tasked with driving adoption, building strong partner relationships, and evangelizing our solutions across the region. You will focus on enabling the MSSP ecosystem, positioning and integrating SentinelOne's technology within partner technical offerings, selling to the managed partner base, conducting demos, delivering technical training, Proof of Values, assisting partners with pre and post sales activities, and assisting with escalations. Your role will be responsible for managing our MSSP partners, while cultivating long-term relationships with partners, and the SentinelOne field and Product/Engineering teams. 

What will you do?

Primary responsibilities include:

- Work with the Managed partner team to identify and qualify partnership opportunities, identify key partner technical objections, competition, and develop strategies to resolve technical blockers and scale the partner sales business

- Bring feedback from partners and end customers to product management to improve the SentinelOne's solution

- Drive follow-ups with partner resources to consistently deliver on messaging how SentinelOne adds value to the partner and their customers.

- Plan and create go-to-market initiatives and offerings with SentinelOne partners

- Develop and execute technical training plans for partners.

- Own the technical relationship with SentinelOne's partners, and the coordination of additional technical resources.

- Deliver demonstrations and work hands-on with partners to demonstrate SentinelOne's value in the partner's environment or solutions.

What skills and knowledge should you bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

- 15+ Years in field, 8+ years in Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Professional Services experience

- Proven track record of scaling managed partner technical programs at a strategic level, including mentoring other SEs

- Proven experience designing and delivering multi-phase technical architecture roadmaps for enterprise, MSSP, or MSP environments, including SKU sequencing and margin/commercial modeling

- Strong track record operating at the CTO/VP Engineering level with partners or customers, translating technical roadmaps into commercial outcomes

- Strong background building relationships with internal sales, product, and executive leadership teams

- Experience presenting and defending technical and commercial roadmaps and sales values presentations to varying audiences from architects to C-level executives.

- Technical experience/skills for the successful candidate:

- Previous experience as a practitioner at a MSSP, MSP, MDR, IR partner or in a SOC.

- Familiarity with SIEM or other data lake solutions

- A strong understanding of cybersecurity, identity security and endpoint security solutions is ideal for success in this role or similar in tech/software industry.

- Experience working with cloud computing environments (e.g. technical sales, devops, security, sales engineering or similar role)

- Experience in and understanding of cloud deployments, especially as relates to security and compliance

- Experience with AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. Azure a plus

- Familiarity with modern cloud environments, e.g. containerized workloads, serverless computing, and microservices architectures

- Experience working with CSPs, channel, MSP/MSSPs, GSIs, or alliances partners.

- Ability to quickly learn, adapt, understand, and work with new emerging technologies, methodologies and solutions

- Fluent German and English language

- Willingness to travel up to 50%

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. title: Analytics Engineer, Revenue, Purchase & Order
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. 
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to join our Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering team.

The area sits at the heart of some of the most critical customer journeys and commercial systems across Vinted’s Marketplace Business Unit, spanning Revenue (pricing and advertising), Purchase (inquiries and checkout), and Orders (transactions and fulfilment). Together, these domains create a rich, high-volume, and deeply interconnected data ecosystem.

As an Analytics Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of data, engineering, and product, building trusted data products that power business and product decision-making across these domains.

In this position, you’ll 

- Build scalable data products: Design, develop, and evolve reliable, cost-efficient data products and pipelines that power analytics and machine learning use cases across the domains.

- Build quality in by design: Embed automated testing, validation, and quality controls throughout the data lifecycle to ensure data remains accurate, consistent, and complete.

- Strengthen observability: Improve monitoring and alerting to detect and address issues before they impact downstream consumers.

- Own production reliability: Take end-to-end ownership of production data systems, from investigating incidents and diagnosing root causes to implementing durable fixes that prevent recurrence and improve long-term resilience.

Who you’ll work with:

- Revenue, Purchase & Order Analytics Engineering: Join a talented and driven team of 7+ Analytics Engineers, working across interconnected domains and tackling complex, high-impact data challenges.

- Data & Decision Scientists: Work closely with Data Scientists and Decision Scientists to build trusted data foundations that enable better business and product decisions.

- Engineering, Product & Business: Partner with Backend Engineering, Product, and Business teams to understand their needs, shape technical requirements, and translate them into well-designed, trusted data solutions.

- The Analytics Engineering Guild: Be an active member of Vinted’s 40+ member AE Guild, benefiting from shared tooling, engineering standards, and knowledge across domains. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to “side quests” that improve engineering practices, tooling, and reusable capabilities.

About you 

- Experience working as an Analytics Engineer, Data Engineer, or in a closely related data role.

- Strong SQL and data warehousing fundamentals, with the ability to build clean, performant, and maintainable data solutions.

- Hands-on experience with dbt or a similar data transformation framework, building well-structured and tested data models.

- Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar.

- A solid understanding of data modelling principles and their application to real-world analytical problems.

- Familiarity with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or similar.

- Comfortable working with high-volume, business-critical data, balancing a high bar for quality and reliability with a pragmatic bias for action.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to clearly explain technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Work perks 

- The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

- 30 days of paid annual leave

- Newest MacBook models

- Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

- Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

- Lunch benefit per your workday

- Frequent team-building events

- A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

- Access to a discounted gym membership plan

- Pension Plan with Vinted matching 150% of your chosen contribution

- Supplemental Private Health Insurance

- Life and Disability insurance

- A subsidised Deutschlandticket for your commute to the office by public transport

- A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Individual learning budget 

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

Hybrid work 

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

Equal opportunity 

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

title: Account Executive - Enterprise - Insurance
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
We’re looking for an experienced, motivated Enterprise Account Executive to drive ElevenLabs’ growth across Insurance: the carriers, MGAs, and brokers people rely on when life gets expensive and complicated. These organizations win or lose on trust and service at massive scale, under some of the most demanding regulatory standards anywhere.

Our ideal candidate learns fast, closes well from a warm introduction, and is passionate about AI voice technology. You’ll act as a strategic partner to insurers reimagining how they serve, sell to, and sound to their customers, safely and at scale.

In this role you will: 

- Focus on prospecting and landing net-new customers to expand the market footprint that ElevenLabs has in the Insurance industry

- Balance a diverse pipeline of large national carriers that require a white-glove experience with regional and mid-sized insurers that require speed to close

- Identify where conversational AI can drive growth, automation, or cost efficiency in customer-facing and internal workflows, such as claims intake, policy servicing and renewals, billing and payment support, agent and broker support, and contact center coaching

- Stay current on the conversational AI landscape, including competitive solutions, build-vs-buy dynamics, and emerging trends in insurance AI governance and regulation

- Develop and execute account strategies across the whole buying group (Claims Operations, Customer Service and Contact Center, Distribution, Digital and Technology, and Compliance, Legal, and InfoSec), landing with one high-impact use case and expanding across lines of business

- Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to solution high-impact use cases, manage a successful Proof of Value, guide customers through security, architecture, and AI governance review, and set them up to scale in production

- Partner closely with Legal teams to drive strategic, fast-moving negotiations

- Serve as a trusted advisor on generative AI and voice, and share what you learn in the field to sharpen our Insurance positioning, messaging, and references

Requirements 

- 7+ years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience in SaaS or technology, ideally with exposure to AI, generative AI, LLM-based products, or API-driven platforms

- Insurance experience (carriers, MGAs, brokers, insurtech) is preferred but not required. We weigh demonstrated adaptability and fast ramp in a new industry heavily

- Proven success closing [six- and seven-figure] deals and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

- Proven ability to take a warm introduction through discovery, Proof of Value, and procurement to close

- Experience selling to both technical buyers (product and engineering) and business buyers (claims, customer service, distribution, digital), and to compliance and risk gatekeepers, translating complex technology into business value

- Adept at deeply understanding a customer’s business and translating ElevenLabs’ capabilities into solutions that deliver against their needs

- Proficient in enterprise procurement, security review, and legal processes, including regulated-industry vendor risk, AI governance, and data protection reviews, and able to work autonomously as a cross-functional partner

- Strong executive presence, the ability to build relationships with senior executives, and willingness to travel frequently for onsite client visits and conferences

- High EQ, self-aware, and curious. Low ego and hands-on, comfortable running your own prospecting and deals

- Comfort in an early-stage, high-growth environment, where ambiguity is the norm and the state of play changes rapidly

- Passion for voice and conversational AI and how it can unlock transformative value for customers

Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

We also expect you to be the person who catches generic, low-effort output before it reaches a customer. Our brand and our customer experience matter too much to ship anything less than excellent.

What you'll do 

- Own onboarding for new Account Executives and SDRs: build a structured ramp program with clear milestones and certifications that gets new hires productive fast

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager (d/f/m)
description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

About the role 

Taxfix builds more products for more customer segments, faster than before. As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you are the go-to-market partner embedded into a product team, from the first discovery conversation to scaling. You’re not just handed a final product to talk about it. You bring customer, market and competitive evidence into the decisions that shape what gets built from day one: which segments to target, what features to prioritize, how to create Aha moments. You influence what the product does, how it wins and whether people will pay. You also build the systems that keep this work running: from automated competitor and customer insights generation, to agentic workflows that let product teams run smaller launches themselves at high quality.

You work closely with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Growth Marketing and Paid Acquisition.

What you'll do 

- Taking one (or many) of our big bets to market. With high level of responsibility, autonomy and direct support from senior leaders and domain experts, you will help us launch assisted and AI-native experiences that customers truly love.

- Bring the market into product decisions. Turn customer, market and competitive evidence into clear recommendations for the product team. Join discovery work and design sprints where market specifics shape what gets built.

- Choose who to serve, and who not to. Break users and products down into needs, pains, and functional and emotional value. Define sharp ICPs and decide which segment to win first and later.

- Position the product to win. Define the competitive alternatives, what makes the product different and why it wins. Turn that into a sharp messaging and shape the pricing and packaging inputs.

- Run launches as tests. Run lean tests early, report what the measures show, and adapt the product, the positioning and the go-to-market. You gather evidence that improves our GTM decision quality, not tick off a launch checklist.

- Align the people around the work. Bring structure to complex go-to-market work: clear owners, milestones, decision points and success measures. Facilitate decisions across Product, Engineering, Data, Growth and commercial teams.

- Build the insight engine. Replace ad hoc research with automated flows of competitor and customer insight that product and marketing teams use every week.

- Own part of the context system. Turn each go-to-market decision and artifact into governed context that empowers people and agents alike.

- Build with AI. Build your own prototypes, applets and automations for the opportunities you prioritize, and help product teams self-serve lower-tier launches at quality.

What you'll bring 

- 5+ years of bringing tech products to market. You have successfully taken complex products or features from discovery to launch and adoption, in a fast-paced environment.

- Data- and evidence-driven over opinion. You set clear targets, success definitions and guardrails. You analyze data and derive actionable next steps. When evidence contradicts the plan, you say so, including to senior stakeholders.

- Customer insight and craft. You stay close enough to users to quote them. You turn what they said into why they behave as they do, and into a narrative people remember.

- AI as a builder. You build agents, automated workflows, prototypes and context towards clear milestones or outcomes.

- Communication and project leadership. You write and speak with precision, align several teams at once and keep many moving pieces on track.

- High agency and curiosity. You find the problem and solve it without waiting to be told, and you carry it like an owner.

- Bias for action. You prioritize speed of learning and progress over perfection.

- English and German. You use German to write customer-facing messaging and English to work with the wider team.

Why Taxfix? 

- A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

- Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions.

- A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

- Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

- 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

- A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

- Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

- Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

- Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

- Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.

Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture.

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves. 

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

We need a Purchasing Specialist who thrives at the intersection of technology and execution. In this role, you will drive the development of a robust and agile supply chain that supports our engineering and R&D ambitions. You’ll be responsible for identifying and partnering with top-tier suppliers, shaping sourcing strategies, and ensuring exceptional standards in quality, cost, and delivery.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

- Strategic sourcing: Design and run procurement strategies for highly technical components, services and first-of-a-kind builds.

- Supplier management: Find, assess and onboard new suppliers, and strengthen relationships with existing ones.

- Contract negotiation: Lead commercial negotiations, evaluate bids, and structure deals that manage risk while getting the best performance.

- End-to-end procurement operations: Oversee the whole process from requisition to delivery, in line with internal policies.

- Tool and process ownership: Improve procurement systems, databases and automation.

- Experience: 3+ years in technical procurement, ideally in a fast-moving engineering setting (startup, fusion, aerospace, defence, medtech). Team leadership experience is preferred.

- Technical acumen: Reads technical drawings and specs, and can judge whether a part can be made and what a supplier can deliver.

- Negotiation: A track record in contract negotiation, supplier risk and cost/value optimisation.

- Communication: Strong communicator. English is required, German is a plus.

- Tools: Hands-on with procurement platforms, ERP and data-driven decision-making.

Well-known brands in fintech, travel, e-commerce, B2B2C and D2C already run Zelara in production, inbound interest is growing, and we're backed by NAP. Now we need the person who turns that interest into a repeatable pipeline engine.

The role 

As our Founding Growth Lead, you'll establish Zelara's growth function and own the top of the funnel. One number matters most: qualified leads that sales is excited to talk to.

There's no playbook to inherit. You pick the channels, spend the budget and ship the work yourself, with the founders and the other GTM leaders. You'll build the function AI-native from day one, and within your first year you'll hire and lead a small team.

Reports to: Co-Founder

Location: Berlin, hybrid, with regular travel across Europe for conferences and our own events

What you'll own 

- Events. Represent Zelara at leading European marketing conferences and host our own executive dinners, roundtables and meetups. Every event ends in meetings.

- Webinars. A series with customers, partners and industry voices, repurposed into content that keeps producing leads.

- Campaigns. Awareness and product marketing campaigns that reach lifecycle, CRM and marketing leaders at enterprise companies, and turn launches and customer wins into case studies and sales enablement.

- Messaging and GTM strategy. Shape how we tell our story and refine our GTM strategy with the other GTM leaders.

- Zelara on Zelara. Run our own nurture and lifecycle programs on our product, as our marketer and most demanding user.

- An AI-native growth function. Build research, content, personalization and reporting workflows around AI, so a small team ships like a much larger one.

- The numbers. Own the qualified-lead definition with sales, attribution and experiments, and move budget to what works.

Qualified upper-funnel leads are your north star.

title: Solutions Architect
description:
About Zelara

Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way.

Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome.

With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift, measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. We are growing our Solutions Architecture team to make the path from integration to measurable value repeatable across more customers.

The Role

This is a deeply technical customer role centered on post-sales value realization, with involvement in pre-sales discovery. It is not reactive customer success, nor a pre-sales role that hands off at signature.

You own technical value realization for a portfolio of customers, from discovery and onboarding through live experiments, measured results, and scaled adoption.

You and the commercial lead run each account as a pair. They own pricing, contracts, expansion, and renewal. You own the technical plan and the evidence behind those decisions: before signature you lead technical discovery alongside them, after signature you are the customer's named technical lead for solution design, data mapping, the experiment plan, and go-live. There is no separate customer success manager; the two of you hold the whole relationship.

Product, Engineering, and Science own the platform, the integrations, and the measurement standards. You turn their work into a working customer solution and bring them in when a requirement crosses those lines.

Our customers are mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe: fintech, e-commerce, travel, and employee benefits.

What You Will Do

- Lead technical discovery before signature: how the customer makes money, which metric moves it, and what the pilot can credibly promise

- Own onboarding: align stakeholders, define the data mapping and acceptance criteria, and take the customer live on its existing CRM stack

- Design and pre-register each experiment to Zelara's scientific standards, because a success bar set after seeing the data is not a result

- Own the customer-facing readout: reconcile our analysis with the customer's data, and say clearly when the evidence is not decision-ready

- Enable the customer's team to run campaigns independently

- Partner with the commercial lead on annual contracts, expansion, and renewal

- Drive the product loop: turn recurring customer needs into product opportunities and research questions, backed by evidence from live accounts, and use agents to build the scripts and prototypes that unblock an account in the meantime

Your First 90 Days

30 Days: Learn the platform and the portfolio, join the active accounts, and take over your first technical customer relationship.

60 Days: Lead one onboarding independently, with the integration, experiment design, and measurement plan agreed before launch.

90 Days: Own a small portfolio and deliver your first evidence-backed results readout.

Who You Are

- You have led deployments, implementations, or technical accounts for mid-market or enterprise customers at a B2B SaaS company, and your work has influenced adoption, renewal, or expansion.

- You judge a customer's business before you design for it: which metric their leadership is held to, and what matters that nobody has said out loud.

- You have led real customer integrations and know that a successful import is not the same as usable data.

- You turn a business question into an analysis plan and understand experiments: control groups, effect sizes, statistical power, and why the design is frozen before it runs.

Bonus

- You have experience with experimentation platforms, bandits, or applied ML in production.

- You have converted pilots or POCs into multi-year contracts and can say what moved the decision.

How We Work

We are an AI-first team. We adopt what makes us faster and drop what does not, and we value evidence, speed, and clear ownership over process theater.

Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.

Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. - du dich unwohl fühlst, aktiv auf Entscheider:innen zuzugehen und Gespräche zu eröffnen

- du lieber bestehende Accounts betreust, statt neue Kund:innen zu gewinnen

- du Abschlüsse nicht feierst und Sales-Ziele dich eher stressen als motivieren

- du ein sehr klar strukturiertes Umfeld brauchst und wenig Freude an Eigenverantwortung hast

Over 40,000 Zenjobbers and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.

The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Product Manager to join our team. In this role, you will play a key part in defining and executing a product vision that ensures Zenjob’s marketplace dynamics are well balanced, by optimizing our demand forecast, making sure jobs and Zenjobbers are matched optimally, and engaging students in working a high number of shifts.

This is not a role that owns one squad's backlog. You'll work project-based: form a team around a problem, own it end-to-end until it delivers on the expected need. You'll get problem statements, not requirements documents. Recent examples: how shifts get allocated across thousands of Zenjobbers each week, and how we get a new Zenjobber from signup to their first shift without human intervention.

This role suits a Product Manager who is energised by an open-ended problem, and who finds complex workflows genuinely interesting. You'll report to the Director of Product and work across our Supply, Demand and Staffing squads, depending on the problem to solve.

What You’ll do

- Bring our business goals to reality. Understand our financial goals, our users' problems and transform them into solutions that drive our revenue up.

- Talk to users directly . Zenjobbers, clients, and our own internal teams. Most of the good opportunities come out of these conversations, not out of a backlog.

- Do your own data work . You don’t wait until a data analyst gives you the insights, you dive into it and derive them yourself.

- Turn ambiguity into a defensible plan . Take a problem nobody agrees on yet, and define what we're solving, what we're explicitly not solving, and in what order.

- Design and run tests . Form a hypothesis, define what would falsify it, ship the smallest thing that gives you a real answer, and be honest about the result.

- Drive product development from concept to launch . Pull together Engineering, Design, Ops and Commercial around a problem and keep them moving through hypothesis, building, rollout and post-launch decision making

- Own the outcome, not the output . Each project has a number attached. You define what success looks like up front, and you're the one who says whether it was hit.

- Communicate clearly. A one-page memo an exec can act on. A spec an engineer doesn't have to interpret. A tradeoff explained to Commercial in terms they care about.

What we’re looking for

- 6+ years in product, with meaningful time on products where the software coordinates real-world processes - staffing, logistics, fintech ops, healthcare, or similar, with substantial business impact. You have experience in marketplace dynamics and allocation problems.

- You've shipped something complex end-to-end and can talk credibly about what broke, not just what launched.

- You're analytically strong - comfortable getting to an answer yourself rather than commissioning one, and having a fluent conversation with data scientists.

- You've moved teams you don't manage . Cross-functional influence without formal authority is most of this job.

- You write and speak clearly. This is the strongest single signal we look for, because in a cross-team role, clear communication is most of how work actually moves.

- AI is already part of how you work , and you can say specifically where it helps and where it doesn't, and you are already able to ship small features with little to no help from Engineers

- English fluency. German is a big plus. 

What we offer

- Real ownership of problems that visibly move the business - not a slice of someone else's roadmap.

- Innovative mission: Together we create something new. Work in a dynamic set-up where you learn a lot and your every idea is heard.

- Unique team spirit : We can rely on each other blindly and celebrate all successes together as a team.

- Vacation : Recreation and further education is important, which is why we offer 28 days of paid vacation (increased by 1 day for every 2 calendar years of service with us, up to a maximum of 30 days), 1 day of special leave for community service, 5 days of paid educational leave, and the possibility of unpaid leave

- Hybrid working model : We love our brand new office in Prenzlauer Berg. But sometimes you need a little more flexibility. Zenjob’s flexible working model combines the best of both worlds, so you can work remotely up to 2 days / week (1 day, during the first 6 months, so we can guarantee you the best onboarding).

- Dog-lover : If you have a dog, feel free to bring it with you. We don’t bite and always have a bowl of water in our range of drinks

title: Director of Treasury
description:
This is a newly created position driven by Moneybox’s exceptional growth. The Director of Treasury will be instrumental in driving treasury strategy and delivering best in class operations and governance. Treasury at Moneybox isn’t just about managing banking counterparties, it’s about leveraging technology and financial products to optimise liquidity and commercial return within a given risk appetite. Assisting and questioning product development, helping set the company’s strategic direction, and delivering quality coaching to get the best out of your team.

What You’ll Do 

Being a Director at Moneybox doesn’t just mean you own and manage your function, it means you play a vital role in helping define company strategy through cross-functional steering committees, quarterly planning meetings, and management committees. Moneybox has thrived owing to its strong culture; as a Director , you are core in helping maintain this culture through living and promoting the Moneybox values.

The role is a trusted advisor to the VP Finance, but also has direct exposure to our Chief Executive Officers and Chief Operating Officer. You’re expected to deliver in the role:

- Values-driven leadership : You take end-to-end ownership of Treasury, acting as a high-trust role model who leads with humility and radical honesty

- Operational excellence through accountability : You oversee day-to-day operations with a relentless focus on collective results, ensuring accuracy and efficiency are team benchmarks

- Curious & Data-Driven : You possess a genuine hunger to understand the "why" behind the numbers, diving deep into behavioral data to ensure our liquidity strategy is built on solid foundations

- Architect of transparent governance : You design KPIs and Risk Frameworks that provide the clarity and "buy-in" necessary for the firm to progress with complete confidence

- Strategic automation driver: You utilize technology to eliminate manual friction, driving the functional tech strategy and holding the function accountable for delivering

- Collaborative relationship builder : You cultivate banking and counterparty relationships through authentic connection, ensuring external partners are aligned with our mission

- Cross-functional partner : You work seamlessly cross-functionally, breaking down silos to ensure operational excellence and positive commercial outcomes are a shared victory

- Accountable regulatory guardian : You take full ownership of critical reporting (ICARA, MIF), ensuring our regulatory standing is beyond reproach through meticulous attention to detail

- Commercially sharp strategic advisor : You translate complex financial data into actionable insights for senior management, driving high-stakes outcomes like M&A, funding plans, and IPO readiness

- Voice of healthy conflict : As a key member of the Treasury Management Committee, you lean into challenging debates to ensure the best decisions are made for the company

Who you are 

- Results-first leader : You possess an ego-less approach to success, instinctively prioritizing collective company outcomes over personal or functional ambition

- Cross-functional catalyst : You thrive in shared-goal environments, understanding that true accountability means bridging silos to ensure the entire team wins, not just your department.

- Hungry & intellectually curious : You bring an exceptional work ethic and a "thirst for knowledge" that drives you to constantly improve yourself and the systems around you

- Action-Oriented : You have the acumen to translate high-level strategy into tangible outputs, ensuring that "commitment" isn't just a word, but a measurable result

- Collaborative Communicator : You build trust by being radically honest—admitting mistakes and asking for help—and you prefer healthy debate to reach the best outcomes 

Experience and Skills 

- Credentialed Excellence : You hold a professional qualification that proves your technical rigour—whether it’s an ACA, CFA, or ACT.

- Liquidity Mastery : Beyond just managing cash, you’ve mastered the art of strategically deploying significant capital to balance safety with return.

- Data Translation : As a natural "data translator," you turn complex datasets into sharp, commercially savvy moves that drive the business forward.

- Regulatory Navigation : Having successfully navigated high-stakes landscapes, you bring deep familiarity with ICARA, ICAAP, or ILAAP frameworks.

- CASS Stewardship : With a robust understanding of CASS compliance, you ensure the integrity and protection of client assets is never compromised.

- People-First Leadership : You bring a proven track record of mentoring high-performing teams and fostering long-term professional growth.

- Thriving Under Pressure : You excel in high-velocity settings, staying calm, focused, and effective when the pace picks up.

- Strategic Communication : Distilling complex financial truths for C-suite stakeholders comes naturally to you; you are an excellent communicator who can command a room.

What’s In It For You? 

- Opportunity to join a fast-growing, award-winning and super ambitious company

- Work with a friendly team of highly motivated individuals

- Be in an environment where you are listened to and can actually have an impact

- Thriving collaborative and inclusive company culture

- Company pension scheme

- Company bonus scheme

- Hybrid working environment – by the Oxo Tower

- Home office furniture allowance

- Personal Annual Learning and Development budget

- Private Medical Insurance

- Health Cash Plan – cashback on everyday healthcare like dental and opticians

- Cycle to work scheme – spread the cost of a new bike and accessories

- CycleSaver – save on bike-share subscriptions and have a more sustainable commute

- Wellhub subscription to a variety of gyms and wellbeing apps

- Enhanced parental pay & leave

- 25 days holiday + bank holidays with additional days added with length of service.

This is a hybrid role. Our office is in London, by the Oxo Tower

title: Data Product & Analytics Engineering Senior Manager
description:
About Moneybox 

At Moneybox, our mission is to give everyone the means to get more out of life. We're guided by our belief that wealth isn't about the money, it's about the means to more - more freedom, opportunities, possibilities, and peace of mind. Moneybox is an award-winning wealth management platform, helping over one and a half million people build wealth throughout their lives, whether they’re saving and investing, buying their first home, or planning for retirement. 

Job Brief 

We’re looking for a Data Product & Analytics Engineering Senior Manager to join the Data & Insight team on a permanent basis. This role is dedicated to lead a team of four Analytics Engineers and own the roadmap for the development of our analytical data products. 

You will be responsible for identifying, shaping and prioritising the data capabilities we need, orchestrating their delivery across multiple teams, and leading the Analytics Engineers who will design and implement them. This role combines Data Product Management, Analytics Engineering leadership and data architecture . 

What you'll do 

Lead the Analytics Engineering team 

- 
Manage and develop a team of four Analytics Engineers across different levels of seniority. 

- 
Provide technical direction, coaching and context while creating an environment where engineers retain ownership of solution design and implementation. 

- 
Work with the team on modelling and architecture decisions, challenge proposed approaches, identify opportunities for reuse and simplification, and ensure solutions align with our target data architecture. 

- 
Coach engineers at different levels, helping them improve not only their technical capabilities but also their understanding of business problems, architectural thinking and ownership of data products. 

Own the Analytics Engineering roadmap. 

- 
Define and maintain a prioritised roadmap covering new data models, data marts, dimensions and attributes, governed metrics, and architectural improvements.

- 
Drive the transition towards more centralised and trusted data models, reducing duplicated transformation logic and creating reusable representations of core business entities, facts, dimensions, metrics and relationships. 

Own data products end-to-end. 

- 
Take requirements from problem definition through discovery, architecture, prioritisation, delivery, quality assurance, adoption and ongoing ownership. 

- 
Coordinate dependencies across Product Engineering, Data Engineering, Insights, Reporting and other teams. Ensure upstream changes and ingestion requirements are identified early enough to support downstream data delivery. 

- 
Understand the underlying problem behind stakeholder requests and determine whether the right solution is a new attribute, metric, model, mart or enhancement to an existing data product. 

Who you are 

- 
Someone comfortable building technical solutions as you are communicating them to non technical stakeholders

- 
A strong previously hands-on Data Engineer and/or Analytics Engineer. 

- 
A clear communicator with experience translating business problems into scalable data products and technical requirements. 

- 
Excited about fintech and the particular challenges that come with a regulated, app-first, long-consideration financial product.

- 
Comfortable with ambiguity and able to operate with autonomy in a fast-paced environment where the brief sometimes evolves mid-sprint.

Experience and skills 

Essential 

- 
5+ years of experience with data architecture and analytical data modelling. 

- 
Experience with modern transformation frameworks such as dbt and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake or equivalent. 

- 
Experience leading, mentoring or technically guiding Data/Analytics Engineers. 

- 
Understanding of the complete data lifecycle from source applications and ingestion through transformation, semantic modelling and consumption. 

- 
Experience managing roadmaps and prioritising competing business, architectural and technical requirements. 

- 
The ability to communicate comfortably with both engineers and senior business stakeholders. 

If you meet most but not all of the above, we’d still encourage you to apply. 

Desirable 

- 
Knowledge of data quality, testing, lineage, documentation, ownership and governance practices. 

- 
Experience working in a regulated industry, ideally financial services or fintech, with an understanding of how governance, controls and regulatory requirements influence data architecture and delivery. 

-

We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs. 

We use cutting-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. Want to be part of it? 

Role overview: 

We are looking for an experienced contractor to lead the analysis, design and execution of a data migration from one Salesforce instance (source org) to another (target org), using Microsoft SQL Server as the staging and transformation layer. You will own the end-to-end migration data workstream: profiling source data, mapping objects and fields, building transformation logic, loading and reconciling data, and supporting cutover.

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role. The right person will combine strong Salesforce data model knowledge with proven, real-world experience of moving data between orgs safely and accurately. The role can be filled at Data Analyst or Data Architect level depending on the candidate’s experience; architect-level candidates will additionally be expected to shape the overall migration approach and standards.

Main Duties / Responsibilities: 

- Define and document the data migration approach, scope, and sequencing for moving data between Salesforce orgs, including cutover and rollback considerations.

- Analyse and profile source Salesforce data to assess volumes, quality, duplication, and dependencies across standard and custom objects.

- Produce object-level and field-level mapping documents between source and target orgs, covering data types, picklist values, record types, required fields, and validation rules.

- Design and maintain SQL Server staging databases and schemas to extract, cleanse, transform, and stage Salesforce data ahead of loading.

- Write, optimise, and test T-SQL (stored procedures, views, ETL logic) to implement transformation and data-cleansing rules.

- Manage the migration of parent/child relationships and record ownership, preserving referential integrity through ID cross-referencing (source ID to target ID) and correct load order.

- Extract and load data using appropriate tooling (e.g., Salesforce Data Loader, Bulk API, SSIS, Azure Data Factory, dbAmp, or equivalent) and manage error handling and re-runs.

- Plan and run multiple migration cycles (development, test/UAT, and production dress rehearsals) and execute the production cutover.

- Design and run reconciliation and validation checks (record counts, field-level comparisons, sampling) and produce sign-off evidence for business stakeholders.

- Work with Salesforce administrators, developers, business analysts, and data owners to resolve data quality issues and agree transformation rules.

- Identify and manage migration risks and issues, including data volume limits, API limits, automation and trigger impacts, and sharing/ownership considerations.

- Ensure the handling of personal data complies with GDPR and internal data governance and security standards.

- Produce clear documentation and a handover pack (mapping specifications, scripts, runbooks, lessons learned) so the migration can be supported after your engagement ends.

Essential Skills & Qualifications: 

- Proven, hands-on experience delivering data migrations between Salesforce orgs or from other systems into Salesforce, ideally including at least one full production cutover.

- Strong working knowledge of the Salesforce data model, including standard objects (e.g., Account, Contact, Lead, Opportunity, Case, User) and custom objects, relationships (lookup and master-detail), record types, and field types.

- Strong SQL Server and T-SQL skills, including stored procedures, joins across large data sets, performance tuning, and data quality checks.

- Experience with data extraction and loading tools for Salesforce (e.g., Data Loader, Bulk API, SSIS, Azure Data Factory, Informatica, Talend, Boomi, dbAmp, or similar).

- Solid experience in data profiling, cleansing, deduplication, and mapping, with a methodical approach to reconciliation and audit trails.

- Understanding of Salesforce migration considerations such as ownership and sharing, validation rules, triggers/flows, API limits, and managing record IDs across orgs.

- Awareness of data privacy requirements (e.g., GDPR) and secure handling of customer data.

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical data concepts for business stakeholders and to work independently in a fast-paced delivery environment.

Desirable skillsets: 

- Salesforce certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Data Architecture and Management Designer, Administrator, or Platform App Builder).

- Experience with multi-org consolidation or Salesforce org merge/split projects.

- Experience with Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud in an automotive or retail environment.

- Familiarity with Salesforce attachments, files, and content migration (ContentVersion, ContentDocumentLink).

- Experience using Power BI or similar tools to present reconciliation and migration progress reporting.

- Working knowledge of Agile delivery and tools such as Jira and Confluence.

Why join us? 

We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way. 

An inclusive environment to thrive 

We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles – not just on key days, but every day. 

Be rewarded for your efforts 

We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration. 

Keyloop doesn’t require academic qualifications for this position. We select based on experience and potential, not credentials.

We are also an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We value diversity and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply . 

" At Keyloop, AI is a daily ally: We encourage and train every employee to use our AI tools to boost their creativity and productivity. "
