title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (Middle East)
description:
The Opportunity 

The infrastructure that runs the modern world (power grids, data centres, fibre networks, EV charging) is being built out faster than at any point in a generation. The companies doing that work are drowning in the volume, variety, and velocity of it. Sitetracker is how they stay ahead of it. 

Sitetracker is the AI-native platform for infrastructure lifecycle management, covering project, construction, operations, and asset management in one system of record. Scout, our enterprise AI agent platform, is what sets us apart. Scout does the work, not just reports on it, and it stays grounded in the customer's own data so the answers are trustworthy enough to act on. That is what holds up in an enterprise procurement review when a bolted-on chatbot does not. 

You will be our go-to Strategic Account Executive for the Middle East territory. Your job is to grow revenue and to shape how Sitetracker leads the AI-native transformation of digital infrastructure across the Middle East. You will own a priority territory with strong product-market fit, backed by proven customer outcomes, a differentiated platform, and strong demand generation. 

Our top performers work as enterprise advisors. They bring strategic thinking, curiosity, and real customer empathy. They own outcomes, not quotas. If you raise the bar, love winning new logos, and want autonomy, scale, and purpose, this is a role worth a serious look. 

What You'll Do 

You will join a sales team that pairs start-up pace with enterprise ambition. This is a build role, not an inherited book of business. You will define and execute the go-to-market strategy for your territory, engage new prospects, and guide them through high-stakes decisions with precision and insight. 

Every deal moves the industry forward, whether that is energising a new grid interconnection, standing up a data centre, upgrading a telecom network, or scaling EV charging. You will orchestrate complex buying journeys across large stakeholder groups, partner cross-functionally with product, marketing, and services, and earn the trust of executives on both sides. This is a quota-carrying role in a MEDDPICC environment, and it is also a chance to lead, to sell a genuinely differentiated platform, and to leave a mark. 

You will be selling into a market that is actively rethinking how it uses AI. Part of the job is separating signal from hype: showing skeptical enterprise buyers what agentic AI grounded in their own operational data actually changes about how their teams work, and what it is worth. 

The Skills You'll Have 

Enterprise Sales 

- Demonstrates evidence of selling in the Middle Eastern markets 

- Strong evidence of success selling complex SaaS solutions across mid-market, large, and enterprise accounts, ideally in Telecom, Energy, or adjacent infrastructure sectors. 

- Can walk through, in detail, how you navigate a complex enterprise SaaS deal to a win and the role you personally play in it. 

- Won high-value SaaS deals ($300k+ ARR) by navigating complex buying centres and influencing executive stakeholders. 

- Knows when to bring in the right partners based on deal strategy. 

- Defines and executes territory plans against a named top-account list, including Sitetracker's priority Middle Eastern accounts under our go-to-market strategy. 

- Executes within MEDDPICC or a comparable methodology, holding rigour and velocity across every cycle. 

Consultative Sales 

- Researches effectively: understands how a target company makes money, where it aligns to our value proposition, and who the stakeholders are. 

- Drives the conversation around product and unique value, knows the proof points, and ties platform capability directly to business outcomes. 

- Builds credible business cases and ROI models for prospects, including the economics of AI-driven automation, not just software seats. 

- Plays back the financial impact of the solution and presents commercial offers anchored to that business case. 

- Acts as a challenger and trusted advisor by knowing the customer's industry and business well. 

Entrepreneurial Mindset 

- Runs the territory like its CEO. Owns the actions, owns the decisions, and moves with speed and urgency. 

- Builds and sustains a healthy (5x) pipeline and drives opportunities through the full cycle to a win. 

- Leads a cross-functional account team (SDR, SE, Product, Delivery, Legal, CSM) through complex cycles and creates alignment between our team and the customer's. 

- Builds for the long term, focusing on durable deals that last. 

Within 90 Days, You'll: 

- Be Sitetracker certified, including a working command of how Scout is positioned and where it wins. 

- Understand Sitetracker's business objectives and strategy. 

- Know your territory and be able to build territory, account, and opportunity strategy. 

- Be developing effective cross-functional relationships across the team. 

- Begin establishing your pipeline and take ownership of existing relationships and accounts. 

- Have command of the Sitetracker message and be able to tell our story to customers and prospects. 

- Run productive meetings that advance opportunities and accounts. 

Within 180 Days, You'll: 

- Be executing the Sitetracker sales process, including MEDDPICC qualification and documentation. 

- Have exceptional command of the message and the process. 

- Have your territory planned and your pipeline defined. 

- Be actively engaged with customers and prospects and on track to goal. 

Within 365 Days, You'll: 

- Look back on year one able to take pride in "getting it done" and "doing it right." 

- Have hit your ARR and new-logo goals, delivered with quality, integrity, and respect. 

- Contribute to best practice by spotting improvements and taking the initiative to recommend and implement them. 

About Sitetracker 

Sitetracker was founded ten years ago with the singular focus of solving a problem that was first recognized within the telecommunications industry; how to effectively manage the volume, variety, and velocity of critical infrastructure projects needed to meet the demand of expanding wireless and cellular service. That problem has become even more pronounced due to the eventual explosion of 5G. Being able to effectively deploy infrastructure is going to be the differentiator between leading telecommunication providers. 

However, over the years, we realized that this challenge isn’t localized to telecommunications – it’s pervasive nearly everywhere and has reached an inflection point. Utilities (such as gas and electric services), smart cities, and alternative energy all face similar challenges. Sitetracker is the only full-lifecycle project management platform suited to support these companies and address these challenges.

We are exceptionally proud of the company we’ve built (we were recently recognized as the #2 place to work in San Francisco , as well as one of the top places to work in the entire United States). Our people are extraordinary and we’re continuing to invest in our people-first culture.

description:

description:
About Summit: 

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) 

- 
HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

- 
HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

- 
HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC) 

- 
HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland. 

Job Title: Sr. Medical Science Liaison 

Location: Oxford, UK or Zug, Switzerland or Dublin, Ireland 

Overview of Role: 

The Associate Director, Clinical Supply Management supports the Senior Director in leading the full scope of global clinical supply chain responsibilities. The role translates functional strategy into disciplined execution across demand and supply planning, inventory management, packaging and labelling, distribution, returns and destruction, cross-border compliance, and GxP operations. Acting as a key delegate for the Senior Director, the (Associate) Director provides a layer of management for direct reports, establishes clear priorities and performance expectations, develops team capability, and drives operational excellence through standardized processes, meaningful metrics, proactive risk management, and continuous improvement. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Commercial, CMC, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Legal, Procurement, Medical Affairs and Program Management, and oversees external partners including Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs), IXRS providers and specialist service providers.

Role and Responsibilities: 

- Supports the Senior Director in developing functional strategy, operating plans, budgets, governance and performance objectives across global clinical supply chain activities

- Leads day-to-day execution for new and ongoing studies and products, ensuring robust forecasting, supply planning, schedule adherence, inventory optimization, global logistics and sustained GxP compliance

- Serves as a delegate for the Senior Director in cross-functional forums, governance meetings, supplier reviews and issue escalation, providing clear recommendations and ensuring timely follow-through.

- Manages and develops direct reports, translating functional priorities into individual objectives, balancing workloads, coaching performance, supporting career development and ensuring appropriate succession and capability plans.

- Creates an effective management layer by coordinating team activities, reinforcing accountability, removing operational barriers and escalating material risks or decisions to the Senior Director.

- Overseeing the Clinical Supply Management (CSM) team, the Associate Director interprets complex clinical protocols, development plans and commercial demand forecasts, working with CMC and internal and external partners to develop packaging, labelling, supply and resupply strategies, timelines and plans.

description:
Why Faculty? 

We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here .

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the team 

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. From strengthening mission-critical capabilities across national security and intelligence, to working with frontier labs to provide robust AI safety red teaming and evaluation, we work at the frontier of high-stakes, high-impact missions. 

We understand that powerful AI systems bring both transformative opportunities and complex risks and we are proud to partner with Government and the biggest tech organisations in the world to ensure AI is not just transformative but is also secure, trustworthy and safe for all. 

About the role 

As a Customer Director at Faculty, you will serve as a trusted partner and strategic lead for the largest technology and lab clients, advancing the frontier of safe, trustworthy, and audit-ready AI systems. Blending deep technical credibility with delivery leadership, you will guide government bodies, Frontier labs, and high-impact organisations through complex AI safety, evaluation, and red-teaming challenges. 

You will own key client relationships, drive commercial strategy, and oversee multidisciplinary delivery teams to ensure cutting-edge AI deployments are secure, reliable, and grounded in real-world impact.

What you'll be doing: 

- Leading strategic accounts across AI frontier labs, hyperscalers and government entities to build long-term partnerships focused on robust AI safety, evaluation, and red teaming.

- Designing transformation programmes that integrate advanced AI evaluation methodologies, auditing frameworks, and technical standards directly into mission-critical operations.

- Partnering with senior client leaders to translate complex safety, governance, and technical AI concepts into actionable strategy and impactful programmes.

- Overseeing delivery excellence across cross-functional teams of engineers, researchers, and delivery leads to ensure high-stakes projects succeed.

- Developing commercial strategies and proposals that expand our work across safety-critical domains while meeting ambitious growth goals.

- Championing thought leadership by sharing insights on AI safety frameworks, emerging risk evaluation, and industry standards with senior stakeholders

Who we're looking for: 

- You bring deep expertise in AI safety, auditing, ethics, or evaluation methodologies, developed through time in government, research labs, or tech-forward environments.

- You are delivery-focused and technically credible, with a track record of translating complex AI and data-oriented concepts into clear strategies for technical senior leaders.

- You have a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships with senior stakeholders and navigating strategic commercial conversations with confidence.

- You excel as a collaborative leader, capable of inspiring multidisciplinary teams and bringing together technicians and delivery leads toward a shared mission.

- You possess an entrepreneurial mindset, with the curiosity and drive to identify emerging opportunities and solve ambiguous, high-stakes challenges.

- You are adaptable and outcome-driven, bringing the strategic vision needed to help partners navigate the rapidly changing AI safety landscape.

The Interview Process 

- Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

- Introduction to the team (60 minutes) 

- Discovery Role Play Interview (60 minutes) 

- Commercial Leadership Interview (60 minutes)

#LI-PRIO

Our Recruitment Ethos 

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. description:

À propos de l'opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

- Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

- Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

- Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

- Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

- Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

- Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

- Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

- Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

- Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

- Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

- Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

- Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

- Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

- La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

- Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

- La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

- Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

- La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

- Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

- Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

- Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

- Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

- Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

- Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

- Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

- Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Commercial terrain, Commercial itinérant, Sales, Freelance, Vente, Commercial B2B, Commercial indépendant, Développement commercial.

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

In 2015, we pioneered a “moneyball for biotech” approach, pooling projects and promising early-stage research from academia together under one financial umbrella to reduce risk and unleash innovation. This model allows science and small teams of experts to lead the way. We build bridges to groundbreaking advancements in rare disease, and develop life-changing medicines for patients with unmet needs as fast as humanly possible.  
  
Together we define white space, push boundaries, and empower people to solve problems. If you're someone who defies convention, join us and work alongside some of the most respected minds in the industry. Together, we'll ask "why not?" and help reengineer the future of biopharma. - Contribute to documenting the patient journey and disease burden

Function leadership and development

- Structure the function (methods, quality standards, vendor panel, review processes)

- Represent the region to global HEOR and Market Access teams

The above list of tasks is not exhaustive.

Where You’ll Work

- Travel within France, a priority country, is expected, as is travel to our international office in Zug, Switzerland, for team alignment and engagement.

- Travel to other countries in the EU West region may also be required. Local team meetings and the designated office location in France are in the Paris area.

Who You Are

Strongly preferred

Expected attributes

title: Responsable commercial régional
description:
Description de l'équipe

SumUp accélère le déploiement de ses équipes de vente terrain en France, et ce poste à responsabilité façonnera cette croissance à Toulouse, en apportant nos outils de paiement et de gestion aux petites entreprises de la région. La personne retenue dirigera et développera une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en assurant personnellement des acquisitions dans un premier temps tout en construisant la structure, la culture et le modèle de coaching qui porteront la région. C'est l'occasion de construire une région depuis ses fondations, avec une évolution possible vers un poste de Territory Manager à mesure que l'équipe et l'activité se développent, en rapportant au Head of Region France.

Vos missions

- 
Diriger et développer une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en construisant les compétences et la culture nécessaires pour s'imposer sur le marché

- 
Porter les objectifs d'acquisition de revenus de la région, piloter le portefeuille de marchands acquis et le développer par la vente croisée et la montée en gamme

- 
Fixer le niveau d'exigence en matière de performance commerciale, en ancrant une culture de coaching et de responsabilisation au sein de l'équipe terrain

- 
Façonner les outils de vente, du support de présentation aux contenus d'accompagnement, pour permettre à l'équipe de rivaliser et de gagner

- 
Maintenir une présence forte sur le terrain, réaliser des audits auprès des marchands et transformer la connaissance du marché en actions concrètes

- 
Définir la stratégie concurrentielle de la région et tenir les parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement

Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…

- 
Expérience avérée dans la direction et le développement d'équipes commerciales, incluant le coaching de consultants indépendants vers une performance durable

- 
Expérience dans la construction d'une région ou d'un territoire commercial dès ses débuts, avec la structure nécessaire pour le faire évoluer

- 
Solide connaissance des services aux marchands, des paiements, des systèmes de point de vente ou de la vente auprès des PME, par exemple dans l'hôtellerie ou le voyage

- 
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, avec une crédibilité reconnue pour évoluer dans des environnements multiculturels et face à des parties prenantes variées

- 
Prise de décision stratégique et orientée données, avec la capacité à diriger dans l'incertitude d'un marché en forte croissance

Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp

🌎 Opportunité de travailler avec des SumUppers du monde entier sur des produits fintech à grande échelle utilisés par des millions d'entreprises, dans le cadre d'un poste de terrain couvrant la région de Toulouse. Soyez acteur d'un changement qui compte vraiment.

title: Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) indépendant
description:
Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 

Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

À propos de l’opportunité

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l’aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d’opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d’une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

- 
Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

- 
Cibler les entreprises locales générant d’importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

- 
Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

- 
Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

- 
Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

- 
Établir des relations avec les chefs d’entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

- 
Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d’optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

- 
Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

- 
Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

- 
Au moins un an d’expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l’énergie, les technologies d’entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l’approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

- 
Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

- 
Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

- 
Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux clients et d’atteinte d’objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

- 
La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

- 
Un bon sens de l’organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

- 
La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d’expérience et à persévérer.

- 
Une bonne compréhension du statut d’indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

- 
La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

- 
Un réseau existant de chefs d’entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

- 
Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s’agit d’une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l’activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

- 
Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

- 
Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

- 
Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

- 
Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

- 
Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

- 
Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d’activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s’appliquer.

Les conditions d’éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s’entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l’accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d’analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d’organisation.

title: Growth - France (CDD)
description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here .

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the French market.

This is a role that spans both sales and go to market. You’ll be responsible for both winning new partners (OEMs, utilities, platforms, etc.) and making those partnerships succeed over time.

This is a multifaceted, client-facing role with a strong technical component. You will own the full commercial lifecycle and should be comfortable moving between strategic conversations, commercial negotiations, onboarding and account growth.

You will speak native-level French and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

This role will own:

- Winning new business

- Go-to-market strategy and execution

- Client onboarding and implementation support

- Account management and expansion

What you will be doing

- Owning Axle’s commercial results for the French market (pipeline, revenue and partner success)

- Building and managing a strong pipeline of partners across key segments (OEMs, energy retailers, installers, platforms, etc.)

- Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue

- Driving go-to-market execution with partners, including value propositions, pricing considerations, customer segmentation and launch strategies

- Managing post-implementation relationships with clients after go-live, driving continuous improvement and opportunity to deepen engagement or grow the account

- Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements

- Building and refine scalable sales and partner processes that support repeatable growth across different customer segments

- Tracking performance, pipeline, and outcomes, using data to prioritise effort and continuously improve commercial effectiveness

- Operating with low structure and high ownership: remove friction, avoid bureaucracy, move fast

What’s in it for you

This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience.

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

You’ll be based in France. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

- Initial interview

- Take-home exercise

- Final interview (in-person)

- Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

description:

France is one of the most important flexibility markets in Europe. This role is critical to accelerating Axle’s growth in France.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach in France.

At the core of our market expansion plans is market analysis. To maximise future revenue, we spend a lot of time understanding the value of flexibility in power markets around the world.

We are looking for a technical individual (data scientist, analyst or engineer) with strong knowledge of the French electricity markets and an instinct for commercial value.

You will become Axle’s internal expert on French power markets: understanding the market rules, modelling the value, and building relationships with system operators and regulators. We’re scrappy about method and rigorous about conclusions.

You will speak fluent French and English. Other European languages will also be an asset.

What you will be doing

- Developing a deep understanding of French energy markets and grid dynamics to understand how trading, compensation, penalties and cash flow work

- Jumping on the phone with grid operators, regulators and market stakeholders to validate hypotheses and make sense of data

- Building and optimising models of wholesale/NEBCO, capacity, balancing, ancillary services and local flexibility markets in France to forecast what different assets can earn

- Sizing the revenue opportunity across markets and products to shape where we expand next

- Building and evaluating different strategies for cycling a battery or load-shifting an EV charger

- Monitoring and shaping energy regulation to accelerate the growth of flexibility.

This is an opportunity to gain unique domain expertise and build the quantitative case for first-of-a-kind projects across the world.

What we think you need to be successful

- Deep quantitative and modelling ability (Python, SQL)

- Exceptional communication and the ability to turn data into actionable commercial insights

- Comfort moving fast and making decisions in an evolving environment

- Deep knowledge of French electricity markets (NEBCO, Mécanisme de Capacité, Mécanisme d’Ajustement, ancillary services…)

- Relationships with regulators, grid operators and other stakeholders (CRE, DGEC, RTE, Enedis, etc.) are a plus

title: Mid/Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (Full Remote - France)
description:
Our Vision & Products

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship 

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World 

50 Million Users in 2 years — Help Us Reach 100M first, 500M next 

At EverAI , we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting , we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform , redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first .

And we’re only just getting started! 

Our Team

We are an enthusiastic, passionate and hardworking team of ≈ 100 people. Our founding team has strong entrepreneurial experience building and scaling web products from 0 to IPO.

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

• 10+ years in Tech Executive Leadership 

• Co-Founder Mad Paws Holdings (from 0 to IPO) 

• Forbes 30 under 30 + Deloitte TechFast50 ’22 & ‘23 

Michael Monin [Co-founder & CTO]

• 10+ years as CTO / COO (web2/web3), 3 years in AI/LLM 

• Serial-entrepreneur: MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) and Zipchat (AI Chatbot for E-commerce brands) 

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

• 8+ years in Customer Acquisition & E-commerce Growth 

• Serial-entrepreneur: Curatible (sold to Blackstone) and MTK Digital (exited / 0->$20m revenue) 

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• 25+ years in Finance, Strategy, M&A 

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone) 

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited) 

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited) 

Your Role

We scaled to 50 million users in just 2 years with a lean team of 100 people. Last year, we doubled our headcount . 

Now, we’re scaling again, and the next hires will shape what EverAI looks like at 100+ people . As our third Talent Acquisition Specialist , you’ll be central to that build, as you’re joining at a defining stage.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Alexis, and partner with leaders across the business to help assemble the team behind one of the fastest-growing AI products globally. We hire internationally and across every function of the company, with a strong focus on tech, bringing together people from leading tech hubs around the world.

You’ll also have the opportunity to influence how Talent Acquisition evolves as we grow : refining our internal workflows, experimenting with new AI tools, launching employer branding initiatives, testing sourcing strategies that keep our quality bar high, and so on.

Key Mission

Identify, attract, and land top global talent , while helping build a recruitment stack that matches the scale and ambition of a company serving 50M users worldwide .

Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

Talent Mapping & Sourcing: 

- Global Talent Scouting: Help map and engage elite talent from Tier 1 tech hubs and companies worldwide. You’ll identify and connect with candidates who aren’t actively applying through thoughtful outreach and strong networking.

- Smart Sourcing: Support the implementation of an AI-first recruitment stack. You’ll use tools, from AI agents to niche technical communities and unconventional channels, to help us find exceptional talent

- Relationship Building: Maintain long-term relationships with passive talent globally to ensure we stay ahead of hiring needs as we continue scaling

Candidate Experience & Evaluation: 

- World-Class Candidate Experience: Own the candidate journey from the first discovery call to the final close. Ensure every interaction with EverAI, whether candidates join us or not, is clear, respectful, and high-quality

- Interviews and Screenings: Conduct structured interviews to assess technical aptitude and cultural alignment, and provide concise, actionable summaries for Hiring Managers and Leadership

Process Innovation & Collaboration: 

- Hiring Operations: Work closely with Founders and Team Leads to improve hiring workflows, remove friction, and strengthen how we operate as we grow past 100+ employees

- Employer Branding and other Initiatives: Contribute to creative initiatives and content that position EverAI as the #1 destination for the world’s best AI talent

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

- Minimum 3 years of experience in recruitment, with at least 2 years in tech recruitment 

- Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment 

- Global sourcing experience: You have a track record of helping attract talent from major tech hubs (USA, EU, LATAM, etc.)

- Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools

- You thrive in a high-trust environment where you are empowered to learn, improve processes, and make an impact 

Others

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable hiring for products that are based on uncensored models and content

Bonus points

- Experience in AI recruitment or familiarity with the AI space

- Exposure to employer branding, compensation benchmarking, or broader TA initiatives 

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth : From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation : We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact : Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership : A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team : 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies , with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core : Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology , ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact

title: Enterprise Sales Lead (French market)
description:

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

We’re opening an Enterprise Sales Team Lead role in France to lead a growing team of 4 Senior Account Executives, who are in charge of acquiring customers with more than 3,000 employees, including all CAC40 companies. 

In this role, you will own acquisition on the Enterprise segment in France and run the business end‑to‑end : you will be hands-on on the field while coaching and scaling a team of Account Executives to win this market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition: We have just passed the one million member milestone – and this is only the beginning! We’re accelerating acquisition in France and doubling down on our portfolio — and the Enterprise segment is one of the core pillars of that plan .

About the Enterprise segment 

- Perimeter: companies of 3000+ employees

- Verticals: all Verticals (Tech, Retail, Industrial Companies etc)

- Total Addressable Market: ~ 7M members in France

Why Enterprise Sales is exciting at Alan 

- Diverse workforce : Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

- Critical challenges : Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers, Unions, long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

- Company profiles : Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

- HR priorities : Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

- Critical business characteristics : This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise Account Executives.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

⭐ What you will do ⭐ 

You will be the Sales leader of the Enterprise Sales team in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and scaling the machine .

More precisely, you will:

- Own the Enterprise acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go‑to‑market strategy for 3000 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets and scale the segment .

- Lead & coach a team of 4 Account Executives (and likely more to come)

- Drive hiring, onboarding, and career development as we scale the crew and the segment.

- Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations , rigorous follow‑up , and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution, and pipeline management.

- Be on the field with the team : prospecting, joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

- Empower every member of the team: Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals : strong feedback culture, coaching, clear ownership, and autonomy.

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? ⭐ 

You may be a great fit at Alan if you: 

- Have at least 10 years experience in B2B sales , with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

- Have experience leading and coaching sales teams , with the ability to set a high bar , give clear direction , and help people grow 

- Have full working proficiency in French , and advanced level in English for internal communication

- Have a very hands‑on mentality : you love being on the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations, and sharing what works

- Have experience selling to Enterprise level companies (3000+ employees and above) in multi‑stakeholder deals 

- Are comfortable operating in fast‑paced, ambiguous environments , and can prioritize ruthlessly 

- Are data‑driven and analytical : you know how to leverage KPIs to drive performance, run analyses, and make decisions

- Have strong cross‑functional collaboration skills and appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

- Are based (or willing to relocate to) the Paris area 

Nice-to-have: 

- Experience selling to HR or Finance 

.

🙌 Perks & Benefits 

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need , and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

- Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours . Organize your time as you wish.

- Transport . Country-specific commuter benefits.

- Learning & Training opportunities . A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

- Parental leave . Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. 

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply !

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

As a senior member of our Paris HQ Finance team, the Senior FP&A Analyst holds the full view of the company P&L, from net sales to EBITDA, across all channels and regions. Act as the go-to reference on P&L performance and its drivers for the Head of Finance and the leadership team.

- Budgeting & forecasting: lead the annual budget, monthly reforecasts and long-range plan. Own the planning calendar, key assumptions and models, and consolidate inputs from regional and functional stakeholders.

- Margin management: own margin analysis at every level (channel, market, category, collection, SKU), including markdowns, promotions, cost of goods, freight, duties, FX and inventory provisions. Build margin bridges, explain variances and drive recommendations on pricing and markdown strategy.

- Business partnering: serve as finance partner to Retail, E-Commerce, Wholesale, Merchandising and Supply Chain leaders on store P&Ls, inventory productivity and open-to-buy, pricing, promotional plans, and business cases for store openings and market entries.

- Processes & controls: design, document and continuously improve FP&A processes, templates, review controls and data standards. Drive reporting automation across the finance stack (NetSuite, Excel / Google Sheets, BI tools) in coordination with Accounting and IT.

- Leadership support: prepare materials for executive and board reviews and lead ad hoc analyses requested by the CFO and the Head of Finance. Review and guide the work of junior team members.

Requirements: 

- 5–7 years of experience in FP&A, controlling or financial planning, with significant exposure to a company-wide or business-unit scope.

- Retail experience is mandatory: proven experience in a retail or fashion company with a store network and multi-channel model, and a solid command of store economics, seasonality, markdowns, inventory and open-to-buy.

- Full P&L vision: hands-on experience owning or co-owning a full P&L, from top line to EBITDA, including consolidation across channels or countries.

- Strong margin expertise: gross margin building blocks, markdown and promotional impact, landed cost, inventory valuation and provisions, with the ability to explain margin drivers clearly to non-finance stakeholders.

- Rigorous and process-oriented: a track record of building or improving planning, closing and reporting processes, with reliable delivery against deadlines.

- Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and financial modeling skills; experience with an ERP (NetSuite is a plus) and a BI or reporting tool (Power BI, Looker, Tableau or equivalent).

- Master's degree in Finance, Business or Engineering, or equivalent.

title: Care Account Manager (Clinical), Europe & West Africa
description:
The Role 

Intellect delivers a clinically governed mental health programme to enterprise clients in the mining and resources sector, supporting remote and expatriate workforces. This is not a standard EAP. Cases begin with acute risk assessment on remote sites and run through structured treatment, fitness-for-work assessment and return-to-work clearance, in direct coordination with the client's chaplaincy, medical and people teams.

This role covers the client's United Kingdom operations and a West African project site where the working language is French. It is a combined clinical delivery and case management role: the postholder conducts the assessments, delivers the therapy, writes the reports and owns the case, rather than coordinating a provider network. That design reflects the absence of an established provider network in the West African market at launch, and gives the client a single clinician who knows each case end to end.

Full professional fluency in French and English is a non-negotiable requirement. Welfare calls, clinical assessment, case documentation and client communication in the West African market are conducted in French.

Responsibilities

Clinical assessment and delivery 

- Conduct acute risk and welfare assessments for employees referred through the client's escalation pathway, in French or English as required.
- Deliver individual counselling and psychotherapy across the supported caseload, virtually.
- Conduct fitness-for-work assessments and produce the associated clinical documentation.
- Write risk assessments, session documentation, return-to-work memoranda and fitness-for-work reports to a standard that stands up to client and regulatory scrutiny, in the language the case requires.
- Delivery is capped so that case management availability is protected. Session load is agreed with the Head of Clinical Operations and reviewed as volume changes.
Case management and coordination 

- Own each case end to end, from referral through assessment, treatment, fitness-for-work and reintegration to closure.
- Align the initial support plan with the client's on-site teams, including session volume and cadence, and manage adjustments where clinically indicated.
- Coordinate with internal helpline, care excellence and network partnership teams on anything that cannot be delivered directly.
- Review the open case list for stalled items and follow up to keep cases moving.
Clinical risk oversight and governance 

- Confirm risk tiering against the client's framework and set review cadence and monitoring requirements.
- Make the clinical decisions the pathway requires, including disputed risk ratings and medical evaluation pathways where an employee declines therapy.
- Escalate to the Head of Clinical Operations where a case exceeds the scope of remote delivery or requires in-person intervention.
- Work within the differing regulatory, medical and emergency-escalation environments of each market, and flag where local pathways do not support the agreed protocol.
Clinical protocols and client enablement 

- Co-develop and maintain the clinical protocols, risk frameworks and SOPs the client's on-site teams operate to, including French-language versions.
- Design and deliver clinical training and framework guidance to client-side staff who are not clinicians, in French and English.
- Build out the in-market provider network alongside Network Partnerships, so that in-person and overflow capacity exists as the programme scales.
Client relationship, insights and reporting 

- Act as the named clinical contact for the client's chaplaincy, medical and health and safety leads in both markets, responding within the core window to queries that are frequently unscheduled and time-critical.
- Produce the case tracker and monthly clinical reporting, moving beyond utilisation to presenting issues, risk patterns, outcomes and service-level themes.
- Present clinical insight at client review meetings and translate it into recommendations the client's health and safety and people teams can act on.
Requirements 

- Full professional fluency in French and English, to the standard required for clinical assessment, therapy delivery and client-facing documentation in both languages.
- Registered clinical psychologist or qualified counsellor, with current registration in your jurisdiction and the right to practise remotely.
- Master's degree in clinical psychology, counselling or a related field.
- Minimum three years in clinical practice, including direct delivery of assessment and therapy to adults.
- Demonstrable experience managing acute risk, including suicidality, in a setting where you held the decision rather than advised on it.
- Experience of structured return-to-work, fitness-for-work or occupational mental health pathways.
- Able to work four hours a day, Monday to Friday, within the 08:00 to 17:00 UK and West Africa window.
Desirable 

- Experience working across multiple jurisdictions or with expatriate, rotational or multinational workforces.
- Understanding of remote industrial, mining, resources or energy operating environments.
- Additional language capability, particularly Mandarin.
- Experience contributing to clinical protocols, risk frameworks or SOPs.
- Prior case management or clinical account experience in a commercial setting.

- Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

- Leidenschaft für digitale, patientenzentrierte Versorgung

- Offenheit, Neues zu gestalten – und Altes zu hinterfragen

- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
Accelerating embodied AGI. 

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do 

- Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

- Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

- Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

- Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

- Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

- Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

- Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements 

- Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

- Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern.

In dieser Rolle wirst Du - Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen.

title: Embedded Control Engineer
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO 

- Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

- Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT 

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO 

- Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

- Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

- Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

- Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE 

- You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

- You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

- You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

- You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE 

- Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS 

- Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

- Technical Screening (30 min)

- Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: Global Events Lead
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a highly motivated Events Lead to own planning and execution of ElevenLabs' flagship events. Your work will deepen ElevenLabs' brand presence, create high-impact moments with customers and prospects, and generate high-quality pipeline in partnership with our GTM teams.

You'll own the full lifecycle of our flagship owned events - summits, experiential activations, marquee sponsorships, and signature brand moments. This role is focused on our flagship event portfolio, distinct from regional field marketing and third-party conference attendance.

What you'll do 

- Develop and execute flagship event plans aligned with business objectives across key markets

- Own owned/branded flagship events, and marquee sponsorships (e.g. F1, major industry summits) end to end

- Collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, product, and GTM teams for seamless execution

- Analyze event performance and provide recommendations for future improvements

- Build and maintain relationships with sponsors, partners, agencies, and production vendors across North America

Requirements 

- 8+ years events experience, with at least three in tech/enterprise flagship event marketing

- Track record of producing large-scale, high-profile branded events end to end

- Deep knowledge of the tech ecosystem and executive/enterprise audiences

- Experience working with premium event agencies and production partners

- Based in NYC or SF preferred

title: Senior Radiochemist
description:
ABOUT US 

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE 

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES 

Process development: 

- Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.

- Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.

- Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.

- Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations: 

- Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.

- cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.

- Define process, equipment, utility, instrumentation and facility-interface requirements.

- Support equipment selection, sizing, qualification, commissioning and process validation.

- Develop operating procedures, batch records, control strategies and consumables requirements.

- Prepare laboratory and production operations aligned with capacity and customer needs.

- Train and mentor colleagues.

Compliance, quality, and safety: 

- Work with QA and Safety to ensure regulatory compliance and meet applicable standards

- Implement and monitor safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS 

The candidates we are looking for must have:

- PhD or Master’s degree in Radiochemistry, Nuclear Chemistry or related field

- A minimum of 10 years of experience in radiochemistry.

- Proven experience in radiochemical separation and purification with strong knowledge of actinide chemistry.

description:
About Electra 

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be.
