At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027. 

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another. 

Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways. 

The Role 

As Electra's Senior Structural Assembly Manufacturing Engineer, you'll play a key role in developing and industrializing the structural assembly processes for the EL9 aircraft, working from early product development through prototype build, production implementation, and ramp-up.

You'll work closely with Product Engineering during aircraft development to ensure structural designs incorporate Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles and can be efficiently, repeatably, and reliably produced. You'll bring a hands-on manufacturing perspective to structural design decisions, evaluating assembly sequence, tolerance management, access, tooling, fastening and joining methods, inspection requirements, producibility, and production risk.

As the EL9 transitions from design into physical hardware, you'll help translate released engineering into executable manufacturing processes and support prototype and initial aircraft builds. You'll work closely with airframe manufacturing suppliers, providing on-site Manufacturing Engineering oversight and liaison support as needed to ensure proper information flow, resolve technical and quality issues, support the incorporation of product changes and support supply chain on contract management.

This is an opportunity to influence both how the aircraft is designed and how it is ultimately built, while helping establish Electra's structural assembly manufacturing supply chain capability from the ground up.

What You'll Do 

- Partner with Product Engineering throughout aircraft development to ensure structural designs incorporate Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles and support efficient, repeatable, and scalable production.

- Review aircraft structural designs, assemblies, drawings, models, and engineering changes from a manufacturing perspective, providing recommendations related to producibility, assembly sequence, access, tolerance stack-up, fastening and joining methods, tooling, inspection, and production risk.

- Participate in design trade studies, concept reviews, and design reviews, representing Manufacturing Engineering and identifying manufacturing constraints and opportunities early in the development cycle.

- Provide Manufacturing Engineering oversight and liaison support at airframe and structural suppliers, working directly with supplier manufacturing teams to clarify design and manufacturing intent, resolve producibility and assembly issues, and maintain program execution.

- Work closely with the airframe supplier Tooling Engineering to define assembly tooling concepts, requirements, locating strategies, interfaces, and implementation plans.

- Review supplier manufacturing approaches, build plans, assembly processes, tooling concepts, and production readiness to ensure alignment with Electra's engineering requirements and program objectives.

- Support prototype fabrication, development aircraft assembly, first builds, and production implementation, providing hands-on Manufacturing Engineering support to resolve issues encountered during structural assembly.

- Coordinate technical resolution of manufacturing issues and nonconformances with Product Engineering, Stress, Quality, Supplier Quality, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders.

- Capture manufacturing lessons learned and supplier feedback from prototype and initial production builds and drive those learnings back into product design, manufacturing processes, tooling, and planning.

- Support structural assembly production ramp-up by identifying constraints, resolving manufacturing issues, improving assembly processes, and driving improvements in quality, cost, schedule, and production rate.

- Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of Electra manufacturing engineering standards, methods, processes, and best practices.

What You Bring

- 8+ years of aerospace manufacturing engineering experience, with significant experience in aircraft structural assembly and industrialization.

- Strong hands-on knowledge of aircraft structural assembly processes, including metallic and/or composite airframe structures, drilling, fastening, joining, shimming, sealing, alignment, and major structural integration.

- Demonstrated experience applying Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFMA) principles during aircraft product development.

Bonus Points

About the role 

ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

title: Director, Business Development
description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

Key position responsibilities: 

- Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

- Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

- Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

- Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

- Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

- Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

- Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

- Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

- Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

- Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international

Essential skills required: 

- Commit to a high level of integrity and service

- Deliver quality work

- Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

- Owning your performance and taking responsibility

- Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

- Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

- Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

- Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

- Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

- Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

- Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required: 

- Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

- Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

- Superior written and spoken communication skills in German and English 

- Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. title: Stagiair(e) Marketing
description:
Ben jij een creatieve en enthousiaste student die zich wil ontwikkelen in de wereld van marketing en communicatie én waardevolle ervaring wil opdoen binnen een ambitieus team?

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een creatieve duizendpoot die barst van de ideeën en niet bang is om initiatief te nemen. Je houdt van aanpakken, denkt in mogelijkheden en weet meerdere projecten tegelijk te coördineren. Met jouw organisatietalent en communicatieve skills breng je niet alleen structuur, maar ook energie en gezelligheid in het team. Herken jij jezelf als marketing- en communicatietopper in spé? Dan willen we jou graag leren kennen!

Voor deze stage zoeken wij iemand die:

· Studeert in de richting van Marketing of Communicatie (HBO);

· Op zoek is naar een meewerkstage van 4 dagen per week;

· Nieuwsgierig en leergierig is;

· Creativiteit graag inzet in het werk.

Wat ga je doen

Geen dag is hetzelfde, en dat maakt jouw stage bij ons juist zo leuk en veelzijdig. Je denkt actief mee over de opzet en uitvoering van marketingcampagnes, waarbij jouw frisse blik en creatieve input van grote waarde zijn. Je helpt bij het ontwikkelen van campagnes voor onze leden, creëert pakkende content en werkt mee aan het vormgeven van promotiemateriaal. Ook krijg je de kans om mee te organiseren aan (sponsor)evenementen en ondersteun je collega’s bij het verbeteren van processen en projecten. Kortom: je draait volwaardig mee in het team en krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te laten zien én te groeien. 

Wat bieden wij

- Een leerzame en leuke stage binnen een enthousiast en betrokken team. Laat jij initiatief zien? Dan krijg je volop kansen om mee te denken en mee te doen; 

- Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en het beste uit jezelf te halen;

- Een enthousiast team van ervaren Marketing collega’s;

- Een stagevergoeding van €600,- per maand (bij 38 uur per week); 

- Minstens twee gezamenlijke kantoordagen per week in Heerenveen met het team.

Wie wij zijn

Univé Dichtbij is één van de acht regiokantoren binnen Univé. Als coöperatie helpen we mensen zo zorgeloos mogelijk te leven en ondernemen. Dat doen we al meer dan 200 jaar: samen risico’s dragen, zonder winstoogmerk en met oog voor elkaar.

We zijn er niet alleen om te verzekeren, maar ook om te voorkomen, adviseren en begeleiden. Juist in een wereld die steeds digitaler en complexer wordt, blijven wij dichtbij: met persoonlijk advies, lokale betrokkenheid en aandacht voor wat mensen echt nodig hebben.

Met 24 winkels en 480 collega’s in Utrecht, Gelderland, Drenthe, Overijssel, Flevoland en Friesland zijn we letterlijk in de buurt. Onze winkels zijn vertrouwde plekken voor advies, een goed gesprek en verbinding met de omgeving. Bij Univé Dichtbij draait het om vertrouwen, verbondenheid en samen sterk staan, voor onze leden, voor elkaar en voor de samenleving om ons heen.

Overige informatie

Interesse?

Senior Projectmanager
description:
Werken bij een verzekeraar saai? Niet bij Univé! 

Wie ben jij

Jij bent een verbindende projectleider met sterke organisatorische vaardigheden en gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen. Je behoudt overzicht in een dynamische omgeving, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor resultaatgebieden en weet mensen mee te nemen in verandering. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen operationeel, tactisch en strategisch niveau en creëert draagvlak bij verschillende stakeholders.

Verder beschik je over:

- hbo/wo werk- en denkniveau;

- minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als IT-projectleider, programmamanager of delivery lead;

- ervaring binnen complexe enterprise IT-omgevingen;

- kennis van Agile/Scrum en hybride projectmethodieken;

- ervaring met stakeholdermanagement op managementniveau;

- aantoonbare kennis van en ervaring met het begeleiden van RFI- en RFP-trajecten, inclusief requirementsvorming, marktverkenning, leveranciersselectie, beoordelingsprocessen en contractvoorbereiding;

- affiniteit met IT-governance, servicemanagement en security/compliance;

- sterke communicatieve vaardigheden, organisatiesensitiviteit en besluitvaardigheid.

Pré 

- ervaring binnen financiële dienstverlening of de verzekeringssector;

- kennis van DORA, ITSM, cloudtransities, sourcingvraagstukken en aanbestedingstrajecten via RFI/RFP;

- ervaring met OKR's en waardestroomgericht werken;

Voor deze rol zijn vooral de volgende competenties belangrijk:

Verbindend leiderschap, resultaatgerichtheid, organisatiesensitiviteit, analytisch vermogen en besluitvaardigheid. Je brengt structuur aan in complexe omgevingen, communiceert helder, creëert draagvlak en weet samenwerking tussen verschillende stakeholders effectief te organiseren.

Wat ga je doen

Als Projectleider binnen IT Kern bij Univé ben je verantwoordelijk voor het initiëren, coördineren en realiseren van organisatiebrede IT-projecten en verandertrajecten. Je opereert in een complexe omgeving waarin continuïteit, security, compliance, servicemanagement en digitale transformatie samenkomen. 

Je werkt nauw samen met teammanagers, product owners, servicemanagers, architectuur, securityspecialisten, leveranciers en stakeholders binnen de Regionale Univé's. 

Je zorgt ervoor dat projecten voorspelbaar, beheerst en met draagvlak worden uitgevoerd. Daarbij bewaak je de balans tussen run, change, innovatie en compliance. 
Binnen IT Kern werk je aan trajecten die direct bijdragen aan de strategische beweging van Univé richting een moderne, omnichannel en toekomstbestendige IT-organisatie. 

Wat ga je doen? 
Als Projectleider IT Kern leid je complexe IT-projecten en verandertrajecten binnen een organisatiebrede context. Je zorgt voor een heldere projectaanpak, bewaakt voortgang, risico’s, afhankelijkheden, budget en kwaliteit, en stuurt multidisciplinaire teams aan. Je verbindt operationele IT-vraagstukken met strategische doelen en zorgt voor draagvlak bij management, CIO Office, Regionale Univé’s, leveranciers en interne IT-teams. Daarnaast begeleid je waar nodig RFI- en RFP-trajecten, van scopebepaling tot leveranciersselectie en overdracht naar implementatie. 

Resultaatgebieden 
De belangrijkste resultaatgebieden zijn: 
Project- en teamsturing 
Je stelt projectplannen op, organiseert projectteams en stuurt interne en externe betrokkenen aan op het behalen van het gewenste resultaat. 
Governance en besluitvorming 
Je zorgt voor duidelijke documentatie, rapportages en besluitvorming, onder andere richting stuurgroep en management. 
Stakeholdermanagement 
Je informeert, betrekt en verbindt stakeholders binnen IT, business, Regionale Univé’s en externe leveranciers. 
Voortgang, kwaliteit en verbetering 
Je bewaakt planning, capaciteit, risico’s en resultaten, evalueert projecten en draagt bij aan verbetering van projectmanagementaanpak en werkwijzen. 

Algemene onderwerpen binnen de functie 
Binnen de functie werk je aan thema’s die bijdragen aan een toekomstbestendige IT-organisatie, zoals IT-continuïteit, DORA en IT Assurance, security en autorisatiemanagement, cloudtransitie en sourcing. Ook spelen servicemanagement, governanceontwikkeling, waardestromen, roadmaps, OKR’s, kwartaalplanning en capaciteitsmanagement een belangrijke rol. Daarbij bewaak je steeds de balans tussen run, change, innovatie en compliance. 

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie. Je krijgt een rol waarin je zichtbaar bijdraagt aan de digitale transformatie van Univé en waarin je samenwerkt met gedreven professionals binnen IT Kern.

Deze functie is ingedeeld in schaal 10. De salarisrange ligt tussen € 64.830,24 en € 93.155,08 bruto per jaar op basis van een 38-urige werkweek. Dit is inclusief vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand en exclusief variabele beloning.

De belangrijkste arbeidsvoorwaarden op een rijtje:

- een prima salaris, afhankelijk van je opleiding, ervaring en competenties;

- 13e maand;

- 8% vakantiegeld;

- variabele Collectieve Prestatie Beloning van maximaal 9% van het jaarsalaris;

- arbeidsvoorwaardenkeuzesysteem: tijd voor geld of geld voor tijd;

- 26 vakantiedagen bij een 38-urige werkweek;

- goede studiekostenregeling;

- prima pensioenvoorziening;

- reiskostenvergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer en een thuiswerkvergoeding;

- korting op je schade- en zorgverzekeringen bij Univé.

Het team heeft een fijne werkplek in Zwolle, vlakbij het station. In overleg met het team behoort 2 tot 3 dagen thuiswerken tot de mogelijkheden.

Wie wij zijn

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die altijd dicht bij haar leden staat en gericht is op het bieden van financiële zekerheid. We richten ons op het voorkomen van risico's, het beperken van gevolgen en het verzekeren wanneer dat nodig is. Vanuit onze coöperatieve kracht ontwikkelen we samen continu nieuwe producten, diensten en oplossingen voor onze leden.

Het groeiende bedrijfsonderdeel IT staat voor de uitdaging om het IT-landschap en de IT-organisatie binnen de Univé Formule te transformeren naar een wendbare, innovatieve, bestuurbare en toekomstgerichte platformorganisatie. Schaalbare technologie en processen, optimaal gebruik van datatoepassingen, integratie en standaardisatie zijn hierbij belangrijke doelen. Zo levert IT kostenefficiënt en effectief een strategische bijdrage aan de continuïteit en innovatiekracht van Univé.

Drie focusgebieden 

De IT-organisatie is ingericht met drie primaire afdelingen op de focusgebieden Kern, Data en Distributie. De CIO Office biedt ondersteuning door richting en houvast te geven aan strategische doelen en kaders.

IT Kern 

De afdeling IT Kern bestaat uit vier teams:

• Services - werkplekdiensten, 1e lijns gebruikersondersteuning, proces- en servicemanagement en consultancy.

• Frontend Platform - applicatiemanagement van platformen die vooral het contact met onze leden ondersteunen, zoals de online omgeving, CRM en telefonie.

• Backend Platform - applicatiemanagement van platformen die de achterkantprocessen ondersteunen, zoals polis-, claim- en financiële administratie.

• Infra & Security Platform - cloud center of expertise en operationele securityactiviteiten.

Interim Senior Business Change Manager
description:
Voor ons Business Change-team zoeken wij een ervaren Interim Senior Business Change Manager die tijdelijk versterking biedt op complexe en organisatiebrede veranderopgaven. Je stapt in waar vraagstukken nog niet volledig zijn uitgekristalliseerd, brengt snel structuur aan en zorgt samen met de business dat verandering daadwerkelijk wordt gerealiseerd. In deze senior rol combineer je analyse en advisering met hands-on delivery. 

Wie ben jij
Je bent een ervaren change professional die comfortabel is in complexiteit en ambiguïteit. Je doorgrondt snel wat er speelt, maakt samenhang en keuzes expliciet en vertaalt strategische ambities naar een uitvoerbare veranderagenda. Je bent geen coördinator op afstand, maar neemt eigenaarschap voor voortgang en resultaat.

Je beweegt gemakkelijk tussen strategie en uitvoering en bent een stevige sparringpartner voor management en directie. Tegelijkertijd blijf je dicht op de operatie: je analyseert, schrijft, structureert, faciliteert en realiseert zelf. Je houdt overzicht in complexe omgevingen en weet verschillende belangen, afhankelijkheden en stakeholders effectief bij elkaar te brengen.

Verder beschik je over:

- Ruime ervaring met complexe business change-, programma- of transformatieopgaven.

- Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig realiseren van meerdere veranderopgaven, van eerste vraagstuk tot implementatie en duurzame borging.

- Sterke ervaring met programma- en projectmanagement, change management en implementatie.

- Ervaring met portfolio management en/of strategy execution, waaronder prioritering, roadmapping en afhankelijkheden.

- Aantoonbare ervaring met Lean, Operational Excellence of vergelijkbare verbetermethodieken.

- De senioriteit om op management- en directieniveau te adviseren én hands-on in de operatie te leveren, met sterk stakeholdermanagement en organisatiesensitiviteit.

- Je werkt aantoonbaar AI-native en gebruikt generatieve AI als persoonlijke productiviteits- en kwaliteitstool voor analyse, voorbereiding, communicatie en delivery.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Interim Senior Business Change Manager werk je nauw samen met de Manager Business Change, het bestaande Business Change-team, domeineigenaren en lijnmanagement. Afhankelijk van de opgave treed je op als programmamanager, project- of change lead, domein change lead of portfolioregisseur.

Je neemt zelfstandig zwaardere opdrachten op je en brengt structuur aan in complexe of deels ambigue situaties. Daarbij zorg je niet alleen voor een goede aanpak en besluitvorming, maar juist ook voor daadwerkelijke implementatie, adoptie en duurzame borging in de lijn.

Je taken bestaan onder andere uit:

- Complexe businessvraagstukken structureren en vertalen naar een heldere veranderopgave, aanpak, scope, roadmap en governance.

- Leiden en realiseren van multidisciplinaire veranderopgaven, programma’s en projecten van analyse en besluitvorming tot implementatie en borging.

- Uitvoeren en begeleiden van business analysis, impactanalyse en solution shaping en voorbereiden van heldere managementbesluitvorming.

- Sturen op stakeholders, afhankelijkheden, risico’s, issues en besluiten en zorgen voor effectieve samenwerking met de business.

- Strategische en domeinambities vertalen naar concrete veranderopgaven, roadmaps en uitvoerbare initiatieven.

- Bijdragen aan portfoliosturing door prioriteiten, capaciteit, afhankelijkheden, voortgang, sturingsinformatie en beoogde businessresultaten inzichtelijk te maken.

- Processen analyseren en verbeteren en Lean- en Continuous Improvement-methodieken praktisch toepassen binnen veranderopgaven.

Wat wij bieden 

- Een uurtarief tussen € 100 en € 110 per uur en een looptijd van de opdracht tot en met 31 januari 2027.

- Een opdracht van 24 tot 32 uur per week, waarbij maandag, dinsdag en eventueel donderdag de vaste kantoordagen in Sliedrecht zijn.

- Een tijdelijke senior opdracht voor complexe en organisatiebrede veranderopgaven, waarin je zelfstandig zwaardere opdrachten kunt dragen.

- Een brede rol waarin portfolio management, strategy execution, change delivery en Operational Excellence samenkomen.

- Nauwe samenwerking met de Manager Business Change, het Business Change-team, domeineigenaren, lijnmanagement en inhoudelijke experts.

- Een opdracht waarin je analyse, advisering en hands-on delivery combineert en zichtbaar bijdraagt aan implementatie, adoptie en borging.

Wie wij zijn 

Univé Zuid-Nederland is één van de acht regionale Univé's, een coöperatie met de missie om de meest menselijke financiële dienstverlener van Nederland te zijn. Ons werkgebied bestaat uit Noord-Brabant, Limburg, Zeeland en delen van Utrecht, Gelderland en Zuid-Holland. Wij zijn verzekeraar en bemiddelaar in schade- en levensverzekeringen, voor zowel de particuliere als zakelijke markt. Daarnaast zijn wij ook erkend hypotheekadviseur. Onze belofte, persoonlijk en dichtbij, komt tot leven in onze lokale dienstverlening, samenwerkingen en sponsoring. Het mooiste van Univé? Dat zijn de mensen, de geschiedenis, de cultuur en de betrokkenheid. A Great Place to Work!

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description:
dnata is one of the world's largest air services providers, delivering ground handling, cargo, travel and flight catering services across more than 30 countries. At Schiphol Airport, our Passenger Services operation plays a critical role in delivering safe, efficient and customer-focused services to some of the world's leading airlines.

To support our ongoing growth and transformation, we seek an experienced, commercially focused Senior HR Business Partner to work with our Passenger Services leadership team.

The Opportunity

As Senior HR Business Partner – Passenger Services, you will advise senior operational leaders and help develop and implement people strategies that drive business performance, operational excellence and organizational transformation.

This high-profile role in a fast-paced airport environment requires expertise in workforce planning, leadership, employee engagement and organizational scalability. You will help drive growth, support major operational changes and ensure the business has the talent, structure and capabilities needed for the future.

The ideal candidate brings strong business acumen, deep HR expertise and excels in environments that require both strategic thinking and operational execution.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnering

- Partner with senior Passenger Services leaders to translate business objectives into practical people strategies.

- Provide strategic advice on organizational design, workforce planning, talent management and leadership effectiveness.

- Support major business initiatives, growth plans and transformation programs.

Organizational Effectiveness & Transformation

- Lead HR programs and implement organizational change and transformation initiatives related to tenders.

- Drive continuous improvement across people processes, structures and ways of working.

- Use workforce analytics and business insights to identify opportunities and improve organizational performance.

- Ensure organizational readiness for operational growth, tender mobilizations and business expansion.

Talent & Leadership Development

- Develop leadership capability through coaching, constructive challenge and support.

- Drive succession planning and talent development initiatives.

- Support performance management and talent review processes.

- Promote internal mobility and career development opportunities across the organization.

Employee Experience & Engagement

- Lead employee engagement initiatives and help foster a high-performance culture.

- Work with leaders to enhance employee experience, retention and workforce stability.

- Promote dnata's Vision, Mission, Values and The dnata Way.

Employee Relations & Compliance

- Offer expert guidance on employment law, employee relations and complex people issues.

- Ensure consistent application of policies, procedures and governance standards throughout the organization.

- Manage organizational risks and ensure compliance with local legislation and company requirements.

Data & Business Insights

- Use workforce data, trends and analytics to inform decision making.

- Monitor key people metrics and provide actionable recommendations to leaders.

- Develop solutions that balance employee needs, operational demands and commercial objectives.

Experience

- Minimum 5–7 years of progressive HR experience, including experience as an HR Business Partner in a complex and operational environment.

- Demonstrated experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing business decisions.

- Proven track record of leading organizational change and transformation initiatives

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology or a related field.

- Strong commercial and business acumen.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Ability to challenge constructively and influence at all levels of the organization.

- Analytical and data-driven approach to problem solving.

- Agile mindset with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment.

- Strong project management and execution capabilities.

- High level of resilience, ownership and accountability.

Why Join dnata?

At dnata, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in one of the most dynamic operational environments in the Netherlands. You will collaborate with experienced leaders, contribute to large-scale transformation and help shape the future of our Passenger Services operation at Schiphol Airport.

If you are an ambitious HR professional who enjoys integrating strategy, leadership and execution, we encourage you to apply.

Ready to take off with us? Apply now to join the dnata journey.

Jouw rol: regisseur van Planning & Control 

Als Senior Financial Controller ben jij de spil in de P&C-cyclus. Jij zorgt dat alle betrokkenen precies weten wat er wanneer moet gebeuren, bewaakt de kwaliteit en houdt de bestuurlijke lijnen strak. · De volledige Planning & Control-cyclus coördineren: van begroting tot jaarrekening. 

· De planning, voortgang en kwaliteit van alle P&C-producten bewaken. 

· Collega’s aansturen zodat zij tijdig en met de juiste kwaliteit aanleveren. 

· Bestuurlijke voorstellen, informatienota’s en technische toelichtingen opstellen. 

· Moties, amendementen en technische vragen van raad en college beantwoorden. 

· Startbijeenkomsten organiseren en zorgen voor goede afstemming met organisatie, management, griffie en accountant.

· Vernieuwende manieren ontwikkelen om bestuur en raad beter te informeren (dashboards, visualisaties, data, AI). 

· Financial Controllers coachen en ondersteunen bij complexe vraagstukken. 

· Sparringpartner zijn voor de teammanager en strategisch financieel adviseurs.

· Een actieve rol spelen in de implementatie van ons nieuwe financiële systeem. 

Waarom deze functie bijzonder is 

De financiële afdeling staat aan de vooravond van een grote moderniseringsslag.Er wordt een nieuw financieel systeem geïmplementeerd, stevig ingezet op digitalisering, datagedreven werken en AI, en routinematige werkzaamheden worden zoveel mogelijk geautomatiseerd. Dat betekent dat jij niet alleen werkt aan de Planning & Control van vandaag, maar ook aan de financiële afdeling van morgen. 

Je komt terecht in een professioneel, ambitieus team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. We geloven in eigenaarschap, samenwerking en elkaar versterken. Jij wordt een van de sleutelfiguren in deze ontwikkeling. 

Wat breng jij mee? 

Je bent een ervaren financial met een stevige inhoudelijke basis. Je houdt overzicht, brengt structuur aan en weet mensen mee te nemen. Je beweegt soepel tussen uitvoering, management, college en gemeenteraad en kunt complexe financiële informatie begrijpelijk maken voor verschillende doelgroepen. 

Daarnaast heb je: 

· Een hbo- of wo-opleiding in een financiële of bedrijfseconomische richting. 

· Ruime ervaring met de Planning & Control-cyclus.

title: Postgres Engineer
description:
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a Senior Postgres Engineer to join our Postgres Team and help maintain and expand the stability and functionality of our hosted Postgres offering . You’ll work closely with customers, partners, product, engineering, support and success, helping us maintain a secure, stable, performant, and functional Postgres foundation.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What you'll own: 

- 
Build and maintain PostgreSQL extensions in C and Rust, with a deep understanding of internals — parser, planner, WAL mechanics, and MVCC

- 
Diagnose and resolve issues in managed PostgreSQL deployments, including custom extension failures, core dump analysis, and performance bottlenecks

- 
Own idempotent deployment pipelines across thousands of running PostgreSQL instances, including testing and rollout strategies

- 
Manage complex extension ecosystems — compatibility, upgrade paths, and conflict resolution

- 
Work with PostgreSQL's background worker framework, shared memory management, and hook system to build reliable, scalable functionality

- 
Collaborate closely with customers, partners, product, engineering, support, and success teams to maintain a secure, stable, and performant Postgres foundation

What you bring: 

- 
Deep expertise in PostgreSQL internals - query planner, executor, and storage engine mechanics

- 
Proven experience building PostgreSQL extensions in both C and Rust 

- 
Strong knowledge of PostgreSQL's permission model : RLS, roles, and grant systems

- 
Experience troubleshooting production issues in managed PostgreSQL environments, including custom extension issues, performance bottlenecks, and resource contention

- 
Comfortable building, testing, and owning idempotent deployments across thousands of running Postgres instances

- 
Ability to read and navigate PostgreSQL source code confidently

- 
Experience with multi-tenant database architectures

- 
Experience running PostgreSQL at scale

What We Offer 

- 
Fully Remote 

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
Tech Allowance 

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
Health Benefits 

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
Annual Off-Sites 

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
Flexible Work 

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
Professional Development 

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
~400 team members

- 
60+ countries

- 
20+ languages spoken

- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
About Toptal 

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Position Description:

As Chief Technology Officer, you will drive execution for the product and engineering teams and put AI at the core of everything the company builds. You will own Toptal’s full technical architecture and you will build it AI-first—utilizing best practices for agentic engineering. AI is not a workstream inside the engineer team—its core to it.

You will create and own the AI architecture and best practices the rest of the company utilizes. You will also own the initiatives that put agents into production. You should know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up, how to engineer best-in-class harnesses, and how to create best practices for agentic engineering that engineering teams adopt to 10x their productivity—without sacrificing quality. Your mindset will be that of a builder and an architect, someone who solves problems in the system itself. No problem will be too large or too small for you to solve yourself. You will set the technical direction and hold the cadenced meetings that turns technical strategy into working, production-ready outcomes. You will be in the design reviews and in the code, not adjacent to them. You will move fast, and you will ensure our engineering team is never the reason an initiative slows down.

You are the technical owner of all Toptal’s products. You will collaborate closely with Product to design infrastructure that exposes Toptal’s core business logic through modular interfaces the rest of the business can build on. Alongside a group of hands-on executives, your engineering discipline directly shapes Toptal’s growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

You will own resourcing and workforce planning as a doer: scoping the work, sizing the teams, planning headcount against it, defining the role and the bar for every seat. None of that is beneath the role, and we are not interested in someone who thinks these tasks can be done properly by handing it off to HR. Hiring is the highest-leverage work you do, and we want someone who is visibly excited about hiring A-players—with a sense of urgency.

Then, you lead the team. You will set the standards, develop people against those standards, and know exactly who is meeting those standards.

You will be one of Toptal’s foremost experts on AI, and you will stay ahead of a field that never stops moving. You will coach engineers on agentic best practices, show the executive team what is newly possible with the new AI tooling, and push AI into every function at Toptal.

This role runs on high-energy execution and attention to detail. You will bring urgency to every part of it and measure yourself on outcomes. We are not looking for someone to oversee this work. We are looking for someone to drive it and get into the detiwls.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. 

One precondition runs through all of it: you conceive the strategy. You will form your own view of where engineering and AI should go, build the case, and bring the CEO a strategy to react to, not a request for direction.

AI and agentic engineering 

- Own Toptal’s AI technology strategy and the architecture beneath it: model selection and fine-tuning, harness design, orchestration, retrieval, context engineering, tool and MCP integration, guardrails, evaluation, and cost control, exposed as primitives every team composes against.

- Deploy agentic engineering at scale against the work that runs this business: matching, vetting, onboarding, delivery, and internal operations. Own the outcomes those agents are accountable for.

- Make AI quality measurable. Own the evals, the regression suites, and the review loops, so quality here is proven rather than claimed.

- Rebuild how the platform gets built and operated, raising output per engineer through AI-assisted development, review, testing, and operations. Engineers have to want this, not comply with it, and creating that pull is on you.

Team, resourcing, and accountability 

- Decide what a team should look like now that the roles have blurred, where the product manager believes they can design and code, the engineer believes they can do product and design, and the designer believes they can code and do product.

- Own resourcing and workforce planning: scope the roadmap into buildable work, plan headcount and sequence, write the specs, and hit time-sensitive hiring commitments.

- Own the bar for the team: assess talent honestly, develop people against the bar, and hold it as the organization grows.

Platform and execution 

- Own the architecture end to end, from services and data flows to interfaces and system boundaries, and hold the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.

- Own throughput, reliability, and the platform layer beneath them, including the AI-dependent paths where latency, drift, and provider outages are real failure modes. Own build-versus-buy, technical debt, secure-by-design architecture, responsible AI, and the engineering and AI cost structure down to inference and token spend.

In the first week, expect to:

- Learn Toptal’s model and platform architecture, and meet the leaders you will depend on across Engineering, Product, Industries, and Services.

- Establish a direct, working rhythm with the CEO.

In the first month, expect to:

- Assess the engineering function honestly, and assess AI maturity with it: what is really in production, what is measured, what is duplicated, and what should be shut down.

- Assess the team against the bar this role requires, and bring the executive team a strategy no one asked you for.

In the first three months, expect to:

- Be executing your own plan, with a review cadence and clear accountability at every level, and your resourcing plan presented.

- Stand up the shared AI architecture and evals, and put one agentic workflow into production with a baseline and a measured result.

In the first six months, expect to:

- Show business impact from agents in production in at least two core workflows, with the evidence behind it.

- Have the leadership team you need, with the bar visibly raised, and throughput and reliability moving on the paths that matter most.

In the first year, expect to:

- Run an engineering organization recognized inside and outside Toptal as one of the most advanced in the industry, with the pull on AI now coming from engineering.

- Have AI leverage embedded in the architecture and the operating model, not living in a portfolio of pilots, and the team you built delivering against plan.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is required, and an advanced degree is strongly preferred.

- 15+ years of progressive engineering leadership, including significant time as a CTO or VP of Engineering, or as a direct report to one at meaningful scale.

- Deep, current, hands-on command of modern AI engineering: foundation models, agentic architectures, harness design, retrieval, context engineering, fine-tuning, and evaluation. You have shipped and operated these in production, and you know how to build and fine-tune foundation models from the ground up.

- Agentic systems deployed at scale against real business processes, with measured outcomes on cost, cycle time, quality, or revenue, and a record of retiring what did not work.

- Rigor about evaluation. You can explain precisely how you knew a model, prompt, or agent change was an improvement, and you can show the evidence.

- Command of the economics underneath it: model routing, hosted versus self-hosted, inference capacity, latency and cost budgets, and staying portable across providers.

- Further ahead on AI than the executives around you, able to teach it, and proven at moving an organization to adopt something it was not asking for.

- You create strategy rather than administer it, and you win arguments on evidence rather than authority, including your view on what a team should look like in the age of AI.

- Proven ownership of resourcing and workforce planning, and a hiring track record you can quantify. You have made the hard calls when someone was not clearing the bar.

- Currently hands-on. You read and write code, you can take apart a design document or an eval harness and find the flaw in it, and you command distributed systems, service architecture, data-intensive applications, and cloud infrastructure at scale.

- Experience scaling and modernizing a large existing codebase without stopping the business. You have replaced load-bearing systems in flight, not only built greenfield.

- Experience leading a globally distributed, remote team at a technology or hyper-growth company is required. A high-volume, two-sided marketplace or multi-tenant platform is a significant plus.

- Outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

- Speed, ownership, and quality. You move with urgency, decide without perfect information, and treat everything you deliver as a reflection of yourself.

- You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

title: Staff Software Engineer, AI-Native Systems
description:
Staff Software Engineer, AI-Native Systems (Tech Lead) 

Location: Remote (US)

We are 

Virtual care only works if the infrastructure behind it does. Wheel builds that infrastructure — the systems that let telehealth run at scale for the patients, clinicians, and companies depending on it. We're not bolting AI onto old workflows; we're rebuilding them from the ground up. Our mission to put great healthcare in everyone's reach means replacing manual, ad-hoc processes with intelligent, agent-powered systems that carry real operational load. We're innovating in a live, regulated healthcare environment where getting it right matters. This is the next architecture of virtual care, and we're building it now.

You are 

A staff-level engineer who sets technical direction for agentic systems and then leads the work to ship them. You've built and operated agents in production, you know where they break, and you have opinions — held loosely, argued well — about how to build them so they hold up in a regulated environment.

You operate with the scope of a domain owner, not a task owner. You take a problem that isn't yet well-formed, define it, sequence it, and lead a group of engineers to a shipped and measured outcome. Your impact shows up in other people's work as much as your own: the patterns they reuse, the design decisions they don't have to relitigate, the ambiguity you removed before it cost the team a quarter.

You treat AI two ways at once — as a product capability you build with judgment, and as a development multiplier you use fluently — and you're the person who raises the org's bar on both.

The Work 

Technical Leadership & Direction 

- 
Own the technical direction for a significant AI-native domain: agent architecture, platform abstractions, or evaluation and guardrail infrastructure.

- 
Act as tech lead for a squad or a cross-team initiative — decomposing ambiguous problems, sequencing delivery, identifying and clearing blockers, and keeping the team pointed at the outcome rather than the ticket.

- 
Write and review design docs; make and document the load-bearing architectural calls, including the ones where the answer is "not yet" or "buy, don't build."

- 
Establish clear technical ownership where it's currently diffuse, so decisions have a named owner and reviews don't stall.

Agent Architecture & Engineering 

- 
Design and build production AI agents incorporating retrieval, orchestration, policy-based routing, tool invocation, evaluation harnesses, and lifecycle observability.

- 
Set the standards for what "production-ready agent" means here — testability, rollback safety, cost ceilings, failure modes, human-in-the-loop boundaries — and hold the bar in review.

- 
Take on the hardest parts of the build yourself. This is a hands-on role; you are expected to be in the code.

AI Platform Foundations 

- 
Build and extend the abstraction layers that let teams integrate AI capabilities cleanly and safely across our services.

- 
Define the shared libraries, patterns, and guardrails other teams build on, and drive their adoption — a pattern nobody uses isn't a pattern.

- 
Treat responsible use of AI on sensitive data as a hard engineering requirement, and translate privacy, security, and compliance constraints into concrete architecture rather than deferring them.

Cloud-Native Engineering 

- 
Own full-stack delivery in TypeScript/Node.js and Python: service and API layers, data-processing jobs, and the internal interfaces on top of them.

- 
Leverage modern cloud infrastructure, event-driven patterns, CI/CD, and observability to deliver scalable AI-native systems.

- 
Own deployment, monitoring, and troubleshooting in production, including on-call, and improve the operational posture of what you inherit.

Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory 

- 
Partner directly with product, operations, clinical operations, and business leaders as both technologist and trusted advisor — helping define which use cases are worth building and which aren't.

- 
Lead design sessions, proofs of concept, and build-with sessions alongside the people who'll use the workflows, building trust and adoption as you go.

- 
Communicate trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, up to and including the executive team.

- 
Influence roadmap and prioritization with a clear-eyed read of technical risk, sequencing, and cost.

Measure & Improve 

- 
Own the evaluation strategy for your domain: define the metrics, test harnesses, and evaluation plans that measure agent accuracy, latency, safety, and cost-effectiveness.

- 
Instrument the systems so their behavior is legible after the fact, not just at demo time.

- 
Iterate rapidly on data, feedback, and changing requirements — and kill approaches that aren't working, early and visibly.

Growing the Org 

- 
Mentor and grow engineers through code review, design review, pairing, and direct feedback; make the people around you measurably better.

- 
Craft reusable patterns, documentation, and best practices that raise the engineering bar beyond your own team.

- 
Anchor our internal community of practice around AI-native and agentic engineering.

What success looks like 

- 
First 90 days: you have a working map of our AI platform surface area, have shipped something real, and have a point of view on where the leverage is.

- 
First 6 months: you own a domain outright, are leading a team's technical direction within it, and there's an evaluation story for the agents you've shipped.

- 
First year: patterns you established are in use by teams you don't sit on, and engineers point to you as the reason their work got better.

What we're looking for 

- 
8+ years building and operating production software, with meaningful full-stack depth across a TypeScript/Node.js backend and at least one other language (Python strongly preferred).

- 
A track record of technical leadership as an individual contributor: owning a domain, leading multi-engineer efforts to completion, and driving decisions across team boundaries without positional authority.

- 
Hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic systems in production — retrieval, orchestration, tool/function calling, and evaluation — with a clear-eyed view of where LLMs and agents work and where they don't.

- 
Demonstrated ability to take a loosely defined problem and drive it to a shipped, measured, agent-powered workflow.

- 
A working practice of using AI development tools as a force multiplier, with judgment about when to trust, verify, or override them.

- 
Strong cloud-native engineering fundamentals; comfort with CI/CD, observability, and running what you build.

- 
Fluency with relational data and SQL.

- 
Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to write a design doc that changes minds. This is a remote, cross-functional role.

- 
Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward shipping measurable results.

Strongly desired 

- 
Experience with agent frameworks and multi-agent architectures at production scale.

- 
Model evaluation and guardrail infrastructure — measuring output quality, catching regressions, keeping agents inside safe bounds.

- 
Experience building platform capabilities consumed by other engineering teams.

- 
Background in workflow automation, forecasting-driven products, or supply-demand matching.

- 
Prior work in a regulated environment (healthcare/HIPAA, fintech, etc.) and an instinct for the constraints that come with using AI on sensitive data.

- 
Experience mentoring engineers or acting as a formal tech lead.

How we work 

Remote-first (US), fast-moving, tight loops between engineering, product, and the business. We're an AI-forward engineering org — we expect AI in the toolchain and in the product, and we measure outcomes over activity. We handle sensitive healthcare data under strict controls; privacy, security, and responsible use of AI are engineering requirements here, not afterthoughts.

Salary and Perks

title: Engineering Manager - EU
description:
Hi I’m Colin , Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at Ashby .

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been skunkworks projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a pessimistic mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is optimistic about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an experienced, talented, and collaborative team of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

- Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

- Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.

- Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-date (while staying off the critical path).

- Improve how we generate and simulate data in demo accounts. It’s a project off the critical path, but it helps you keep up-to-date on our codebase while immensely impacting the business, from Engineering to QA to Sales.

Why be a manager?

I had two experiences early in my career that set me on my path. I had a great manager who asked tonnes of questions about the decisions I was making and coached me without me realizing it. And I had a terrible manager - being told to work harder after a week of 3am finishes was not what I needed as a young engineer. The stark difference between these two experiences motivated me to become a manager: I wanted every engineer I worked with to have the support I had in the best case.

Since then, as I’ve learned more, I’ve realized that I love the kind of problems I get to solve as a manager. Deeply complex problems with long-term impact both on the company and on people’s lives. One of my proudest achievements is creating a fully transparent pay system, and on the day it was revealed, everybody was happy with it. Nobody stormed out. By spending time thinking deeply about everybody’s pay and ensuring the mechanics of promotion were clear, I put the team in a place where they could see a peer was paid more than them, and it not be a problem.

Despite all this, I love being technical. I sometimes indulge myself and spend a morning writing some code to improve tests or provide better abstractions. If I couldn’t be a manager, I’d be super happy to be an IC.

I’m looking for someone who is passionate. Passionate about both management and being technical. Someone who spots a pattern amongst their team, figures out a better way for us to operate, and then builds the automation that powers it. I introduced a new process that enables engineers to merge 30% of PRs without a human review beforehand. I also built the automation that approves these PRs. I also built that automation with abstractions that make it easy for the engineers to improve the automation themselves.

It can be hard to find seasoned engineering leaders who haven’t succumbed to the status quo in some way or another. We're committed to giving all our people a total and utter lack of terrible managers, and that means we're willing to take a chance on someone early in their leadership journey who's courageous, principled, and has the drive to build themselves into a great leader who can say “Yah I know everyone is doing that, but we won't because...”

Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply

Engineering leadership comes in many flavors, not all of which fit our model. I thought I’d outline some things I’m looking for to help you decide if this fits what you’re looking for:

- You love being technical and can hold in-depth conversations with direct reports from infra to backend to frontend.

- You enjoy management problems . We want people who get excited about driving people to be their best, giving difficult feedback, and building systems that make this easier

- You hold your team to a high standard and don’t shy away from getting into the details and giving feedback, even to the best folks on your team.

- You are an excellent and empathetic communicator. Facilitating change at both an individual and organization level requires understanding how to navigate the beliefs, opinions, and past experiences of engineers and figuring out how to both convince them of a new way of doing things while also leaving yourself open to feedback. 

- You know what exceptional engineers look like. You’ve thought deeply about what makes them tick, how to recruit them, and how to grow folks into them. I want to see depth here, the industry often regurgitates a vanilla description, but the reality is more nuanced.

- You’re good at thinking about product, business , and maybe even design, but you’re not interested in calling the shots and are more interested in building a team that can make the best decisions without you.

- You thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments . We're a young startup where leaders wear multiple hats, and you'll build your own (high-speed) on-ramp through developing strong feedback loops.

Put another way, you shouldn’t apply if: 

- You don’t enjoy coding or don’t find time to stay up-to-date on technology.

- You’ve gotten into management because it was the only growth path available

- You want to make all the product decisions instead of empowering your team to make those calls.

- You're happy with a team of engineers that are predominantly early-career, mid-career, or don't thrive with ownership or autonomy. With enough guardrails, the team can get things done.

- A staff or principal engineer to you is someone who spends most of their time project managing or doing architecture reviews.

- You’re not optimistic or convinced that we can build a large engineering team that functions differently than the status quo. You think, at some size, common processes need to be implemented to ensure consistent product delivery (e.g., sprint planning, product managers writing in-depth specifications). You might not say it out loud, but you think, at some size, compromises have to be made for the sake of hiring numbers.

What We’re Building

Talent teams aspire to build a hiring process that identifies great candidates, moves them quickly through the interview process, and provides an excellent experience for the candidate. To accomplish this, recruiters perform thousands of daily tasks to coordinate and relay information between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers. Teams struggle to keep up!

Scheduling a final round is an excellent example of our customers' challenges. A recruiter needs to collect availability from the candidate, identify potential interviewers, perform “Calendar Tetris” to find who is available to interview the candidate, schedule on the earliest date possible, and perform any last-minute adjustments as availability changes. They must perform this while considering the interview load on each individual and whether interviewers need to be trained and shadowing others. 

Ashby provides talent teams with intelligent and powerful software that provides insights into where they’re failing and automates or simplifies many of the tasks they’re underwater with. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered and extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

We have many customers, great revenue growth, years of runway, and amazing investors like YCombinator, Elad Gil, and Lachy Groom. I’ll share more once we meet.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Abhik and Benji ’s (our co-founders) belief that a small talented team, given the right environment, can build high-quality software fast (and work regular hours!).

Collaboration is Natural, Communication is Deliberate

Our engineering team (and the team at large) consists of lifelong learners who are humble and kind (meet them here !). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally (we filter for it in interviews). We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers can focus 36h out of a 40h work week (Abhik wrote about it here ). Even managers can rely on getting consistent time (and support to make, if necessary) to focus and do creative work without the demand of constant meetings.

Increase Leverage, not Team Size

We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:

- Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 5x a day. Everyone on the team has contributed to developer experience 

- Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) which we are constantly improving. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video on it here ).

- AI-powered tooling. We think of AI as a way to automate the mundane parts of building and maintaining high-quality software. We use a combination of third-party and internally built tools that, for instance, auto-triage customer issues, suggest fixes, prototype ideas, generate production-ready code, and conduct code reviews. Engineers have an unlimited token budget (but are not measured on it). We write in detail about our philosophy, current use of AI, and future plans for AI in Engineering here .

Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:

And a demo of one of these building blocks:

Give Engineers Ownership & Autonomy

We, as engineers, find clever ways to solve problems, which amplifies when we deeply understand the problem. All of us in technical leadership did our best work as engineers when we had a deep understanding of the end-user and the business and ownership over the solution.
